title: Senior Data Warehouse Engineer
description:
company summary:

echostar is reimagining the future of connectivity. our business reach spans satellite television service, live-streaming and on-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products.  
  
today, our brands include boost mobile, dish tv, gen mobile, hughes and sling tv.

our technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our team members play a vital role in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow.

job duties and responsibilities:

**candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.**

this role addresses the complex challenges of scaling enterprise data infrastructure and maintaining peak system reliability across massive ecosystems. the position focuses on eliminating performance bottlenecks, streamlining etl/elt workflows, and maintaining strict data quality standards. additionally, modernizing data pipeline engineering with cloud-native architectures and leveraging artificial intelligence will drive continuous operational excellence.

**what success looks like (objectives):**

* monitor and provide expert-level operational support for large enterprise data ecosystems using snowflake and databricks while resolving etl/elt bottlenecks
* architect, maintain, and optimize scalable batch and streaming pipelines on aws using clean, production-grade python code
* design, automate, and manage complex enterprise data workflows and job schedules using apache airflow and control-m
* champion infrastructure-as-code (iac), manage ci/cd pipelines via gitlab, and integrate generative ai tools like amazon q to drive operational efficiency
* lead incident management, root cause analysis meetings, and operational metrics development to continuously improve production systems
* collaborate within agile/scrum frameworks alongside data scientists, analysts, and devops teams to execute complex data transformation logic

skills, experience and requirements:

**core skills and competencies (what you’ll bring):**

* critical experience designing, developing, and engineering large-scale enterprise data warehouses (edw) and modern data lake architectures
* advanced proficiency in sql, python, and shell scripting for building and deploying production-grade data pipelines
* deep expertise in aws data services and cloud infrastructure, including iam, vpc, cloudwatch, redshift, and s3
* strong ability in relational and analytical data modeling utilizing dimensional (kimball) and 3nf structures
* high proficiency in devops best practices, version control using git/gitlab, and iac tools such as terraform or aws cloudformation
* ai literacy and application skills to evaluate modern technologies like generative ai tools (amazon q, gemini, databricks genie rooms) to accelerate development workflows

**minimum requirements:**

* **minimum education:** bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field
* **minimum experience:** 4+ years of professional experience in enterprise data warehousing and data lake engineering
* **required technical skills:** must have at least 3 years of experience with:
* + sql, python, and shell scripting
  + aws cloud data platform (s3, redshift, ec2, glue), snowflake or databricks ecosystems

title: Scientist III – AI Scientist for Quantitative Neuropathy and ML Scalable Infrastructure
description:
***scientist iii – ai scientist for quantitative neuropathy and ml scalable infrastructure***

the **allen institute** accelerates science for a healthier world through large-scale research designed to answer some of the most complex questions in biology. our multi-disciplinary teams generate foundational knowledge, tools, and data to understand how our brain, cells, and immune system work. we share our work openly so others can build on it, move faster, and ask bigger questions. we drive discovery forward and create new possibilities for improving human health.

**brain health** is a new global collaborative research initiative designed to accelerate understanding of human brain diseases through large-scale human tissue analysis, open science, ai-enabled disease modeling, and translational platform technologies. building on foundational advances in human brain cell atlases, quantitative neuropathology, single-cell and spatial biology, multimodal molecular profiling, and ai-enabled analysis, brain health is developing a scalable framework for understanding disease progression directly in the human brain and identifying new opportunities for therapeutic development.

we are searching for a **scientist iii in scalable ai/ml for neuropathology** who will develop, scale, and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning methods, along with the infrastructure that supports them, to integrate multimodal neuropathological data, model disease progression, and drive the mechanistic understanding of brain disease at cellular resolution. this role sits at the intersection of computational biology, neuropathology, and ml engineering, working within the brain health accelerator and collaborating with experimental neuropathologists and software engineers. ai/ml focus areas could include multimodal foundation models, diffusion models, and computer vision architectures, together with the distributed training, data pipelines, and model serving needed to run them at scale.

at the allen institute, we believe that science is for everyone – and should be open to everyone. we are dedicated to combating biases and reducing barriers to stem careers more broadly.

we also believe that science is better when it includes different perspectives and voices. we strive to make the allen institute a place where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to do their best work in a supportive environment.

we are an equal-opportunity employer and strongly encourage people from all backgrounds to apply for our open positions.

**essential functions**

* develop and deploy large-scale ml models integrating multimodal neuropathological data, including digital histology, spatial transcriptomics, mri, and clinical metadata, to characterize brain disease progression at cellular resolution
* design and apply computer vision architectures (vit and related models) and foundation models to quantitative neuropathology image analysis
* design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that render diverse biological and neuropathological datasets, including gigapixel whole-slide images and spatial omics, ml-ready across cloud and on-premises gpu infrastructure
* implement and optimize distributed training and inference workflows for foundation models, including multi-gpu and multi-node training, experiment tracking, and reproducible model versioning
* apply bayesian statistical and causal modeling approaches to describe and predict neurodegenerative disease trajectories
* collaborate with scientists, computational biologists, neuropathologists, and software engineers within the allen institute and with external partners to advance model development from research to scientific impact
* promote open science through publication of peer-reviewed papers and release of open-source code, models, and reusable ml tooling

* *note: reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. this description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not proscribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.*

**required education and experience**

* ph.d. in computer science, applied mathematics, computational biology, computational neuroscience, statistics, or related field; or equivalent combination of degree and experience
* minimum of 5 years of postdoctoral or industry research experience
* demonstrated ability to design, implement, and apply deep learning models to large-scale biological or medical image data
* experience with bayesian modeling and probabilistic inference
* experience building and maintaining scalable data or training pipelines for large-scale ml workloads
* proficiency in python and ml frameworks including pytorch or jax, with strong software engineering practices (version control, testing, code review)

**preferred education and experience**

* 3-5 years of experience developing and applying ml methods to biomedical or neuropathological data
* experience with digital pathology workflows, quantitative neuropathology, or computational histology
* familiarity with multimodal data fusion approaches, including integration of imaging, omics, and clinical data
* experience with score-based diffusion models, multimodal transformer architectures, or state-space models
* experience developing or applying causal models of disease or biological processes
* proficiency with cloud computing platforms and on-premises gpu clusters for large-scale model training, including distributed training frameworks (e.g., pytorch ddp/fsdp, deepspeed, or ray)
* experience with containerization and workflow orchestration (e.g., docker, kubernetes, slurm, nextflow, or airflow) and with large-scale image formats such as ome-zarr
* strong publication record of innovative individual and team scientific contributions
* excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

**physical demands**

* fine motor movements in fingers/hands to operate computers and other office equipment; repetitive motion with lab equipment

**position type/expected hours of work**

* this role is currently able to work both remotely and onsite in a hybrid work environment. we are a washington state employer, and the primary work location for all allen institute employees is 615 westlake ave n.; any remote work must be performed in washington state.

**travel**

* attendance and participation in national and international conferences occasionally required

**additional comments**

* include a cover letter with your application
* \*\*please note, this opportunity offers relocation assistance\*\*
* \*\*please note, this opportunity may offer work visa sponsorship\*\*
* this position is funded by and depending upon, a grant award to the allen institute. (the position may terminate at the conclusion of the grant)

**annualized salary range**

$129,950 - $162,450 \*

* final salary depends on the required education for the role, experience, level of skills relevant to the role, and work location, where applicable.

**benefits**

* employees (and their families) are eligible to enroll in benefits per eligibility rules outlined in the allen institute’s benefits guide. these benefits include medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. employees are also eligible to enroll in the allen institute’s 401k plan. paid time off is also available as outlined in the allen institutes benefits guide. details on the allen institute’s benefits offering are located at the following link to the benefits guide: https://alleninstitute.org/careers/benefits.

*it is the policy of the allen institute to provide equal employment opportunity (eeo) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. in addition, the allen institute will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.*

title: Senior Engineer, Agentic Engineering Governance, Open Source
description:
**college board – technology – platform operations**

**location:** this is a remote role. candidates who live near cb offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (tuesday and wednesday in office). all cb employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

**role type**: this is a full-time position

**about the team**

the platform operations team at college board builds solutions to help reimagine and elevate engineering practices around cloud infrastructure, architecture, networking, ci/cd, iac, and developer experience. we operationalize the platforms that are core to our development environment within our growing aws ecosystem. we also lead the organization's approach to agentic and ai-assisted software development, helping engineering teams safely and effectively adopt ai coding agents and tools. our team consists of engineers with a unique blend of skills and experiences that foster a collaborative working environment where each individual member contributes to the success of the team. we learn and teach. we are creative and value the merit of ideas.

**about the opportunity**

as a senior engineer focused on agentic engineering governance for open source software, you are an idea-generator, a catalyst, and a collaborator who sets the standard for how college board engineers use ai coding agents and agentic development tools safely, responsibly, and effectively. you understand cloud software delivery, tools, and processes that empower efficient and resilient delivery, and you bring that same rigor to the guardrails, policies, and standards that govern how developers use ai coding assistants (such as claude code, github copilot, and similar agentic tools). you are technologically curious and seek opportunities to research emerging technologies and trends, standards, and products. your eagerness and vision enable you to create and learn complex solutions.

your focus will be on the fast-moving area of agentic governance for open-source software, where you build the program for license compliance, dependency risk, and review of the code we publish externally. you thrive in an environment with a strong mix of creativity and productivity, splitting your time between hands-on building and setting the standards others follow. you work closely with security, legal, and the developers who rely on us. your excellent communication and mentoring skills allow you to effectively articulate solutions and policies to the team, enabling all to make healthy, well-governed contributions. the result is that the teams building for 7 million students each year can adopt ai with confidence.

*in this role, you will:*

design & implementation (60%)

* design and implement guardrails, permission models, and policy-as-code controls that govern how ai coding agents (e.g., claude code, github copilot, and similar agentic tools) interact with source code, infrastructure, and production systems
* build solutions using the best practices of agile, ci/cd, and devops
* build and maintain tooling for sandboxing, audit logging, and rollback of agent-driven code and infrastructure changes
* continuously develop the skills required to work as part of the agile team in a poly-skilled development environment, including hands-on use of agentic coding tools
* be a subject matter expert in current technological capabilities such as cloud networking, api integrations, infrastructure resiliency, cloud design, and agentic/ai-assisted development patterns
* write code to automate the infrastructure lifecycle, create and support internal tools utilizing iac, and be able to use clis
* evaluate and pilot emerging agentic programming tools, frameworks, and protocols (e.g., mcp, agent orchestration frameworks), and make adoption recommendations
* partner with domain smes (delivery team software engineers, security, infrastructure, network, observability and operations) to analyze features, capabilities, and risks of agentic tooling
* contribute to the development and growth of the cloud engineering program, through thought leadership, design and implementation of tools and processes
* participate in the enterprise architecture review process, with a focus on proposals involving ai coding agents and agentic tooling

governance & strategy (25%)

* establish and maintain organization-wide standards, guardrails, and acceptable-use policies for agentic and ai-assisted software development
* partner with security, legal/compliance, and architecture review stakeholders to assess risk and approve new use cases for ai coding agents
* contribute to technology strategy and planning; conduct research on emerging agentic and ai development technologies and recommend approaches that increase safety, cost effectiveness, and systems flexibility
* author documentation, playbooks, and governance frameworks for developers using ai coding assistants
* participate in agile scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, daily scrum, demo, retro) and contribute to team deliverables
* participate in peer reviews of software engineering artifacts, including code produced or assisted by ai agents
* assist in the identification and resolution of production and production-like issues, including those arising from agentic tooling, as part of the team’s daytime on-call rotation

team coordination & enablement (15%)

* mentor team members on the safe, effective, and compliant use of agentic coding tools
* design and deliver training materials and office hours to help developers adopt agentic engineering practices
* lead technical efforts and mentor technical staff in the development and usage of technology architectures and solutions, with a primary focus on agentic engineering governance for open source software
* serve as an escalation point for questions on ai coding tool policy and governance

**about you**

*to qualify for this role, you must have:*

* 5+ years of experience with infrastructure as code, ci/cd framework, immutable infrastructure, automation, orchestration, and other modern devops patterns
* significant hands-on experience with ai coding agents or assistants (e.g., claude code, github copilot, cursor, windsurf) or other llm-based developer tooling
* experience with llm platforms and apis such as anthropic claude or openai, including agent orchestration and tool-use concepts like function calling and mcp
* understanding of ai/llm security considerations such as prompt injection, data exfiltration, permission scoping, and sandboxing
* experience establishing technical standards, guardrails, or review processes across an engineering organization, in responsible ai governance or an adjacent discipline such as security
* technical knowledge of cloud computing, devops, and microservices, with strong experience in distributed cloud infrastructure (aws preferred, with experience in services such as lambda, sns, sqs, s3, step functions, ec2, ecs, vpc, iam, cloudwatch, and dynamodb a plus)
* experience building event-driven cloud-based serverless applications
* a strong background in a language such as python, javascript, react.js/node.js, or java, with the logic and problem-solving skills to pick up new languages quickly
* excellent communication, collaboration, and documentation skills; ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language, including to non-technical stakeholders on ai governance topics
* experience supporting developers as internal customers, gathering their requirements and feedback, and earning adoption of the standards you set
* curiosity and discipline to research emerging technologies, standards, and products, and the ability to prioritize and execute in a high-pressure environment

*all roles at college board require:*

* a passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
* authorization to work in the united states for any employer
* curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new ai-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
* clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
* a learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
* a drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
* a collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

**about our process**

* application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. this role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
* while the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

**what we offer**

at college board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. we’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

***a thoughtful approach to compensation***

* the hiring range for this role is **$153,000 – $166,000**.
* your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at college board.
* we aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
* we adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

you’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at college board throughout your hiring process. check out our careers page for more.

title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
description:
**about us**  
visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

at visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

join visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. progress starts with you.

**job description**

every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay- visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200+ countries. as a software development engineer on the product reliability engineering (pre) team, you won’t just watch those systems run- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them.

pre is not a traditional ops team. we are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. you’ll write python, build agentic ai tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real-time transactions. from day one, you are an engineer- and from day one, your work matters.

if you are endlessly curious about how large-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of ai, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you.

**build automation that scales**

* design and ship end-to-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves.
* write clean, production-grade python (and go or bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self-managing.
* develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle.

**manage & evolve data platforms**

* support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure.
* gain exposure to real-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale
* perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier-1 production databases.
* optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, cpu usage, and replication latency.
* automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like ansible and liquibase, and contribute to ci/cd pipelines that govern schema changes through test and prod environments safely.
* build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents.

**ship agentic ai & ml-powered tools**

* build genai-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management.
* integrate llms into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, ai-driven intelligence.
* contribute to prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position pre as one of the most ai-forward reliability organizations in financial technology.

**own observability & platform health**

* build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using prometheus, grafana, splunk, or elk that give engineers real-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems.
* analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur.
* contribute to self-healing and auto-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention.

**engineer for reliability & security**

* ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale.
* support zero-downtime deployment strategies and high-availability architectures that visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock.
* participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first-class engineering concern.

**collaborate, learn & grow fast**

* embed within agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global pre peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions.

* experience helping build an emerging ml function: establishing the practices, tooling, and production patterns a growing team builds on.
* databricks on azure, pyspark, and ci/cd for ml, including mlflow, model registry, model serving, and feature stores.
* experience extending, evaluating, or migrating commercial search or personalization platforms (e.g., bloomreach, constructor, algolia, dynamic yield, salesforce personalization, salesforce commerce cloud).
* semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), or computer vision applied to product discovery.
* ecommerce or omnichannel retail experience, ideally in high-consideration, project-based categories (home improvement, furniture, home décor).
* experience with llm-based agents or tool-using workflows.
* experience with clickstream and customer behavioral data at scale.
* experience with causal inference methods for measuring impact.
* experience mentoring other data scientists or serving as technical lead on a multi-person ml effort.

**essential job functions:**

* build and improve ml models for product search and discovery, using floor & decor's proprietary signals (customer behavior, store-level availability, local demand) to help customers find the right products faster.
* develop personalization and recommendation models across site and app, including "complete the project" recommendations and session-based models for anonymous and infrequent shoppers.
* apply llms and computer vision to enrich product attributes at catalog scale, improving search, filtering, recommendations, and product feeds, with quality controls appropriate for technical product specifications.
* partner with the lead data scientist, ai/ml on conversational shopping and ai-assisted project guidance, owning retrieval quality and evaluation, including offline evaluation sets, and monitoring of quality, cost, latency, and safety.
* build durable ml assets (enriched product data, embeddings, evaluation sets) that carry across ecommerce platform and vendor changes.
* lead quantitative evaluation of search and personalization vendors using floor & decor's own data; recommend where platform configuration is sufficient and where proprietary models create defensible value.
* own models in production on databricks, delivering documented outputs that ecommerce and it engineering integrate into the site, app, and vendor platforms; monitor performance and own retraining and troubleshooting.
* help build out ml capabilities on databricks as needs expand, and, with the lead data scientist, ai/ml, define team ml engineering standards built to scale as the team grows.
* partner with data engineering, product, and engineering on the data and event tracking needed to train and measure models.
* design and analyze a/b tests for model-driven features, measure incremental impact on conversion, average order value, and engagement, and confirm that offline model gains translate into online results. standard digital performance reporting is owned by ecommerce analytics.
* inform the digital data science roadmap, set jointly by ecommerce product and data science leadership, by sizing opportunities, assessing feasibility, and communicating what a model will and won't do.
* serve as technical lead for digital ml: guide the work of the data scientist, digital, raise the team's technical bar through design and code reviews, and support recruiting and hiring.
* maintain clear documentation of methodologies, model assumptions, and limitations to ensure reproducibility and continuity.
* stay abreast of developments in search, recommender systems, and applied generative ai, and bring relevant advances into floor & decor's practice.
* be compliant with all appropriate privacy preferences, responsible ai, and security protocols, including guardrails for customer-facing generative ai.

description:

as one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. by delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. if you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at invesco.

title: Mgr - Software Eng
description:
**ally and your career**  
ally financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. we love this stuff! we see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. from generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. we want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. you’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?
  
  
**work schedule** **:** ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. all work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

  

**the opportunity**

we are seeking an experienced and hands-on genai tech lead to drive the end-to-end development of enterprise-grade generative and agentic ai solutions. you will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and hands-on execution—architecting robust systems, leading a talented team of engineers, and transforming complex business challenges into scalable ai products.

**the work itself**

**key responsibilities**

  

**minimum qualifications:**

* 7+ years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
* bachelor’s degree in relevant field or equivalent

**preferred qualifications:**

* **architecture & design:** design scalable, secure, and production-ready genai applications utilizing large language models (llms), fine-tune and deploy open-source models that meets business needs, retrieval-augmented generation (rag) pipelines, and vector databases.
* **agentic workflows:** build and orchestrate multi-agent ai systems and tool-calling frameworks (e.g., langchain, langgraph, autogen).
* **technical leadership:** lead code reviews, establish engineering best practices, enforce coding standards, and mentor junior-to-mid-level software engineers.
* **prototyping & r&d:** rapidly build proof of concepts (pocs) and minimum viable products (mvps) to test emerging ai models and frameworks
* **llmops & monitoring:** implement monitoring, caching, prompt versioning, cost tracking, and evaluation guardrails for models running in production
* **cross-functional collaboration:** partner with product managers, data scientists, security teams, and business stakeholders to align technical deliverables with organizational goals
* **experience:** 8+ of software engineering experience with 5+ years in machine learning engineering, with at least 2+ years hands-on focus building and deploying genai/llm enterprise applications.
* **core technologies:** advanced proficiency in python and cloud-native development (aws, azure, or google cloud).
* **ai frameworks:** deep practical knowledge of rag architectures, vector search, prompt engineering, and orchestration libraries (langchain, llamaindex, langgraph).
* **infrastructure:** familiarity with ci/cd pipelines, containerization (docker, kubernetes), and api microservices.
* **soft skills:** proven track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and translating complex technical concepts into clear business value. strong analytical, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills. ability to prioritize workload and balance multiple initiatives and efforts. ability to respond quickly to a changing environment.
* experience fine-tuning open-weight foundation models.
* background in highly regulated industries (bank/finance) navigating strict security protocols.
* active curiosity about emerging ai tooling, model context protocol (mcp), and automated evaluation loops.

  

**how we'll have your back**  
ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. our total rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:
  
  
**time away:** program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).
  
  
**planning for the future:** plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401k retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.
  
  
**supporting your health & well-being:** flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax health savings account with employer contributions, healthcare fsa, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.
  
  
**building a family:** adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, dependent day care fsa back-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts.
  
  
**work-life integration:** other benefits including mentally fit employee assistance program, subsidized and discounted weight watchers® program and other employee discount programs.
  
  
**other compensations:** depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity.
  
  
to view more detailed information about ally’s total rewards, please visit this link: https://www.ally.com/content/dam/pdf/corporate/ally-total-rewards-snapshot.pdf

  

**who we are** **:**  
ally financial is a customer-centric, leading digital financial services company with passionate customer service and innovative financial solutions. we are relentlessly focused on "doing it right" and being a trusted financial-services provider to our consumer, commercial, and corporate customers. for more information, visit www.ally.com .

in accordance with the americans with disabilities act, if after review of the position expectations, you believe that you may need a medical accommodation to fulfill the duties of this role, please email hrpolicy@ally.com with details of your accommodation request.

$110,000.00 - $180,000.00

an individual's position in the range is determined by the specific role, the scope and responsibilities of the role, work experience, education, certification(s), training, and additional qualifications. we review internal pay, the competitive market, and business environment prior to extending an offer.

this position is eligible to participate in our annual incentive plan.

title: AI / Machine Learning Talent
description:
**thank you for considering a career at ensemble!**

ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. they offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. we recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. this is why our people are the most important part of who we are. by empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

o.n.e purpose:

* **customer obsession:** consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **embracing new ideas:** continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **striving for excellence:** execute at a high level by demonstrating our “best in klas” ensemble difference principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**the opportunity:**

**ai lab - ai/ml opportunities**

**location:** san jose, ca (hybrid – onsite 3x per week on tues, wed, thurs)

**about ensemble’s ai lab**

ensemble health partners is the leading revenue cycle management (rcm) partner to u.s. health systems. we sit between hospitals, payers, and patients, and we are responsible for billions of dollars of healthcare revenue moving accurately and on time. ai is increasingly central to how we do that work — from predicting denials and automating coding to flagging payment integrity issues and routing accounts to the right action at the right time. these roles exists where those ai systems meet the business outcomes we are paid to deliver.

we are continuously building a pipeline of exceptional ai/ml talent across research, data science, and engineering. this general application allows candidates to be considered for multiple roles across the ai lab. final role alignment (e.g., data scientist, ai research scientist, machine learning engineer) and leveling will be determined based on interview performance, experience, and team needs.

**what you’ll work on**

depending on your background and strengths, you may:

* design, build, evaluate, and improve machine learning and ai systems in production environments
* translate business problems into ai/ml solutions and measurable outcomes
* develop and run experiments to evaluate models, including defining metrics, datasets, and success criteria
* productize models into scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient services
* optimize training and inference performance (latency, throughput, cost)
* analyze real-world system behavior and production data to drive continuous improvements
* partner cross-functionally with engineering, product, and domain experts to deliver end-to-end solutions
* contribute to ai research, experimentation, and adoption of new techniques where applicable
* communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**what we’re looking for**

we are hiring across a range of profiles, but strong candidates will demonstrate:

* proven experience working with machine learning or ai systems in real-world or production settings
* strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate in ambiguous, evolving environments
* ability to connect technical work to measurable business or product outcomes
* experience collaborating across teams (engineering, product, data, or research)
* ownership mindset—taking work from idea through execution and impact

**technical skills (vary by role)**

candidates may have experience with some combination of:

* **programming:** python (required), plus familiarity with sql and other languages (e.g., java, c++, go)
* **machine learning:** model development, evaluation, and optimization
* **deep learning:** frameworks such as pytorch, tensorflow, hugging face
* **llms & modern ai:** fine-tuning, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, or emerging techniques (e.g., peft, rlhf)
* **data & analytics:** statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and working with real-world datasets
* **systems & infrastructure (engineer-leaning candidates):**

  + model serving, apis, and distributed systems
  + training at scale (e.g., multi-gpu / distributed training)
  + performance optimization and cost efficiency
* **research (research-leaning candidates):**

  + experiment design, evaluation rigor
  + reading and applying state-of-the-art research
  + publication or novel contributions (preferred, not required)

**qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, or related field required
* master’s or phd preferred for certain roles (especially research-oriented positions), but not required for all paths
* relevant industry experience typically ranges from 3+ years (senior) to advanced leadership/ownership experience (staff/principal)

the base salary range for these roles is $154,100 to $341,600.

**join an award-winning company**

five-time winner of “best in klas” 2020-2022, 2024-2025

black book research's top revenue cycle management outsourcing solution 2021-2024

22 healthcare financial management association (hfma) map awards for high performance in revenue cycle 2019-2024

leader in everest group's rcm operations peak matrix assessment 2024

clarivate healthcare business insights (hbi) revenue cycle awards for strong performance 2020, 2022-2023

energage top workplaces usa 2022-2024

fortune media best workplaces in healthcare 2024

monster top workplace for remote work 2024

great place to work certified 2023-2024

* innovation

bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. a few of those include:

title: Engineer II
description:
**our values start with our people, join a team that values you!**

bring your talents to ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. all while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

as part of our team, you will experience:

* **success**. our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
* **career growth**. we develop industry leading talent because ross grows when our people grow<
* **teamwork**. we work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
* **our commitment to diversity, equality & inclusion, and our community.** we celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. we strive to be a positive force in our community.

our corporate headquarters are in dublin, ca, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in new york city, los angeles, and boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. with 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **general purpose**

we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced engineer ii – artificial intelligence (ai) to join our enterprise architecture and artificial intelligence team. this role is responsible for the hands-on design, development, and delivery of intelligent digital assistants, ai agents, and agentic solutions leveraging the microsoft ai ecosystem, including azure ai foundry, azure services, copilot studio, and the power platform, alongside pro-code development using python and other programming languages.

the ai engineer ii will contribute across the full software development lifecycle (sdlc), encompassing prototyping, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing operational support. the primary objective of this role is to deliver scalable, ai-driven solutions that enhance productivity, improve customer experience, and drive operational efficiencies within a retail environment. the position will involve participation in a diverse range of ai initiatives, including generative ai applications, autonomous agents, computer vision solutions, and intelligent process automation.

this role requires close collaboration with enterprise architects, data engineers, business analysts, and external technology partners to translate architectural designs and business requirements into robust, production-grade solutions. a strong understanding of integration platforms, apis, ai gateways, the model context protocol (mcp), and modern ai frameworks is essential to ensure solutions are scalable, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.

the ideal candidate is a proactive and results-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic and rapidly evolving technology landscape. they should demonstrate proficiency in both low-code and pro-code development environments and possess a strong commitment to continuous learning, with the ability to effectively apply emerging ai technologies to address complex, real-world challenges in the retail domain.

**the base salary range for this role is $114,300 – $195,000. the base salary range is dependent on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, relevant education, certifications, seniority, and location. the range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. other rewards vary by position and location.**

### **essential functions**

* develop and deliver ai assistants and agent-based solutions

o design, build, test, and deploy intelligent digital assistants and ai agents using microsoft copilot studio, azure ai foundry, azure ai search, and other azure services.  
o implement agentic workflows and multi-agent orchestration patterns using both low-code platforms (copilot studio, power platform) and pro-code approaches (python, sdks, apis).  
o develop and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (rag) pipelines, including data ingestion, vector indexing, prompt engineering, and grounded responses leveraging enterprise data sources.  

* participate in the full software development lifecycle (sdlc)

o contribute to all phases of solution delivery, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.  
o write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code in accordance with engineering best practices and enterprise standards.  
o support ci/cd pipelines and implement llmops practices for effective management of models, prompts, and agent lifecycles.  

* integrate ai solutions with enterprise systems and platforms

o develop and consume apis, connectors, and integration workflows to connect ai solutions with enterprise data sources (e.g., sql databases, file systems, saas platforms) and business applications.  
o work with enterprise integration platforms (e.g., mulesoft, azure api management, azure integration services) and microsoft graph connectors to enable seamless and secure data access.  
o leverage ai gateways, the model context protocol (mcp), and emerging interoperability frameworks to enable secure, governed, and extensible communication between agents and enterprise systems.  

* contribute to broader ai initiatives

o collaborate with third-party partners to design and deploy video analytics and computer vision solutions (e.g., in-store customer experience, safety monitoring, and compliance use cases).  
o support the development and operationalization of additional ai/ml use cases such as demand forecasting, personalization, and intelligent process automation.  

* support ai governance, security, and responsible ai practices

o implement responsible ai controls, including guardrails, content filtering, and security measures, in alignment with enterprise architecture and ai center of excellence (coe) guidelines.  
o ensure compliance with data privacy, security standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.  
o contributes to the development and documentation of reusable ai patterns, frameworks, and reference architectures.  

* collaborate and communicate across teams

o partner with solution architects, data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into high-impact ai solutions.  
o provide technical input for estimation, planning, and delivery of project milestones.  
o participate in architecture reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of ai engineering standards and practices.  

* drive continuous learning and ai innovation

o stay current with emerging ai tools, frameworks, models, and industry trends, particularly within the retail domain.  
o promote knowledge sharing through technical demos, workshops, and documentation to strengthen ai capabilities across the organization.

### **competencies**

building effective teams

developing talent

collaboration

leading by example

communicates effectively

ensures accountability & execution

manages conflict

business acumen

plans, aligns & prioritizes

organizational agility

dealing with ambiguity

problem solving

drives results

### **qualifications & special skills required**

* minimum of 7 years of experience in software engineering, ai/ml development, or a related technical field.
* hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying ai/ml or intelligent automation solutions in production or near-production environments.
* demonstrated experience with microsoft azure ai services, including azure ai foundry, azure openai, and azure ai search.
* hands-on experience with microsoft copilot studio and/or the power platform (power automate, power apps) for low-code ai solution development.
* solid understanding of generative ai concepts, including retrieval-augmented generation (rag), prompt engineering, vector databases, and orchestration patterns.
* experience developing and integrating apis and rest services, along with familiarity with enterprise integration platforms such as mulesoft, azure api management, and microsoft graph connectors.
* strong proficiency in python, with demonstrated experience leveraging generative ai libraries and modules (ex - langchain, semantic kernel, openai/azure openai sdks), and vector database integrations to build and integrate llm-powered solutions.
* working knowledge of ai gateways, the model context protocol (mcp), and emerging standards for agent interoperability and tool orchestration.
* strong understanding of software development lifecycle (sdlc) methodologies, including agile/scrum practices.
* experience with ci/cd pipelines, version control systems (e.g., git), and modern devops practices.
* understanding of ai security, data privacy, responsible ai principles, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* understanding of ai finops concepts to be able to develop cost efficient ai solutions
* strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to navigate ambiguity and complex challenges.
* excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications:**

**join shure’s signal processing and applied research team and help explore the future of intelligent audio.**

as a **senior engineer in applied research science**, you’ll research and develop innovative ai/ml and advanced algorithmic solutions aimed at solving complex, real-world customer challenges.

you'll be working alongside software, signal processing, data, and test engineers, where you will investigate emerging technologies, develop and demonstrate new approaches, and help bridge the gap between research, experimentation, and product innovation. this is an opportunity for someone who enjoys tackling difficult technical problems and seeing ideas move from concept and prototype toward real-world application.

responsibilities:

* experience in audio classification and scaling audio classification frameworks for efficient development and maintenance
* experience using ai-assisted software development and research tools (e.g., github copilot, agentic ai systems, large language models, code generation and analysis tools) to improve engineering productivity and solution development.
* independently deploying, validating, and demonstrating early proof of concept machine learning

#### **3. cross-functional leadership & ai/ml support**

* **stakeholder alignment:** collaborate across it, manufacturing, finance, purchasing, and program management to capture technical requirements and align business goals.
* **ai/ml workflows:** support the integration of machine learning models and predictive analytics into existing engineering data pipelines.
* **executive communication:** translate complex data technicalities and process trade-offs into clear decision packages, business cases, and leadership presentations.

#### **basic requirements**

* **education:** bachelor of science degree in engineering from an accredited program.
* **big data ecosystems:** hands-on experience with **snowflake** or **databricks**.
* **programming languages:** proficiency in **sql**, **python**, and/or **pyspark**.
* **data modeling & bi tools:** proven expertise in data modeling and tools such as **power bi**, **sharepoint**, **powerapps**, **power automate**, **azure**, or **palantir foundry**.
* **cloud stack proficiency:** hands-on experience with modern cloud architectures, including microsoft fabric (lakehouse, directlake, dax, dataflows) and/or aws cloud services.
* **leadership & soft skills:** demonstrated leadership, self-starter mindset, organizational skills, and fluent english communication skills with the ability to present to all levels of management.

#### **preferred qualifications**

* **advanced degree:** master's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* **domain experience:** experience supporting core engineering processes (e.g., sourcing, quality, validation, manufacturing, logistics, program management).
* **ai/ml integration:** experience integrating predictive models or ai capabilities into production data pipelines.
* **business analysis:** proven ability in business process mapping, writing business requirements documents (brds), and technical process documentation.
* **big data frameworks:** familiarity with open-source frameworks like apache spark or hadoop.

crowdstrike is looking for a sr. software engineer - martech to join our fast-growing marketing it team. you will apply ai to transform how marketing and sales work, building llm-based agents and machine learning solutions across digital, revenue, partner, and event marketing. your focus will be turning high-impact initiatives, such as event invitations, prospecting, lead and contact data quality, site search, and partner experiences, into reliable, measurable, production-grade solutions.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**join atlas air worldwide. move the world with us!**

at atlas air worldwide, we're not just an airline, we're a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. as a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we're built on a foundation of **safety**, **service excellence**, **integrity**, **innovation**, **teamwork**, and **responsibility**. with over 30 years of history, a modern all-boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we're driven by purpose.

**if you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.**

**position summary:** atlas air is seeking a data engineer to join our data platform and engineering team. this is an early-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work.

as we continue to build our data environment on databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. you will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production-quality code that supports analytics, data science, ai/ml, and operational decision-making.

**major accountabilities:**

**data pipeline development**

* build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks.
* develop data transformations that convert source data into accurate, documented, and reusable datasets.
* implement data models and data products based on defined business requirements and technical designs.
* use databricks, spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members.
* participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and performance.

**data quality & operations**

* create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop.
* investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately.
* produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes.
* participate in the team's on-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support.
* follow established security, privacy, governance, and access control requirements.

**collaboration & growth**

* work with data analytics, data science, software engineering, it, security, and business partners to clarify requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
* break defined requirements into engineering tasks, communicate progress and risks, and deliver work within agreed timelines.
* contribute to team standards for source control, testing, ci/cd, documentation, and operational readiness.
* learn the atlas air business domain and use that understanding to improve the usefulness and reliability of data products.
* seek feedback, share knowledge, and progressively take ownership of larger components and less-defined problems.

**required qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.
* minimum 1 year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field.
* working proficiency in sql and at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., python, typescript, rust, java, c++, etc.).
* experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or data models in a professional, internship, academic, or substantial project setting.
* familiarity with core data engineering concepts, including etl/elt, relational data modeling, data quality testing, and pipeline orchestration.
* experience with git-based development practices and an understanding of code review, automated testing, and deployment workflows.
* ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.

**desired qualifications:**

* hands-on exposure to databricks, apache spark, or another distributed data-processing platform.
* experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework and an orchestration tool such as airflow, prefect, or dagster.
* familiarity with one major cloud platform and its data services: aws, azure, or gcp.
* exposure to streaming or event-driven technologies such as kafka, kinesis, spark structured streaming, or flink.
* familiarity with bi, data science, or machine learning workflows and the data products that support them.
* experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry.

at **atlas air worldwide**, we believe in the power of people, the promise of innovation, and the responsibility we hold to each other, to our customers, and to the planet. join us and be part of a team that lifts more than cargo; we lift ambition.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**ally and your career**  
ally financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. we love this stuff! we see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. from generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. we want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. you’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?
  
  
**work schedule** **:** ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. all work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

  

**the opportunity**

smartcash is ally financial's dealer money movement and wholesale settlement platform, responsible for processing approximately $500 million per day in ach transactions across ally's national auto dealer network. the platform serves a critical operational function and operates under strict daily processing windows with no tolerance for failure.
  
  
the platform is currently undergoing a full migration to aws. architecture design and proof of concept work has been completed across all major workstreams, and the team is moving into execution. the senior software engineer joining this team will contribute to a well-defined migration program while maintaining a production platform that runs seven days a week. the role carries technical depth across cloud infrastructure, java application development, database migration, and batch processing — supported by modern tooling including enterprise access to generative ai development tools.

**the work itself**

cloud migration:

migrate smartcash's application and data tiers to aws. this includes re-platforming spring batch jobs from openshift to aws batch on ecs fargate, migrating weblogic and jboss online applications to ecs fargate containers, moving the oracle 19c database to aurora postgresql, archiving to s3 glacier, and deploying the react spa to s3 with cloudfront distribution. infrastructure is managed via terraform through the ally pce gitlab pipeline.

  

database migration:

convert oracle pl/sql packages, procedures, and sequences to postgresql compatible equivalents. this work requires applied knowledge of both oracle and aurora postgresql behavior under financial transaction load.

  

batch processing:

maintain and extend the spring batch processing chain that runs nightly monday through friday, generating ach files, gl extracts, retail and wholesale feeds, and cba reports. own incident response within this chain and eventually re-platform these jobs to aws batch without interrupting production operations.

  

feature development:

contribute to high impact, innovative capabilities that advance the platform alongside migration work. smartcash is an active product — new features ship regularly and engineers are expected to contribute meaningfully to both the modernization effort and the ongoing business roadmap.

  

ai assisted development:

utilize generative ai tooling as a standard development instrument

  
  

**minimum qualifications**

  

* 3+ years of relevant experience
* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent
  

  

**the qualifications we’re looking for**
----------------------------------------

  

* 3+ years of experience preferred.
* java and backend development - 3+ or more years of production java development; java 17 or 21
* spring boot and spring batch, including job partitioning, restart ability, step chaining, and failure handling
* familiarity with java ee patterns — ejb, container managed transactions, jndi — and experience migrating away from legacy jee frameworks
* restful api design and experience operating behind an enterprise api gateway
* experience with micro service architecture
* production experience with ecs fargate, aws batch, eventbridge, step functions, secrets manager, and rds/aurora
* working knowledge of vpc networking, iam roles, and oidc based authentication; imds based identity patterns preferred over static credentials
* familiarity with ecr, s3, cloudfront
* terraform authorship in a multi-region environment, module based structure
* experience with a corporate ci/cd pipeline framework and state management conventions
* proficiency in oracle sql and pl/sql sufficient to read, analyze, and convert legacy packages
* working knowledge of aurora postgresql
* demonstrated experience using generative ai tools — such as claude, github copilot, or equivalent — as active development instruments, not supplementary aids
* ability to apply ai tooling to practical engineering tasks: legacy code analysis and refactoring, automated documentation, test generation, schema conversion, and code review

  

**how we'll have your back**  
ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. our total rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:
  
  
**time away:** program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).
  
  
**planning for the future:** plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401k retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.
  
  
**supporting your health & well-being:** flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax health savings account with employer contributions, healthcare fsa, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.
  
  
**building a family:** adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, dependent day care fsa back-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts.
  
  
**work-life integration:** other benefits including mentally fit employee assistance program, subsidized and discounted weight watchers® program and other employee discount programs.
  
  
**other compensations:** depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity.
  
  
to view more detailed information about ally’s total rewards, please visit this link: https://www.ally.com/content/dam/pdf/corporate/ally-total-rewards-snapshot.pdf

  

**who we are** **:**  
ally financial is a customer-centric, leading digital financial services company with passionate customer service and innovative financial solutions. we are relentlessly focused on "doing it right" and being a trusted financial-services provider to our consumer, commercial, and corporate customers. for more information, visit www.ally.com .
  
  
ally is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy status, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic disposition or any other reason protected by law.
  
  
in accordance with the americans with disabilities act, if after review of the position expectations, you believe that you may need a medical accommodation to fulfill the duties of this role, please email hrpolicy@ally.com with details of your accommodation request.

  

**base pay range**

$85,000.00 - $150,000.00

an individual's position in the range is determined by the specific role, the scope and responsibilities of the role, work experience, education, certification(s), training, and additional qualifications. we review internal pay, the competitive market, and business environment prior to extending an offer.

this position is eligible to participate in our annual incentive plan.

title: Software Engineer 1
description:

------------

this role is for engineers at the start of their careers who are eager to learn, grow, and make an immediate impact. it’s a general posting, so we’ll get to know your skills, interests, and career goals and align you with a team where you can do your best work. you’ll work on real problems alongside experienced engineers, designers, and cross-functional partners. you’ll get hands-on guidance, detailed feedback, and mentorship as you learn proven engineering practices and see your work launch. you’ll also build fluency with ai tools and learn to use them responsibly to work smarter.

we're cultivating a culture that prioritizes innovators, risk-takers, and imaginative thinkers. you’ll help create solutions that transform how millions of consumers and small businesses manage their finances in cloud, platform, mobile, and saas environments. working in a culture that embraces experimentation and rapid prototyping, you’ll collaborate closely with customers and cross-functional teams, turning ideas into real impact while building the skills to launch a rewarding career.

across all tech stacks:

* learn and apply proven practices for designing, building, testing, and supporting software.

* turn customer feedback into small, meaningful improvements, using methods like design for delight.
* collaborate with peers, designers, and engineers, and use code reviews, mentorship, and feedback to grow.

* **full stack:** work across frontend and backend, discuss application and api architecture, and contribute on agile/scrum teams using tools like git, jenkins, or travis.

* willingness to learn and adapt to new priorities, tools, and technologies in a fast-paced environment.

description:

description:

the data scientist, digital machine learning (ml), develops, deploys, and maintains ml models that support floor & decor's digital customer experience across flooranddecor.com, fnd apps, and omnichannel digital shopping tools. areas of responsibility include personalization and recommendations, product search and discovery, product data enrichment, and customer intent signals. working cross-functionally with ecommerce product, engineering & analytics, data engineering, merchandising, and digital marketing, this role advances models from development through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. the position adheres to the team's technical standards and partners closely with the senior data scientist, digital, to deliver measurable improvements in how customers find, evaluate, and select products.

**minimum qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative field (advanced degree a plus); relevant experience can be substituted for the required education on the basis of one calendar year of experience for one academic year of education.
* 3+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, including hands-on contribution to at least one model deployed into a production system, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company.
* experience building machine learning for live, customer-facing digital products such as search, recommendations, ranking, personalization, or ads, in e-commerce, marketplaces, media, or similar environments.
* strong proficiency in python and sql, writing clean, tested, production-ready code.
* solid foundation in machine learning, including classification, ranking, and recommendation approaches.
* familiarity with ml lifecycle practices, including automated training and scoring pipelines, deployment, and monitoring.
* experience designing and analyzing a/b tests and interpreting results for business partners.
* proficiency with ai-assisted development tools (e.g., claude code, github copilot, cursor) to accelerate exploration, modeling, and engineering.

**preferred:**

* databricks on azure, pyspark, and ci/cd for ml.
* experience extending, evaluating, or migrating commercial search or personalization platforms (e.g., bloomreach, constructor, algolia, dynamic yield, salesforce).
* experience with deep learning recommenders, embeddings, or llms applied to product, content, or customer data.
* experience with clickstream and customer behavioral data.
* ecommerce or omnichannel retail experience, ideally in high-consideration, project-based categories.

**competencies:**

* analytical problem-solving
* technical communication
* organization & adaptability
* collaboration across product teams

* integrity, humility & teamwork

**essential functions / key responsibilities:**

* build and maintain recommendation models across site and app, including similar products, "complete the project" recommendations (e.g., tile with the setting materials, tools, and underlayment the project requires), and continue-your-project experiences.
* develop session-based models that infer shopper intent (project type, style, diy vs. pro, stage in the purchase journey) for anonymous and infrequent visitors.
* rank content, offers, and modules across the home page, category and product pages, and app.
* contribute to product search improvements, including query classification, synonyms, and relevance evaluation.
* apply llms and embeddings to enrich product attributes that improve search, filtering, and recommendations, with quality checks on technical specifications, and support evaluation of llm-powered features by building evaluation sets and reviewing output quality.
* produce digital propensity and intent scores (e.g., sample-to-purchase conversion, pro identification) for the site, app, and marketing systems, leveraging enterprise customer segments from customer analytics & insights rather than building parallel segmentation.
* contribute to shared ml assets that carry across ecommerce platform and vendor changes, and support vendor evaluations with analysis on floor & decor data.
* bring personalization, search, and recommendations to floor & decor's upcoming pro app, using pro purchase history, project patterns, and loyalty data to drive app adoption, engagement, and share of wallet with pro customers.
* deploy and operate models on databricks following team standards; monitor performance, data quality, and drift, and retrain as needed.
* partner with data engineering, product, and engineering on the data and event tracking needed to train and measure models.
* design and analyze a/b tests for model-driven features and measure incremental impact on conversion, average order value, and engagement. standard digital performance reporting is owned by ecommerce analytics.
* communicate results, tradeoffs, and recommendations to product teams and business stakeholders in a clear, actionable way.
* maintain clear documentation of methodologies, model assumptions, and limitations, and participate in code and design reviews.
* stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in personalization, search, recommender systems, and applied data science.
* be compliant with all appropriate privacy preferences, responsible ai, and security protocols, including customer consent and preference requirements for personalization.

the role is based in the store support center in atlanta, ga. work is primarily sedentary, involving extended periods of sitting at a computer, with occasional walking or standing. the work environment is typically quiet to moderate.

sedentary work – ability to exert up to 10–20 lbs. occasionally and negligible force frequently to lift, carry, push, or pull objects.
