title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Healthcare Platform - Remote
description:
**role summary**
----------------

we are seeking a senior ai engineer to help build and operate a production-grade healthcare genai platform for patient-facing and enterprise conversational experiences. this role will focus on backend ai services, agentic workflows, mcp tool servers, secure clinical data integrations, and ai platform tooling.

the ideal candidate is a strong python/backend engineer with hands-on genai experience who can build reliable agent systems using **google adk**, llm tool calling, structured outputs, rag, guardrails, and healthcare-safe integration patterns. this is not a prompt-only role; it requires production engineering judgment across security, observability, testing, deployment, phi protection, and operational ownership.

**primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* design, implement, and maintain backend ai services using **python 3.12+**, async service patterns, and frameworks such as **fastapi**, **google adk**, and **fastmcp**.
* develop and operate agentic genai workflows using **google adk 2.x** as a primary orchestration framework.
* build mcp tool servers and domain-specific tools for healthcare workflows such as care tasks, medications, scheduling, patient profile lookup, clinical record retrieval, and ehr/fhir-backed experiences.
* integrate llm providers and genai toolkits including **google gemini/vertex ai**, openai, anthropic, and related orchestration frameworks where appropriate.
* implement prompt engineering, rag, structured output validation, tool selection patterns, memory strategies, and ai guardrails to support safe and reliable model behavior.
* design secure clinical integration boundaries for fhir, ehr, user profile, scheduling, and other healthcare systems.
* protect phi and sensitive credentials through secure jwt/oauth flows, delegated authorization, token forwarding, encryption, redaction, and audit-safe logging.
* leverage cloud services such as **azure app configuration, key vault, cosmos db, event hubs, application insights**, and google cloud services such as **vertex ai/gemini and cloud run**.
* build observability, telemetry, evaluation, and impact-reporting capabilities for ai systems and ai-assisted engineering workflows.
* author and maintain automated tests using **pytest** and support linting, type-checking, ci/cd, and containerized deployments.
* collaborate with product, architecture, security, clinical, platform, devops, and application teams to deliver safe ai capabilities through well-defined http/mcp contracts.
* participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, production support, operational readiness, and incident response.

  
**benefits**  
  
our competitive benefits package includes the following  

* immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits
* 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%
* tuition reimbursement
* pto accrual beginning day 1

note: benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 7+ years of professional software development experience.
* strong production experience with **python**, asynchronous programming, backend apis, and service-oriented architecture.
* hands-on experience building genai applications with **google adk 2.x** or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
* demonstrated understanding of llm tool calling, multi-agent workflows, structured outputs, rag, prompt engineering, and ai safety/guardrail patterns.
* experience integrating with llm providers such as **google gemini/vertex ai**, openai, anthropic, or equivalent platforms.
* experience with **fastapi**, **pytest**, docker, ci/cd workflows, and containerized production deployments.
* strong understanding of api security, **jwt/oauth**, delegated authorization, secrets management, and secure service-to-service communication.
* ability to design safe integration patterns for healthcare data, clinical systems, or other sensitive regulated environments.
* experience with cloud-native services in azure and/or google cloud.
* strong debugging, testing, and operational problem-solving skills.
* ability to work with high ownership in a small, fast-moving engineering team.
* strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, security, product, and clinical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* healthcare domain experience, especially with **hipaa**, **hl7/fhir**, epic integrations, patient portals, scheduling, medication, claims, or clinical workflow systems.
* experience with **mcp**, **fastmcp v3**, model-tool integration, or agent tool-server architecture.
* experience with langgraph, langchain, pydanticai, semantic kernel, or other orchestration and structured-output frameworks.
* familiarity with **opentelemetry**, application insights, kusto, ai evaluation pipelines, or production observability tooling.
* experience building ai platform tooling, internal developer enablement tools, ai governance automation, code review automation, or ai impact reporting.
* experience with **uv**, ruff, pyright, python packaging, dependency isolation, and multi-container service deployment.
* exposure to react and typescript for occasional full-stack collaboration, while remaining primarily backend/platform focused.

**ai-augmented development expectations**
-----------------------------------------

this role requires disciplined use of ai tools as part of daily engineering work. the engineer should be able to use ai coding agents and genai systems to accelerate implementation, research, validation, and documentation while remaining fully accountable for correctness and safety.

the successful candidate will know how to:

* give ai agents clear, scoped engineering tasks.
* require agents to inspect existing code, contracts, tests, and architecture before proposing changes.
* validate ai-generated code with tests, type checks, linting, runtime review, and security judgment.
* identify when generated code is unsafe, incorrect, over-engineered, noncompliant, or inconsistent with platform boundaries.
* use ai tools to improve delivery speed without compromising phi protection, reliability, auditability, maintainability, or user trust.
* contribute to ai governance patterns, reusable agent instructions, tool ergonomics, and platform standards.

**ideal candidate profile**
---------------------------

the ideal candidate is a senior backend/platform engineer with practical genai experience and strong healthcare-grade judgment. they can design agent workflows, but they also understand authentication, deployment, observability, testing, failure modes, phi handling, and operational ownership.

they are pragmatic, security-minded, collaborative, and comfortable building early platform foundations that will later support production patient-facing ai experiences.

title: AI Engineer III
description:
**our deloitte human capital team transforms technology platforms, drives innovation, and helps make a significant impact on our clients' success. we are hiring an ai engineer to build and operate the data, features, and genai foundations that power human capital ai products and analytics. you will work with an ai data engineer (data ingestion, curation, governance, platform foundations) and a lead ai solutions architect (end-to-end solution architecture, integration patterns, non-functional requirements), partnering closely with product, data science/ml, security, and platform engineering to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable ai solutions.**  
  
**this role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will ship production pipelines and services that support model training, real-time inference, and llm applications using claude-, gpt/codex-, and gemini-class models, and more implemented with strong governance, observability, and cost/performance discipline.**  
  
**recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.**  
  
**work you'll do**  
  
**as an ai engineer iii on the hc forward team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and running the trusted, governed data, feature, and retrieval layer used by ai/ml and genai solutions. you will deliver reproducible datasets and features, operationalize quality and lineage, and enable secure consumption patterns for both predictive ml and llm-based experiences.**  

* **partner with the lead ai solutions architect and ai data engineer to translate human capital product needs into secure, scalable technical designs and delivered solutions (apis, services, pipelines, containers/serverless) meeting availability, performance, and security expectations.**
* **build and operationalize llm-enabled capabilities (e.g., copilots, hr knowledge assistants, summarization, policy q&a) using claude/gpt(codex)/gemini, including secure endpoints, tool/function calling, and reusable prompt/context patterns.**
* **implement llm application patterns including rag, document ingestion/chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and retrieval/evaluation telemetry.**
* **deliver governed datasets and feature engineering/serving for ml training and real-time inference (online/offline consistency, caching, latency slos, backfills).**
* **implement safety, privacy, and access controls (pii handling, prompt-injection defenses, content filtering, policy-based access) with security and risk stakeholders.**
* **establish data/model reliability and cost-performance discipline (data quality, schema evolution, lineage/metadata, monitoring; right-sizing, query tuning, llm token/cost telemetry), and contribute to mlops/llmops and production operations (versioning, reproducibility, ci/cd, automated testing, observability, incident response); support design reviews, deployment readiness, and runbooks.**

  
**a successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **ability to meet deadlines**
* **ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**the team**  
  
**hc forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of human capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply ai, data, and engineering to modernize hr experiences and outcomes.**  
  
**qualifications**  
  
**required:**  

* **bachelor's degree in a stem field (e.g., computer science, engineering, statistics, data science)**
* **4+ years building and delivering large language model (llm) and generative artificial intelligence (genai) solutions with claude/gpt(codex)/gemini-class models, including prompt/context design, tool/function calling, evaluation, and production integration**
* **4+ years implementing retrieval-augmented generation (rag)/retrieval, including document processing, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and enterprise governance controls**
* **4+ years of modern data and ai engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, feature engineering/serving fundamentals, and production real-time inference services, including application programming interface (api) design, latency/performance, and reliability patterns**
* **4+ years leading platform/integration engineering across enterprise systems, including api/integration experience with representational state transfer (rest), graphql, event-driven architecture, microservices, and middleware**
* **4+ years of development and operations (devops) or development, security, and operations (devsecops) experience, including ci/cd, infrastructure as code (iac) such as terraform/cloudformation, docker/kubernetes, and observability/monitoring**
* **4+ years leading security/compliance efforts, including experience with enterprise security controls such as identity and access management (iam), encryption, secrets, and audit logging; and data/privacy controls such as pii, retention, and access controls**
* **ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.**
* **limited immigration sponsorship may be available.**

  
**preferred:**  

* **master of science (ms) or doctor of philosophy (phd) degree and/or cloud and ai/ml certifications**
* **4+ years of experience with human capital platforms and integrations, including workday, sap successfactors, oracle hcm, or salesforce, and hr data domains**
* **4+ years of experience operationalizing llmops/mlops capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management; and 4+ years of cloud experience on one or more of amazon web services (aws), microsoft azure, or google cloud platform (gcp), including managed data platforms and scalable compute patterns**
* **4+ years of experience using structured problem solving to translate business needs into requirements, acceptance criteria, and shippable increments; and 4+ years of experience explaining ai/genai trade-offs involving quality, latency, cost, and risk to stakeholders and documenting decisions**
* **4+ years of experience collaborating across product, data science/ml, data engineering, platform, and security; and 4+ years of experience performing threat testing, monitoring, and operational-readiness activities**
* **4+ years of experience identifying consent, pii, and bias boundaries and escalating appropriately; experience supporting soc 2, general data protection regulation (gdpr), or health insurance portability and accountability act (hipaa) requirements**

  
**the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,000 to $240,500.**  
  
**you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.**

title: API Integration & Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**what you’ll do:**  
design, build, secure, and operate enterprise integrations that connect applications, data, and ai agents. develop rest, soap, and event-driven integrations using mulesoft anypoint platform as the preferred integration platform, along with microsoft azure integration services. connect ai agents to enterprise apis, data, and workflows using standards such as model context protocol (mcp) and agent2agent (a2a).
  
  
**who we are:**  
at aaa washington, we equip our members with trusted service and expertise to confidently travel through life. we provide our members with best-in-class roadside assistance, discounts and rewards, travel services and insurance. for over 120 years, we’ve served our members, not shareholders, so our growth supports innovation for the club today and for the future. seeking to reflect the communities we serve and create an inclusive culture, we encourage employees to bring their full self to work and support applicants from all backgrounds, abilities and walks of life to apply.

you’ll play an important role in bringing aaa washington’s spirit of service and peace of mind to our membership. consistently ranked as one of the best places to work by puget sound business journal, we aim for work-life balance across the organization. we support hybrid and remote work options for many positions based in our corporate office (bellevue, washington) along with some of the best benefits in the region!
  
  
**essential duties/responsibilities:**  

* design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain rest, soap, and event-driven apis and integrations.
* build integration solutions using mulesoft anypoint platform, azure api management, and azure functions.
* apply api-led connectivity patterns, including system, process, and experience apis.
* implement api security using oauth 2.0, mtls, jwt, tls, rate limiting, and security policies.
* build event-driven integrations using azure service bus and azure event hubs.
* connect ai agents to enterprise apis, data services, and business workflows.
* implement mcp for agent-to-tool integration and a2a for agent-to-agent communication.
* develop integration and agent components using python, java, or c#.
* deploy applications and infrastructure using bicep or equivalent infrastructure as code (iac).
* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines using azure devops or github actions.
* implement automated testing, monitoring, logging, and production observability.
* monitor and support production services using application insights, azure monitor, and splunk.
* troubleshoot production issues and participate in the on-call rotation.
* maintain api specifications, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* other duties as assigned.

**supervisory responsibilities:**  

* none

**minimum qualifications:**  

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business, or equivalent experience.
* experience in api development, integration engineering, or software development.
* experience with mulesoft anypoint platform and/or microsoft azure integration services.
* experience designing and developing rest, soap, and event-driven integrations.
* experience with oauth 2.0, jwt, tls/mtls, and api security.
* experience with azure functions, azure service bus, and azure event hubs.
* proficiency in python, java, or c#.
* experience with infrastructure as code and ci/cd practices.
* experience supporting applications and integrations in production.

**preferred qualifications:**  

* experience with salesforce agentforce, microsoft copilot studio, langchain, microsoft autogen.
* knowledge of model context protocol (mcp) and agent2agent (a2a).
* experience with dataweave, raml, or openapi specification (oas).
* experience with application insights, azure monitor, and splunk.
* experience integrating salesforce, azure, saas, and on-premises systems.

**certificates, licenses, registrations:**  

* mulesoft certified developer – level 1 (mcd) preferred.
* microsoft certified: azure developer associate (az-204) preferred.
* additional mulesoft or microsoft azure certifications are a plus.

**knowledge, skills, abilities:**  

* strong knowledge of api design, integration patterns, and api-led connectivity.
* knowledge of rest, soap, http, messaging, and event-driven architectures.
* knowledge of api security, including oauth 2.0, jwt, tls/mtls, and access controls.
* knowledge of mulesoft and azure integration technologies.
* understanding of agentic ai integration concepts and interoperability standards.
* ability to write production-quality code in python, java, or c#.
* ability to automate deployments using iac and ci/cd pipelines.
* ability to monitor, troubleshoot, and support production integrations.
* strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* strong written and verbal communication skills.
* ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, architecture, security, and business teams

**salary:**  

* hiring range: $120,666 - $144,840
* discretionary bonus based on company performance

**benefits we offer:**  

* health insurance (medical, vision, dental and prescription drug)
* up to 22 days of paid time off (pto) in the first year
* eleven paid holidays in addition to pto
* 401(k) with employer match
* life, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance
* flexible spending accounts
* 4 hours of volunteer time off per year
* on-demand pay / earned wage access
* free premier rv aaa washington membership
* travel, insurance, and membership discounts and perks
* paid, on-going training throughout your career
* thrive wellness program
* tax-advantaged commuter benefit
* free parking
* financial literacy education

**work environment & physical demands:**  

* hybrid work from home and office required
* the physical environment is typical of a standard office space. it requires the employee to work inside for the duration of work. must be able to remain in a stationary position, sitting for more than 50% of the time. this position will require occasionally moving about inside the office to access equipment, cabinets, etc. may work around office equipment which could be noisy, such as copiers and fax machines.

**other:**  

* equipment used: computer, phone, various virtual technologies, other office equipment
* travel: rarely travel

to perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. the requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

position/job characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

description:

the business applications & ai engineer works closely with business stakeholders, operational leadership, and technical teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, automate manual tasks, improve data quality, and deliver scalable business solutions. this role is responsible for gathering requirements, documenting business processes, developing technical solutions, managing application enhancements, and ensuring solutions align with organizational goals and governance standards.

* develop and maintain operational and executive reporting solutions using microsoft power bi, including data preparation, semantic models, dashboards, reports, visualizations, and appropriate data-access controls.
* create and maintain application documentation, training materials, governance standards, support documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for workflow optimization, automation, system consolidation, and data standardization.
* establish and maintain application governance standards, security models, change control processes, development standards, testing procedures, and lifecycle management practices for business applications.

the solutions architecture team sits within marvell's platform organization, which turns advanced silicon into deployable, customer-ready ai and cloud infrastructure. this team — the ai solutions lab — owns the validation layer that proves our platforms perform as promised, across compute, networking, and memory fabrics. without it, marvell could design great silicon but could never prove, at rack scale, that it performs the way customers expect — and hyperscalers don't buy chips on paper, they buy validated systems.  
  
day to day, the team runs ai benchmarking experiments that mirror real customer workloads, operates gpu/hpc lab clusters, validates marvell's teralynx switching and ai fabrics under production-like conditions, and builds live demos for trade shows — carrying platform programs from concept to production.  
  
what sets this team apart is breadth of ownership: engineers here aren't limited to validating a single switch chip — they work across the full breadth of marvell's ai platform portfolio, from teralynx network fabrics to integrated optical platforms like co-packaged optics (cpo) and near-packaged optics (npo), as well as emerging memory fabric products such as cxl and photonic fabric memory appliances. this cross-domain ownership — networking, optics, and memory, together — is work that's often siloed across separate teams elsewhere, and the results feed directly into customer proof points and executive reviews.

**what you can expect**

the nre/sre engineer owns the compute and software foundation of the ai solutions lab. this role is responsible for building, standardizing, and operating the environments required to validate marvell solutions across customer-relevant workloads, including scale-up, scale-out, memory acceleration, and dpu-enabled use cases.

**key responsibilities**

* own compute provisioning, cluster bring-up, os images, rocm and nic driver stacks, and environment standardization for lab systems.
* build and maintain mlperf-style harnesses, workload libraries, test plans, result pipelines, and dashboards to support repeatable validation.
* establish baseline observability for cluster health, job execution, failures, utilization, and regression tracking.
* deploy and manage workload scheduling and orchestration (kubernetes and/or slurm) as the primary means of running validation and benchmark jobs across the lab.
* own incident response for lab infrastructure, driving root-cause analysis and reliability improvements after cluster or job failures.
* partner with architects, network engineers, and performance engineers to ensure lab environments accurately reflect target customer deployments.
* improve repeatability and operational efficiency through automation, infrastructure, code, and standardized workflows.
* support cross-functional validation efforts and help convert lab output into reusable internal and external assets.

**what we're looking for**

**education and certifications**

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field; a phd is a plus.
* linux certifications, cka certification, or similar kubernetes certifications are preferred.

**required qualifications**

* ms in electrical/computer engineering, computer science, or related field; 6+ years of experience as a software/systems engineer, with at least 4+ years of linux/infrastructure experience.
* strong linux systems experience at scale, including solid data center and cluster operations fundamentals; development experience across both windows and linux environments.
* proficient in python/tcl scripting and automation, with familiarity in c/c++ api development; proficiency in python specifically for metrics, observability, and pipeline automation.
* experience with automation tools such as ansible and terraform.
* experience building and maintaining test harnesses, workload libraries, test plans, result pipelines, and dashboards to support repeatable validation.
* experience establishing baseline observability for cluster/system health, job execution, failures, utilization, and regression tracking.
* hands-on experience with workload scheduling and orchestration (kubernetes and/or slurm) in a lab or production environment.
* excellent understanding of sw development flows, methodology, and production sw test policies and practices.
* excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills; customer-facing experience required.
* ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced lab environment

**preferred qualifications**

* experience operating ai or hpc clusters in a lab or production environment.
* working familiarity with a distributed training framework (pytorch ddp/fsdp, nemo, or similar) sufficient to interpret job failures, not just infrastructure symptoms.
* working knowledge of at least one distributed-storage or parallel filesystem technology (e.g., lustre, gpfs, beegfs, ceph), since cluster performance is frequently storage-bound.
* basic experience with model tuning and workload optimization.

131,010 - 196,300, $ per annum

the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. the expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

this role is eligible to participate in marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. we look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

these tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. use of ai tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Cyber Security Cloud Engineer
description:
company overview

ncs is a leading industrial products, services and technology company whose primary end-market is car wash operators. ncs provides a full suite of manufactured equipment, installation project services, aftermarket parts and services, chemicals (detergents, protectants, etc.), and software. more specifically with equipment, ncs provides tunnel equipment, iba (in bay automatic), vacuums, dryers, water systems, doors, signage, arches, and related components. ncs also sells a range of brands – on both equipment, chemicals and software today – including armor all, rain-x, blue coral, tss, vacutech, ncs, amp, etc. the company sells primarily in n. america, operates 6 manufacturing plants across n. america, and has ~1600+ employees. the company operates numerous distribution centers and has sales/hq offices across n. america, with its primary corporate offices in des moines, iowa and dallas, tx. ncs is currently owned by berkshire partners, a leading boston-based pe firm

**we are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the united states. however, we are not currently able to sponsor work visas.**

**position summary**

the cyber security cloud engineer is the hands-on engineer responsible for implementing, operating, and maturing security controls across ncs's cloud environment, including microsoft azure, amazon web services, and the enterprise saas platforms that run the business. ncs operates within an established set of nist-based enterprise security requirements that define the controls, reporting cadences, and audit expectations for the business. this role implements the security controls that protect our cloud, saas, identity, workload, and data environments, and serves as the security lead for integrating newly acquired companies into the ncs security framework. as ncs invests in ai to transform how we serve customers and run the business, this engineer ensures those initiatives are deployed with the required safeguards in place. the engineer also partners with product engineering and devops teams to put required security controls into practice across the software development lifecycle for ncs products, connected equipment, and customer-facing platforms. the role works closely with infrastructure, networking, data, application development, and business stakeholders, and provides security leadership with clear visibility into control status, gaps, and remediation progress. success in this role means delivering required controls on schedule, demonstrating their effectiveness, and reducing enterprise risk without slowing the business.

**key responsibilities**

**cloud security implementation & operations**

* implement and maintain security controls across azure and aws in accordance with ncs security requirements and the enterprise security framework, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection.

* deploy and operate cloud security posture management (cspm/cnapp), infrastructure-as-code guardrails, policy-as-code, and automated compliance checks that enforce required baselines and provide continuous evidence of control effectiveness.

* operate and tune cloud-native security services (e.g., microsoft defender for cloud, microsoft sentinel, entra id protection, aws guardduty, security hub, cloudtrail, iam access analyzer) and integrate cloud telemetry into enterprise siem detection and response workflows.

* execute detection engineering and incident response for cloud-hosted and identity-centric threats, including alert triage, investigation, root cause analysis, containment, and remediation coordination with managed security providers, following established playbooks and escalation paths; track emerging cloud attack techniques and recommend updates to detections, hardening, and response procedures.

**acquisition integration & migration**

* support cybersecurity due diligence for acquisitions by executing technical assessments of target environments and documenting gaps against ncs security requirements to inform prioritized integration plans.

* execute the secure integration and migration of acquired companies onto ncs platforms, including identity consolidation into microsoft entra id, tenant-to-tenant microsoft 365 migrations, workload migrations to azure and aws, network and endpoint onboarding, and decommissioning of legacy infrastructure.

* maintain and follow repeatable, documented integration playbooks and security baselines that bring acquired entities to the required security standard within defined integration timelines, with status reporting throughout.

**devops & product security**

* implement and operate required security controls across the ci/cd pipeline in partnership with product engineering and devops teams, including static and dynamic application security testing (sast/dast), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container image scanning, and software bill of materials (sbom) generation, with risk-based gates that protect release velocity.

* support secure product development for ncs software, connected equipment, and customer-facing platforms through threat modeling, secure design reviews, application of secure coding standards, api security, and vulnerability management, with particular attention to payment-enabled and field-deployed systems.

* track product security metrics, maintain developer-facing documentation, and uphold remediation slas that give engineering teams clear, actionable ownership of security findings.

**compliance, reporting & leadership**

* implement the data protection, dlp, identity governance, and access controls required to securely enable approved ai initiatives, including microsoft 365 copilot, azure openai, aws bedrock, and enterprise ai tooling, in partnership with data, it, and business teams.

* maintain security controls across microsoft 365, identity, endpoint (windows and apple), and cloud platforms in line with ncs security requirements; produce the evidence, metrics, and documentation needed for pci-dss compliance, nist csf alignment, internal and external audits, executive security reviews, and customer security assessments.

* mentor engineers, serve as the escalation point for complex cloud and identity security issues, and report clearly on control status, gaps, risk, and remediation progress to technical and executive audiences.

**required qualifications**

* 5 or more years of progressive experience in it, with broad exposure to infrastructure, networking, identity, and enterprise systems.

* 3 or more years of hands-on experience in a dedicated cybersecurity role, including securing production workloads in microsoft azure and/or aws.

* demonstrated experience implementing security controls within an established enterprise security framework, including translating defined control requirements, audit findings, and assessment results into deployed, documented, and measurable controls.

* hands-on implementation experience with cloud security services and patterns on at least one major platform (azure or aws) and solid familiarity with the other, including iam, network security, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection.

* experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., terraform, bicep, cloudformation), ci/cd platforms (e.g., azure devops, github, gitlab), and application security tooling (sast/dast, sca, secrets and container scanning), with a track record of partnering with development teams to embed security into the sdlc.

* working knowledge of the nist cybersecurity framework and experience supporting pci-dss compliance and audit or assessment processes, including evidence collection and remediation tracking.

* clear, professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to report control status, gaps, and remediation progress to technical and non-technical audiences.

**preferred qualifications**

* one or more current, industry-recognized security certifications such as cissp, ccsp, aws certified security – specialty, or microsoft certified: azure security engineer associate (az-500); equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.

* direct experience executing security workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures, including tenant-to-tenant migrations and identity consolidation.

* experience securing ai/ml platforms and services (azure openai, aws bedrock, microsoft 365 copilot, enterprise data platforms) and familiarity with the nist ai rmf, owasp top 10 for llm applications, or similar frameworks.

* experience with cspm/cnapp platforms, container and kubernetes security, and secrets management.

* experience implementing or maturing a product or application security program, including familiarity with owasp asvs and samm, nist ssdf, or similar secure development frameworks, and tooling such as github advanced security or equivalent integrated devsecops platforms.

* experience securing embedded, iot, or payment-enabled products, including pci-dss considerations for software and device design.

* scripting and automation proficiency (powershell, python, etc.) for detection engineering and security tooling.

* experience in manufacturing, distribution, or field service environments, including connected equipment and payment systems.

**core competencies & leadership expectations**

* takes ownership of assigned controls and initiatives and follows through to measurable, documented completion.

* executes with discipline against established standards while exercising sound judgment on how to implement them with minimal business friction.

* demonstrates calm, decisive leadership during incidents and high-pressure situations.

* provides clear, pragmatic implementation guidance to peers and leadership on cloud, product, and ai risk.

**physical requirements & work environment**

* primarily office-based or remote-office work using a computer and standard office equipment for extended periods.

* ability to communicate effectively through phone, video, and in-person meetings.

* periodic participation in after-hours incident response or maintenance windows.

* occasional travel to ncs facilities and acquired-company locations to support integration activities.

overview:

securing the home for all developers starts with securing github itself. as a senior software engineer on the vulnerability management engineering team, you’ll build and run the systems that find vulnerabilities across github’s services and infrastructure, get each one to the team that owns it, and control how our code, packages, and container images are sourced and built. it’s backend and distributed systems work where the users are other engineers, and you’ll build deep expertise in vulnerability management and software supply chain security along the way.

* design and roll out software supply chain controls, such as authenticated package and container proxies that enforce policy, across github actions, docker builds, and dependabot, in a way teams can adopt without slowing down.

* build systems that meet compliance requirements such as fedramp, and evolve production services without breaking the apis other teams rely on.

**required qualifications**

  + or associate’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, math, physics, computer engineering, computer science, or related field and 5+ years experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, c, c++, c#, java, javascript, go, ruby, rust, or python

  + or doctorate in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, math, physics, computer engineering, computer science, or related field.

these pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the united states. an individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. at github certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. these rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. in addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

title: Product Support Solutions Developer
description:
with 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, recorded future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

the **product support solutions developer** designs, builds, and maintains the technical infrastructure, tools, and automated workflows that power the customer support function. combining technical development expertise with support operations and enablement, this role is responsible for architecting scalable internal tooling, engineering custom integrations, and leveraging ai agents/automations to drive operational efficiency, reduce resolution times, and elevate customer satisfaction.

### **what you'll do:**

#### **1. custom tooling & integration development**

* design, build, and maintain custom applications, scripts, and webhook integrations across core support systems (e.g., zendesk, jira, salesforce service cloud, domo, statuspage).
* architect and optimize api connections, custom middleware, and automated workflows to streamline ticket routing, data syncs, and escalations.
* build custom ui components, apps, and macros within support platforms to enhance agent efficiency and desktop experience.
* determines methods and procedures for new or undefined assignments, considering company objectives—not only functional needs—to shape solutions

#### **2. ai agent & automation implementation**

* lead the evaluation, development, and deployment of ai agents, llm-powered assistants, and chatbots to automate tier-1 support interactions and internal agent assistance.
* fine-tune ai agent prompt workflows, knowledge ingestion pipelines, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) models to improve self-service resolution rates.
* monitor and continuously optimize ai agent performance, accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.

#### **3. support operations & tool management**

* administer, configure, and optimize support systems, maintaining slas, routing rules, triggers, and automated workflows.
* conduct regular quality, tag, and compliance audits across systems to ensure high data integrity and adherence to support processes.
* assist platform operations and support leadership with outage communication tooling, incident escalation paths, and client updates.

#### **4. data engineering, analytics & reporting**

* build and maintain complex analytics dashboards and data pipelines (e.g., zendesk explore, domo, sql) to track kpis like ticket volume, mttr, csat, and backlog trends.
* partner with product analytics to build unified data reporting layers across disparate platforms.
* perform root-cause analysis on platform trends and negative csat ratings to identify automation opportunities and systemic fixes.

#### **5. technical enablement & process improvement**

* collaborate with support leadership to design and deliver technical onboarding and enablement programs for support staff.
* digest complex product handoffs from product and engineering teams, translating them into technical documentation, live training modules, and internal knowledge base resources.
* partner with documentation and training teams to create client-facing self-service e-learnings and articles that reduce inbound ticket volume.
* continuously audit support workflows to identify operational bottlenecks, create documented procedures to improve them, and develop automated solutions as necessary to eliminate them.
* maintains key relationships outside their area of expertise to bolster unified process improvement where necessary

### **what you'll bring:**

#### **required:**

* **experience:** 3+ years of experience in product support engineering, support operations, technical support, or developer relations.
* **development & scripting:** hands-on programming experience (e.g., python, javascript/node.js, rest apis, webhooks, json) to build custom tooling and integrations.
* **platform expertise:** deep administrator/developer experience with customer support ecosystems (e.g., zendesk api/apps framework, jira service management, salesforce, freshdesk).
* **data & analytics:** strong sql skills and experience building dashboards in bi tools (e.g., domo, tableau, looker) or native reporting engines (zendesk explore).
* **operations & enablement:** proven ability to document sops, lead technical training, and optimize operational support workflows.
* **communication:** strong cross-functional collaboration skills to liaise effectively between engineering, product, and support teams.

#### **preferred:**

* **ai & automation experience:** hands-on experience developing or implementing ai agents, llm apis (e.g., openai, anthropic), conversational ai frameworks, or agentic frameworks (e.g., langchain, autogen).
* **knowledge management for ai:** experience with vector databases, prompt engineering, or managing knowledge bases optimized for ai search/rag architectures.
* **best practices:** familiarity with itil framework, agile methodology, or devops deployment practices.

title: Cloud Developer
description:
**position summary:**  
the cloud developer performs critical infrastructure and development functions for vanderbilt’s
  
growing initiatives in digital scholarship, cloud-based research computing, and generative ai
  
(genai) deployment. working closely with technologists across the heard libraries and other
  
campus units, the cloud developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the
  
scalable cloud infrastructure required to make research data scalable and accessible. given the
  
agile, collaborative nature of the work unit, this role demands a blend of deep technical
  
execution, nimble project management, and mentorship capabilities. the cloud developer will
  
serve as a "principal engineer" within our experiential learning programs, helping to manage
  
student developers, architect "fail-fast" innovations, and scale computational solutions for wide
  
impact.

**about the work unit:**  
the jean and alexander heard libraries at vanderbilt university comprise nine libraries and
  
multiple specialized service departments. the libraries are fundamental to the university’s goal
  
of advancing scholarship and learning by collecting, preserving, and making accessible a wide
  
variety of resources,and partnering with faculty and students to shape research. the digital lab
  
advances the creation, development, and sustainability of faculty and student-driven digital
  
projects. as an applied research and learning center, the lab transforms unstructured library
  
collections into machine-readable computational assets and builds cutting-edge software
  
solutions leveraging generative ai. the aws-sponsored vanderbilt cloud innovation lab
  
(vcil), which provides immersive, hands-on software development experiences for student
  
fellows, is a core focus of this work. by embedding students directly into professional
  
engineering workflows as junior developers, the digital lab bridges advanced faculty research, technical mentorship, and scalable cloud infrastructure to broaden computational innovation across campus.

**key functions and expected performance:**

cloud architecture & software development
  
design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily aws) to
  
host digital scholarship platforms and process massive library archives.

implement and scale generative ai pipelines and machine-learning models to automate metadata enrichment and text extraction.
  
ensure faculty and institutional projects are built on modern, sustainable, and well-documented technical stacks that integrate efficiently with broader university infrastructure.

**position description**  
project management & operational delivery
  
manage the full lifecycle of assigned digital projects, tracking timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation across partner units.
  
serve as an agile project manager for select faculty-driven r&d initiatives, ensuring transparent communication and consistent progress.
  
coordinate technical requirements and scope with key campus partners, including research it, the advanced computing center for research & education (accre), and the data science institute.

student mentorship & team leadership
  
recruit, interview, and hire undergraduate and graduate student fellows and research assistants.
  
act as a "principal engineer" by embedding students into professional software development workflows, conducting code reviews, and providing technical mentorship.
  
guide student teams through real-world deployment challenges, balancing structured learning with hands-on software delivery.

sustained innovation & grant support
  
in coordination with digital lab leadership, write staff technical expertise and infrastructure costs into external grant applications.
  
explore and implement "fail-fast" innovations using emerging technologies to maintain
  
the lab's best-in-class standing in genai and research computing.

**education and certifications**  
undergraduate degree in computer science, cloud computing, data science, or a related
  
technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience and industry certifications is
  
required. postgraduate degree preferred.

aws certified solutions architect, sysops administrator, or developer certification is
  
highly preferred.

**experience and skills:**  
two to four years of relevant experience is necessary.
  
technical skills & experience
  
cloud infrastructure: proven experience provisioning and managing cloud
  
environments, preferably aws (including ec2, s3, lambda, and iam infrastructure), is required.
  
development & frameworks: proficiency in programming languages common to data
  
processing and cloud back-ends (e.g., python, node.js) is required. experience with
  
modern web frameworks and frontend development is preferred.
  
ai & data pipelines: familiarity with deploying generative ai models, vector databases,
  
or orchestration frameworks, as well as handling distributed data storage is required.
  
tooling: experience with version control (git), ci/cd pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code
  
(iac) is required.

**core competencies**  
leadership & collaboration: evidence of strong interpersonal skills and translating
  
complex technical requirements for non-technical faculty or students is required.
  
experience with mentoring novice developers is highly preferred.
  
organization: demonstrated ability to manage multiple small-to-medium digital projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, collaborative environment is required.

title: Sr Scientist, Tech - Science
description:
**about the role**  
  
the rider team is the centerpiece of the uber consumer experience, owning the flagship app used by over 100m monthly active users.  
the personalization team builds the ranking, recommendation and agentic systems that shape what millions of riders see and do in the app. we are looking for a senior scientist to bring scientific rigor to this work and to help set its direction. you will be an experimentation and causal inference expert with strong ml fluency who will own how we measure whether our ai/ml systems are working, and you will use deep-dive analysis to show the team where the biggest opportunities are. you will partner closely with applied scientists and ml engineers to ensure we can trust our results, understand why a model wins or loses, and focus the roadmap on what moves rider outcomes.  
  
**what you'll do**

* own experimentation for personalization. design, run and analyze experiments for ranking, recommendation and agentic features. this includes interleaving, holdouts, switchbacks, and variance reduction (e.g., cuped/regression adjustment). use difference-in-differences, synthetic control, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, or propensity methods, and be clear about the identifying assumptions.
* close the gap between offline and online evaluation. build offline evaluation and simulation frameworks (e.g., ndcg/mrr, counterfactual and off-policy evaluation). diagnose why offline gains don't show up online, including novelty effects, distribution shift and training-serving skew.
* go deep on the data. run deep-dive analyses of rider behavior, funnels, and ranking and recommendation outcomes. include heterogeneous treatment effects and long-term versus short-term tradeoffs. surface proactive insights that change what the team builds next.
* define success, guardrail and long-term metrics for personalization surfaces. make results easy to find and use through dashboards, query templates and debugging tools.
* shape the roadmap. turn analysis into clear recommendations for pms, engineers and applied scientists, and help the team decide which bets to prioritize and which to stop.
* raise the scientific bar. review experiment designs and model evaluations, mentor junior scientists, and share best practices across the team. partner with applied scientists on experiment design for new ml approaches (e.g., listwise ranking, reinforcement learning, evidential deep learning, llm-based/agentic applications).
* stay current on advances in causal inference, experimentation and personalization ai/ml.

**basic qualifications**

* m.s. or bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, operations research, or another quantitative field.
* 5+ years of industry experience as a data scientist, applied scientist, research scientist, or equivalent, with a track record of owning experimentation and/or causal inference end to end.
* deep expertise in experiment design and analysis (power, variance reduction, multiple testing, interference/network effects) and in observational causal inference methods.
* working knowledge of machine learning. you can critique and debug models, understand ranking/recommender approaches and common failure modes, and use ml as an analytical tool.
* proficiency in python and sql, plus pyspark or similar big-data tools. you can build production-quality analysis pipelines.
* strong business and product sense. you can frame ambiguous problems, take them end to end, and communicate recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners

**preferred qualifications**

* ph.d. or m.s. in statistics, economics, or a related field with a causal inference or econometrics focus.
* experience evaluating ranking, recommender, search or feed systems (offline vs. online evaluation, interleaving, counterfactual evaluation).
* experience with heterogeneous treatment effects, uplift modeling, or long-term effect estimation/surrogate metrics.
* experience measuring or evaluating llm-based or agentic applications.
* hands-on experience with ml frameworks (scikit-learn, pytorch or tensorflow), and with good practices such as design documentation, testing and git.
* history of mentoring and raising the technical bar for a team.

  
for new york city, ny-based roles: the base salary range for this role is usd $190,000 per year - usd $211,000 per year.  
  
you will be eligible to participate in uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. all full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. you will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**ready to ride?**  
  
this isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. if you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
you may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. explore our benefits.  
  
offices remain key to collaboration and uber's culture. unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. ask your recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Rust / C++
description:
**job description:**

  

thomson reuters is hiring senior software engineers to build the core of the document-processing platform behind our ai products. the platform turns very large volumes of documents, millions of pages a day, into clean, structured output through a queue-driven pipeline. it powers flagship products like westlaw and cocounsel and serves internal product teams across the company. the work is mostly rust in du core, with regular work in the c#/.net services (du apps) that sit in front of it. as a senior software engineer ii, you’ll lead high-impact projects across core and apps, shape how the platform evolves, and set the technical bar for the team.

  

**key responsibilities:**

* turn asks into requirements. take requirements from product owners and consuming teams, and propose your own improvements. turn them into clear functional and technical requirements: the problem, who is asking, how much traffic it affects, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and how we’ll know it worked
* design with explicit trade-offs. write design docs and adrs that include all the options considered and why the chosen solution won out. cover cost, latency, quality, failure modes, operability and security, not just the happy path.
* define the architecture. shape how our services are designed, deployed and run on azure, and decide where the boundaries between services belong.
* find and fix bottlenecks. use production metrics, profiling, latency distributions and traffic mix to find where the pipeline is slow or wasteful, and to set timeouts, limits, concurrency and rollout plans. back decisions with benchmarks and load tests, and be clear about what the results do and don’t show.
* build and run the processing pipeline end to end. it’s a queue-driven pipeline that handles millions of pages per day. that means autoscaling, rate limiting, retries and failover across third-party vendors, very large inputs, and streaming with bounded memory while minimizing latency and maximizing throughput.
* work across core and apps. you’ll likely spend most of your time in the core backend rust services, but be willing to pivot to c#/.net to support the customer-facing services that sit in front of them.
* evolve contracts safely. change message schemas, api surfaces and feature flags across services, and often across repos, in one coordinated change. internal product teams depend on our output, so keep changes additive and backward compatible, ship with a rollout and rollback plan that covers every side, and return errors that consumers can act on.
* keep a strong engineering mindset. prefer simple designs over convoluted ones, deliver in small reviewable steps, test at the right layers, and leave code better than you found it.
* work agentically. write specs and plans that coding agents can carry out, break work into reviewable pieces, and check agent output with tests and evidence. evaluate ai tools for specific use cases. you own the correctness every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it.
* improve how humans and agents work here. evolve our agent instructions, skills and review automation so they capture what the team knows, and measure whether they help. write code, docs and prs clear enough that a new teammate and an ai agent can both understand the intent, constraints and invariants.
* own it in production. instrument services so you can see how they behave, take part in the on-call rotation and incident response, write blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes.
* lead high-impact work. own the design and rollout of large projects from requirements through production, break
* them into pieces the team can deliver, and keep the vision for where they’re headed.
* raise the team’s bar. mentor engineers and set the standard in code and design review.
influence direction. translate business needs into technical solutions, explain hard trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, and shape product and platform decisions with consuming teams and leadership  

  

**required qualifications:**

* 7+ years of professional software development experience building and operating backend services in production in rust or c++. if your background is c++, you should be keen to work in rust day to day.
* experience leading complex projects across teams, including architecture for multi-region or highly available systems.
* experience designing features with privacy and compliance requirements in mind, and building those requirements into code.
* deep distributed-systems expertise: message queues and at-least-once delivery, idempotency, backpressure, retries and timeouts, failure detection, and autoscaling.
* experience choosing between storage options (relational, nosql and others) for a given workload.
* a record of performance work at scale: profiling, benchmarking, memory budgets, concurrency limits, and handling inputs that don’t fit in memory
* a track record of written design work (design docs, adrs or rfcs) that compared options and drove a decision, and of turning ambiguous asks into scoped, testable requirements.
* excellent software development fundamentals: testing strategy across unit, integration and load, security-conscious defaults, and incremental delivery through ci/cd.
* experience mentoring other engineers, and strong code-review and technical-writing skills.
* hands-on experience with agentic development (e.g., claude code, cursor, github copilot).
* ownership mindset: you follow your work into production, lead root-cause analysis, and fix what you find
* willingness to join the team’s on-call rotation.
* willingness to work in c#/.net, and to learn it if you don’t already know it.
* must be located in the united states.
must be a u.s. person and legally authorized to work in the united states without current or future visasponsorship.  

  

**preferred qualifications:**

* professional experience with rust: async (tokio), errors modeled as types, and performance and memory tuning.
* daily, critical use of ai coding agents, including knowing when not to trust their output.
* experience building or improving developer tooling for ai agents: prompts and skills, mcp servers, multi-agent review, or evaluation of agent output.
* experience with document ai, ocr or file processing, such as pdf internals, format conversion or very large inputs.
* experience integrating several third-party vendors behind one abstraction, with health-based routing or failover.
* cloud and container platform experience (azure preferred), including kubernetes autoscaling and multi-region deployment.
* professional experience with c#/.net.
experience in regulated environments, such as fedramp, hipaa, cjis, fips 140 cryptography, or supply-chain controls like sboms and dependency bans.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
founded in richmond, virginia in 1997, capcenter exists to help individuals and families achieve one of life's most meaningful milestones—homeownership. by bringing mortgage, realty, and insurance services together under one roof, we provide a simpler, more transparent experience designed to save clients time and money. our commitment to innovation, including our zero closing cost mortgage, has earned the trust of thousands of clients and fueled our growth through repeat business and referrals.

at capcenter, our mission extends beyond serving clients. we foster a collaborative, high-impact environment where employees are empowered to do meaningful work, grow professionally, and make a real difference in the lives of the people we serve.

**job overview:**

we are seeking an innovative **ai software engineer** to design, build, and deploy advanced software solutions that transform both internal mortgage operations and external customer experiences. this role combines software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud-native infrastructure, and mortgage-industry problem-solving to deliver tools that increase efficiency, enhance customer engagement, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

**key responsibilities:**

***ai-driven software development***

* architect, develop, and deploy ai-powered applications for internal operations (e.g., loan processing tools, underwriting automation, compliance checks, workflow optimization).
* build customer-facing and marketing-facing software such as intelligent chat assistants, personalized loan recommendation engines, automated prequalification tools, and interactive calculators.
* integrate ai models (llms, predictive models, generative ai) into new or existing products using modern development frameworks and apis.

***cloud infrastructure & deployment***

* design, deploy, and operate applications on microsoft azure, using services such as azure kubernetes service (aks), app service, azure functions, azure sql, storage, key vault, and azure openai / ai foundry.
* containerize applications with docker and run them on kubernetes. this includes writing and maintaining manifests and helm charts, and managing deployments, scaling, ingress, secrets, and resource limits.
* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines (azure devops or github actions) that take code from commit to production reliably and repeatably.
* manage cloud resources with infrastructure-as-code (terraform, bicep, or arm templates).
* implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (azure monitor, application insights, log analytics) to keep production ai services healthy, and troubleshoot cluster and application issues when they come up.
* apply cloud security best practices, including entra id (azure ad) identity and role-based access, managed identities, network isolation, and secure secrets handling. all of this should meet the data-protection requirements for sensitive borrower information.
* optimize cloud cost and performance for ai workloads, including model hosting, inference scaling, and gpu/compute usage.

***collaborative product engineering***

* partner with operations, loan officers, compliance, marketing, and customer experience teams to identify high-impact use cases for ai and translate them into scalable products.
* work closely with data engineering to source, prepare, and validate datasets used for model training and evaluation.
* develop secure, compliant, and well-documented systems aligned with mortgage regulatory requirements.

***model development & optimization***

* train, fine-tune, or customize ai models to improve accuracy, performance, and relevance to mortgage workflows.
* implement continuous monitoring, versioning, and quality checks for ai models in production.
* evaluate emerging ai technologies and recommend adoption paths for the organization.

***technical leadership & best practices***

* establish development standards for ai-enabled software, including testing strategies, documentation, and model governance.
* provide guidance on responsible ai usage, data protection, and fair lending considerations in all deployments.
* contribute to long-term ai strategy to modernize the company’s tech stack and customer experience.

**qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5+ years of software engineering experience building web or backend applications.
* hands-on experience with machine learning or generative ai tools (openai, anthropic, huggingface, langchain, vector databases, etc.).
* proficiency in languages such as python, typescript/javascript, or c#.
* strong working knowledge of microsoft azure, including hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating production workloads (compute, networking, identity, storage, and key vault).
* solid experience with containers and kubernetes (preferably aks), including deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets, autoscaling, and debugging workloads with kubectl.
* experience building and maintaining ci/cd pipelines for containerized applications.
* understanding of apis, microservices, and modern software architecture patterns.

**preferred:**

* experience in fintech or mortgage/lending systems.
* familiarity with mortgage workflows: los, pos, underwriting, rate/pricing engines, and compliance considerations.
* microsoft azure certifications (e.g., az-204 developer, az-104 administrator, az-305 solutions architect, or ai-102 ai engineer) and/or kubernetes certifications (cka or ckad).
* experience with infrastructure-as-code (terraform or bicep) and gitops or helm-based deployment workflows.
* experience deploying and scaling ai/llm workloads on azure (azure openai, ai foundry, or self-hosted models on aks).
* knowledge of mlops tools and frameworks for model deployment.
* experience building customer-facing digital experiences.

**key competencies:**

* strong problem-solving skills with the ability to map operational processes to technical solutions.
* ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex concepts to non-technical teams.
* ownership of systems in production, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
* curiosity and eagerness to explore new ai capabilities.
* commitment to data security, fair lending, and responsible ai use.

**compensation:**

the estimated range of $90,000 – $115,000 reflects the budgeted amount for this position. individual compensation will be determined based on job-related business considerations, such as relevant qualifications, experience, location, education, certifications, skills, and other job-related reasons. where applicable, this position is eligible for incentive compensation and/or discretionary bonus opportunities.

**benefits:**

capcenter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid vacation, paid holidays, and other programs designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees.

**physical requirements and work environment:**

work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may involve extended periods of sitting, computer use, keyboarding, and telephone or virtual communication. the position may require managing competing priorities, responding to time-sensitive matters, maintaining accuracy and attention to detail, and working effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**reasonable accommodation:**

as required by law, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**equal opportunity employer:**

capcenter is an equal opportunity employer (veteran/disability). all qualified applicants will be considered regardless of race, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Data Platform Architect (Data 360)
description:
**data platform architect (d360)**  
  
we are looking for a data platform architect to help us support our continued growth. the data platform architect is responsible for owning the overall design of the technical solution as well as recommending best practice solutions based on client needs. they provide technical guidance to the development of salesforce.com and other saas applications to support business and product strategies, with a heavy emphasis on maximizing the salesforce data 360 (d360) ecosystem.  
  
a data platform architect facilitates discovery sessions to understand client processes and challenges and translates findings into technical requirements supported by a documented solution design. they provide thoughtful leadership and communication to project and client team members in order to build the foundation as a trusted partner.  
  
**role responsibilities:**

* data architecture design:
  + enterprise d360 harmonization: develop and implement data architectures that align with business needs and leverage salesforce data 360 (d360) capabilities for unified profile management, data democratization, and real-time activation.
  + modern cloud integration: design and implement data solutions that bridge enterprise cloud data platforms (data lakes/warehouses) with the salesforce ecosystem to address specific business needs, such as business intelligence (bi), etl/elt, and ai/ml.
  + legacy migration: assist with the migration, ingestion, and mapping of customer data from legacy systems and siloed databases into the salesforce d360 platform.
  + governance & trust: ensure data accessibility, data privacy, granular security controls, and compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., gdpr, ccpa) and industry standards within the customer data ecosystem.
* data modeling & pipeline design:
  + ingestion & streaming pipelines: design and implement real-time streaming and batch data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading high-volume enterprise data into salesforce d360 from various cloud sources and apis.
  + d360 identity resolution: design and implement scalable data models and metadata architectures within salesforce d360, expertly defining identity resolution rules, reconciliation rules, and unified data graphs.
  + performance optimization: monitor and optimize query performance, calculated insights, identity resolution runs, and data transformation processes within the salesforce d360 and underlying lakehouse environment.
* technical leadership and collaboration:
  + cross-functional collaboration: collaborate with key stakeholders—including business users, data engineers, data scientists, and crm it teams—to understand requirements and deliver unified data solutions.
  + ecosystem evaluation: evaluate and select appropriate tools, connectors, and zero-copy/zero-data-movement technologies for seamless data integration, transformation, and activation within the salesforce d360 ecosystem.
  + technical guidance: provide technical leadership, architectural oversight, and best-practice guidance to data engineering and crm development teams.

**experience/skills required:**

* 5+ years of experience in solutions architecture or technical consulting for cloud data platforms with multiple enterprise workstreams.
* deep understanding of salesforce d360 (data cloud) architecture & capabilities: expert knowledge of the data model (dmos, dsos), identity resolution, data spaces, calculated insights, and activation targets.
* data modernization advocate: passionate about modern data architecture methods, including lakehouse architecture, zero-copy data sharing, and real-time data activation.
* broad data ecosystem experience: comprehensive range of experience in enterprise database technology, cloud data warehouses (e.g., snowflake, databricks), etl/elt tools, data engineering pipelines, and data science principles.
* elite communication: strong verbal and presentation abilities, capable of effectively communicating complex data architecture concepts to stakeholders and prospective clients at all levels of an organization.
* strategic roadmap leadership: demonstrable experience leading strategy and digital roadmap projects in a complex business environment. proven ability to guide clients toward optimal standard solutions when initial custom designs are not a fit.
* technical tooling & development: experience with data-centric programming languages (such as sql and python) as well as salesforce application development components (apex, flow, lwcs, mulesoft).
* advanced architecture patterns: deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns, api management, and real-time data streaming technologies (e.g., kafka, amazon kinesis).
* structured data modeling: mastery of data modeling methodologies (such as kimball dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, or medallion bronze/silver/gold structures) and how they map into a canonical customer 360 model.
* us authorization: must have full-time permanent us work authorization.

**additional preferred experience/skills:**

* bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* salesforce certified data cloud consultant or accredited professional designations.
* hands-on experience with core salesforce crm technology like sales cloud, service cloud, or industry clouds (e.g., financial services cloud, health cloud).
* hands-on experience deploying ai/ml solutions like salesforce einstein, aws sagemaker, or google vertex ai, alongside a solid understanding of generative ai patterns (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation / rag).
* experience designing data architectures on cloud platforms like amazon web services, microsoft azure, or google cloud platform.
* hands-on expertise with analytics and visualization tools like tableau, crm analytics, powerbi, or looker.
