title: Software Power Systems Engineer
description:
overview:

**we are designing the grid of the future!**

ener-i is a cutting-edge software solution from electric power engineers (epe) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. backed by the collective expertise of epe, ener-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud-based, enterprise computing software. ener-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, gis, network connectivity models, machine learning & augmented intelligence. our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry.

responsibilities:

**join us in leading the** **change!**

the software power systems engineer will work as a core member of the ener-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. this involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi-static time-series (qsts) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and der interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of der and non-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and derms operational planning, and long-term capacity and investment planning.

the level of the role (engineer iii, senior, principal, or senior principal) will be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience. principal-level engineers are expected to set technical direction for the platform's powerflow analysis architecture and lead cross-team initiatives.

  

* the software power systems engineer will also engage with the ener-i product, engineering, and client delivery teams for tasks such as:
* distribution model conversion, validation, and onboarding (e.g., cyme, synergi, windmil, opendss)
* translating utility planning practices and criteria into technical specifications
* technical design reviews and architecture decisions for analysis engines
* validation of platform results against commercial tools and field data
* performance benchmarking and scale testing on utility-sized models
* client technical workshops, demonstrations, and user training
* perform and deliver ener-i based distribution planning studies when needed

**how you can make an impact:**

  

* design and implement production-grade python libraries and services for distribution analysis, power flow orchestration, and optimization within the ener-i platform.
* scale simulations across thousands of feeders and full-year time-series through parallelization, cloud batch processing, and performance tuning – including compiled languages (e.g., rust, c++) where it matters.
* build and maintain distribution data models and model converters that bring utility network models (cyme, synergi, windmil, opendss, gis) into a common, validated representation.
* develop algorithms for automated mitigation, hosting capacity, der valuation, and grid planning using optimization (lp/milp), heuristics, and data-driven methods.
* establish test automation, validation suites, and engineering benchmarks that keep platform results accurate and trustworthy.
* serve as a distribution subject matter expert to developers, product owners, and product managers; review requirements and user stories for engineering correctness.
* propose and prototype new ener-i modules and help shape the technical roadmap with product management.
* mentor engineers and developers, contribute to code and design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team.
* represent epe through publications, open-source contributions, and industry working groups where appropriate.
* perform other duties as assigned.

  
qualifications:

**bring your passion, here's what’s needed:**

  

* master's degree or ph.d. in electrical engineering with a power systems focus, or a bachelor's degree with equivalent experience.
* 3+ years (engineer iii) or 7+ years (principal) of combined experience in distribution system analysis and software development; national laboratory, research, utility, and vendor experience all count.
* expert understanding of three-phase, unbalanced distribution systems, power flow formulations, and distribution planning practices.
* hands-on experience with at least one distribution modeling tool (e.g., opendss, cyme, synergi, windmil, or gridlab-d), including its apis or automation interfaces.
* strong python software engineering skills beyond scripting: packaging, typing, automated testing, git, code review, and ci/cd. opendss experience is a plus.
* a track record of building tools that other people use: libraries, applications, or open-source projects with real users.
* experience applying numerical methods and optimization (e.g., pyomo, jump, gurobi, highs) to power systems problems.
* experience working with large data sets (time-series, ami, scada) using tools such as pandas/polars, sql, or parquet.
* strong communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly with respect to explaining complex technical matters.
* proven team player skills with ability to build and maintain internal and external relationships.
* familiarity with agile software development methodologies (e.g., scrum).

**beneficial experience:**

* proficiency in a compiled or high-performance language such as rust, c++, julia, or java.
* contributions to open-source power systems tools (e.g., opendss/altdss, ditto, gridlab-d, powermodelsdistribution, pandapower).
* experience with cloud-native development, containers, and distributed or high-performance computing (e.g., aws, docker, kubernetes).
* experience with der integration topics such as hosting capacity, ieee 1547, derms, flexible interconnection, non-wires alternatives, and electrification load forecasting.
* breadth across transmission, controls, or t&d co-simulation.
* familiarity with gis tools (preferably esri) and utility network data models.
* experience leveraging machine learning and ai tools responsibly to improve engineering quality and productivity.
* publications or participation in ieee pes or similar industry working groups.

be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. for more than half a century, electric power engineers (epe) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. as leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. together we can transform the future of energy.

**how we support you:**

* comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you
* generous pto and paid holidays
* myshare employee ownership program
* work with industry leaders
* 401k, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

***location***: this position is open to remote for highly qualified candidates

***travel***: occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

*epe is an equal opportunity/aa/disability/veteran employer. the eeo is the law poster, and its supplement are available using the following links:* *eeoc is the law poster*

***third-party recruiting notification***

*epe does not accept unsolicited resumes from* ***third-party recruiters****. any unsolicited third-party resumes forwarded by recruiters to epe via our career page or to any of our managers or employees will be considered public information, may be treated as a direct application from the person identified in the resume, and will not be eligible for placement fee payment to the agency. epe will not pay a fee to a third-party recruiter or agency* without a previously signed third-party agreement *and has not coordinated their recruiting activity with the appropriate member of the talent acquisition team.*

in this role, you will design and operate reliable, governed batch and real-time data products using technologies such as databricks, snowflake, spark, kubernetes, vector/search technologies and cloud-native services. you will build the pipelines, data assets, orchestration patterns, and search and retrieval capabilities that make trusted data available to search, machine learning, analytics, and engineering teams.

you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data solutions that integrate and transform data for business and analytical use. you will apply data engineering practices to deliver reliable, high-quality data products and improve the performance, scalability, and automation of data processes. the senior data engineer partners with technical and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective data solutions.

**you** **will**

* design, develop, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data products that integrate information from

multiple sources.

* build solutions to extract, transform, integrate, and deliver reliable data for analytical and business needs.

* develop and enhance data engineering capabilities that improve data accessibility, performance, quality, and scalability.

* analyze requirements and translate business and technical needs into data designs, specifications, and solutions.

* identify and implement improvements to data engineering processes, including automation, optimization, and increased reliability.

* partner with technical and business stakeholders to resolve data-related challenges and deliver solutions that meet business requirements.

* design and deliver scalable batch and streaming data pipelines and data products across modern data and cloud platforms.

* define reusable data engineering patterns for cdc, event-driven processing, workflow orchestration, data products, and ai/search-enabled workloads.

* partner with engineering, product, and applied science to shape architecture, roadmap, adoption, and operational ownership of data capabilities.

**you have**

* bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, data science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field or equivalent experience

* 3+ years' experience in related data engineering or software engineering experience

* experience building and operating production batch and streaming data pipelines on databricks or similar modern data platforms.

* strong software engineering skills in python with hands-on experience using spark or other distributed processing frameworks.

* hands-on experience with cdc, streaming/event-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration, with the ability to select appropriate patterns based on scale, reliability, and use case.

* experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as docker and kubernetes, along with cloud platforms such as aws or equivalent.

* experience implementing ci/cd and automated testing using platforms such as github actions or equivalent.

* experience working across relational, nosql, vector, graph, or other database technologies and selecting appropriate storage patterns based on the use case.

* experience designing and developing scalable data pipelines, data integration solutions, and data products.

* proficiency with programming, scripting, and data query languages used to develop and manipulate data solutions.

* experience translating requirements into technical designs and implementing solutions involving multiple data sources.

* knowledge of modern data engineering.

**preferred**

* experience with cdc and orchestration platforms such as aws dms, debezium, tableflow, airflow, databricks workflows, or equivalent technologies.

* experience using machine learning or ai within data pipelines to classify, enrich, standardize, match, or improve data.

* experience with e-commerce, search, recommendations, or personalization platforms.

* working knowledge of machine learning models and production of ml workflows.

title: Data & AI Engineer, Advanced
description:
working at the naval nuclear laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: trust, empowerment, and collaboration. our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the sailors who operate those reactors in the u.s. navy's submarines and aircraft carrier fleets. looking for a lifetime career? apply today!

**job description**
-------------------

working at the naval nuclear laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: trust, empowerment, and collaboration. our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the sailors who operate those reactors in the u.s. navy's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. join the naval nuclear laboratory (nnl) as a data & ai engineer and play a central role in modernizing the data foundations that power the naval reactors program. in this role, you will help transform the financial data ecosystem by designing, building, and maintaining secure, scalable data infrastructure that enables accurate, timely, and actionable analytics across the enterprise. you will partner with teams across financial services, it, digital transformation, and other mission-critical organizations to advance nnl's growing data-driven decision-making capabilities. this work supports the multi year modernization of financial systems and analytics platforms, enabling cloud-forward architectures, integrated data repositories, standardized data structures, and automated data flows-all essential to ensuring nnl's financial insight, compliance, and operational excellence. looking for a lifetime career? apply today!

  

what you'll do:  

* design, build, and maintain high?quality data pipelines and workflows that integrate data from multiple systems.
* develop and support data warehouses and data lakes to enable secure, efficient access to structured and unstructured data.
* implement etl/elt processes that deliver clean, consistent, and well?governed datasets.
* collaborate with analysts, software developers, and business partners to create data models that support reporting and advanced analytics.
* improve data quality, performance, and reliability through monitoring, validation, and optimization.
* ensure adherence to data governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* evaluate new tools, cloud technologies, and automation capabilities that enhance scalability and efficiency.

**required combination of knowledge and skill**
-----------------------------------------------

* bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or
* masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or
* doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field; or
* currently an advanced reactor training engineer, refueling engineer, or field (rpco) engineer at the company.

**preferred skills**
--------------------

* degrees in computer science, data science, or computer engineering are preferred, but not required.
* experience integrating and transforming enterprise data from erp, tms, or epm systems into analytical platforms, using etl/elt tools (such as azure data factory, synapse pipelines, ssis, notebooks) and data engineering languages (python, sql).
* proficiency in designing and optimizing modern data architectures, including data lakehouse/cloud patterns, dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas), and power bi analytics (datasets, dashboards, dax, m).
* familiarity with software development lifecycle, devops practices (git-based source control, ci/cd pipelines, automated testing), and emerging ai/ml platforms (azure ml, microsoft copilot, azure open ai), with attention to data privacy and responsible ai.
* strong ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate effectively, and apply analytical and problem-solving skills.

**compensation and benefits**
-----------------------------

* health, dental, vision & voluntary benefits
* disability, life & accident insurance
* 401(k) savings program & capital accumulation plan
* personal & medical time off
* paid parental leave
* flexible work schedules
* tuition assistance for eligible employees
* student debt benefit personal time off sell program
* employee assistance program (eap)
* wellness program
* visit us online to view all nnl benefits!

**pay range**
-------------

$95,700.00 - $149,600.00 annually
  
  
salary information provided is a general guideline only. annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

the naval nuclear laboratory is operated for the u.s. department of energy (doe) by fluor marine propulsion, llc (fmp), a wholly owned subsidiary of fluor corporation. naval nuclear laboratory personnel are fmp employees who work at four doe facilities: bettis atomic power laboratory, knolls atomic power laboratory, kenneth a. kesselring site, and naval reactors facility, and at the u.s. department of defense-owned nuclear power training unit-charleston. fmp employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards, satellite, and vendor locations.

  

for more than 75 years, the naval nuclear laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. the naval nuclear laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the naval nuclear propulsion program. we rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel.

  

all candidates must be u.s. citizens. applicants selected will be subject to a federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter. fmp is a government contractor and maintains a drug free workplace and workforce. all candidates must be able to pass a drug test in compliance with fmp company policy and 10 cfr 707. marijuana is a federal schedule i controlled substance and illegal under federal law. therefore, fmp is required to test for marijuana.

  

fluor marine propulsion, llc is an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state, or local law.

the senior software engineer is responsible for all aspects of the development of platforms and applications. this is a highly skilled hands-on role requiring extensive proficiency involved in all aspects of the development of cloud-based software solutions. subject to their specialization, this senior software engineer leads the design, development, testing, publishing, and/or support of different cloud-based products and solutions and serves as subject matter expertise for customer implementation and cloud platform support. the senior software engineer works closely with a global team of engineers to build robust solutions that meet our business objectives following continuous integration and continuous deployment processes, while supporting software and associate software engineers. additionally, this role provides recommendations to management as to process, technologies, or other improvements intended to benefit productivity, efficiency and/or quality of the solutions developed by the team and leads the implementation of new solutions.

* proven track record of delivery of complex features end-to-end

* 3 years experience with source control tools (git, svn or similar)
* 3 years experience with containerized runtime environments: docker, kubernetes
* 3 years experience with compiling and continuous integration tools like : eclipse/intellij, visual studio, maven, jenkins, artifactory or other continuous integration/build/static code analysis tools
* excellent teamwork, self-learner and self-managed
* strong interpersonal skills, high communication skills
* clear and concise written and verbal communication in english; comfortable presenting technical plans to engineering and product stakeholders

**preferred requirements**

* experience in full stack development
* experience in node.js programming language
* experience in javascript/typescript with hands-on react experience (hooks, context, redux or equivalent).
* experience with cloud hosting services: aws, azure, or gcp
* experience with application performance management systems: datadog, newrelic, appdynamics, elk

title: AI Engineer
description:
**about oakwood.** oakwood systems group is a microsoft solutions partner helping organizations modernize applications, data platforms, cloud environments, and business workflows. our ai work focuses on moving clients beyond experimentation by designing and delivering secure, production-ready ai applications, agents, copilots, and automation that create measurable business value.

**the role.** we are seeking an experienced, hands-on ai engineer who can turn ambiguous business problems into reliable ai solutions. this role is for an engineer with a strong software, data, or machine-learning foundation who has already shipped production systems and is comfortable owning work from discovery and technical design through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and operational handoff. you will work directly with clients and oakwood delivery teams to build practical ai capabilities on the microsoft cloud, with particular emphasis on generative ai, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), agentic workflows, enterprise integration, and responsible production operations.

**what you will do:**
=====================

* design, build, and deploy production of ai applications, copilots, and agents using microsoft azure and modern ai frameworks.
* build rag and enterprise knowledge solutions using embeddings, vector search, document processing, metadata, and retrieval strategies that produce grounded, source-aware answers.
* design agentic workflows that use tools, apis, structured outputs, memory/state, human approval, and multi-step orchestration to automate real business processes safely.
* integrate ai capabilities with enterprise applications and data sources through rest apis, microsoft graph, power platform, databases, saas platforms, and custom services.
* develop maintainable backend services and apis, primarily in python, with appropriate testing, error handling, logging, security, and performance considerations.
* establish evaluation approaches for ai quality, groundedness, reliability, safety, latency, and cost; use those results to improve prompts, retrieval, orchestration, and model selection.
* implement production engineering practices including source control, automated testing, ci/cd, containerization, secrets management, observability, and environment promotion.
* apply enterprise security and governance practices, including identity, role-based access, data boundaries, auditability, responsible ai controls, and human-in-the-loop patterns where appropriate.
* work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to understand workflows, clarify requirements, prototype solutions, explain tradeoffs, and translate ai possibilities into deployable designs.
* contribute architecture reviews, code reviews, estimation, technical discovery, and solution design for new client opportunities.
* create reusable patterns, accelerators, reference implementations, and delivery of assets that improve the speed and consistency of future oakwood ai engagements.
* document solutions clearly and support knowledge transfer so client teams can understand, operate, and extend what we deliver.
* mentor less-experienced engineers and help establish pragmatic engineering standards for production of ai delivery.

**required qualifications:**
============================

* 5+ years of professional engineering experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, applied ai, backend development, or a closely related discipline, with meaningful ownership of production systems.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience building generative ai / llm-powered applications or ai-enabled software, with at least one solution taken beyond prototype into a production or production-like environment.
* strong python programming skills and experience building production services, apis, integrations, or data/ai pipelines.
* hands-on experience with llm application patterns such as prompt design, rag, embeddings, vector search, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent orchestration.
* experience evaluating ai systems using measurable criteria rather than subjective demos alone, including quality, reliability, safety, latency, and/or cost.
* experience with cloud-based applications and ai services; strong azure experience is preferred, and candidates should be able to work effectively in a microsoft-centric environment.
* working knowledge of sql and enterprise data integration, including the ability to reason about data quality, access, lineage, and how data architecture affects ai outcomes.
* experience with modern software engineering practices: git, peer review, automated testing, ci/cd, containers, apis, logging/monitoring, and secure configuration/secrets management.
* ability to troubleshoot production of ai behavior, including retrieval failures, hallucinations, tool-calling errors, prompt regressions, latency, cost, and unexpected edge cases.
* strong client-facing communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts, architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* ability to work independently in a consulting environment, manage competing priorities, and move from incomplete requirements to a well-structured implementation plan.
* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**preferred qualifications:**
=============================

* hands-on experience with microsoft foundry / azure ai foundry, azure openai, azure ai search, copilot studio, power automate, or related microsoft ai services.
* experience with one or more orchestration frameworks such as semantic kernel, langgraph, autogen, langchain, crewai, or custom agent frameworks.
* experience with model context protocol (mcp), agent-to-tool integration patterns, or reusable enterprise tool registries.
* experience with azure application services such as functions, container apps, app service, aks, api management, cosmos db, azure sql, key vault, and entra id.
* experience with mlops / llmops practices including evaluation pipelines, model or prompt versioning, tracing, monitoring, feedback loops, and production incident response.
* experience with microsoft fabric, databricks, or other modern data platforms used to prepare governed enterprise data for ai.
* experience with classical machine learning, nlp, deep learning, fine-tuning, multimodal models, or model serving where the use case requires more than foundation-model apis.
* experience using ai-assisted development tools such as github copilot, claude code, codex, or cursor while applying disciplined engineering review for correctness, security, and maintainability.
* prior consulting, professional services, systems integration, or microsoft partner experience.
* relevant microsoft or cloud certifications, such as azure ai engineer, azure developer, azure solutions architect, or equivalent.

**what success looks like:**
============================

* ai solutions move from discovery and prototype to secure, supportable production deployments with clear acceptance criteria.
* clients can see and articulate the business value of the systems delivered, not just the technical novelty.
* ai quality is measured and improved through repeatable evaluation, observability, and feedback rather than one-time demonstrations.
* solutions integrate cleanly with client applications, data, identity, and operating processes and can be maintained after handoff.
* reusable engineering patterns and delivery assets reduce effort and risk across future engagements.
* you are viewed by clients and teammates as a trusted engineer who can combine technical depth, sound judgment, and practical delivery.

**why oakwood**
===============

oakwood combines deep microsoft expertise with hands-on application, data, cloud, and ai engineering. we hold microsoft solutions partner designations across key solution areas and an advanced specialization for ai applications on microsoft azure. ai engineers at oakwood have the opportunity to work directly with clients, build real production solutions, shape reusable delivery patterns, and help organizations turn rapidly evolving ai capabilities into durable business outcomes.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer - Core Platforms
description:
the enterprise technology services organization partners with every part of the american express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. we support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. we also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise ai platforms on behalf of the company.

the evaluation engineer designs, develops, and maintains evaluation frameworks for ai and machine learning solutions, including llm, rag, agentic, and multimodal applications. this role translates business, product, risk, and governance requirements into measurable success criteria; builds automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation pipelines; and partners with cross-functional teams to ensure ai systems meet enterprise standards for quality, safety, reliability, compliance, latency, and cost.

  

**education and knowledge**

* 5+ years' experience in software development, including hands on experience in machine learning, ai technologies, and agentic solutions
* bachelor's degree in computer science, machine learning, data science, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
* knowledge of python and data processing technologies such as big data (hadoop, spark)
* knowledge of natural language processing techniques like fuzzy wuzzy and models such as bert, transformer models, and their real-world applications
* advanced knowledge of machine learning techniques and performance optimization
strong understanding of ai system architectures including llm ecosystems, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation methodologies  

**work experience**

* experience in software development with a focus on machine learning, generative ai, big data, and prompt engineering
* experience in working with large language models (llms), especially gpt-3.5/4 or similar ai models
* experience in languages such as python, r, java, or c++
* experience in deploying ai models and pipelines using machine leanring operations tools
* experience in machine learning algorithms and experience applying them to real-world problems
* experience in continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines and containerized deployments
* experience in building and maintaining data pipelines and extract, transform, and load processes
* experience delivering end-to-end ai systems in production, including design and operational ownership
* experience with distributed systems design, scalable apis, and cloud-native ai infrastructure, including monitoring and optimization
* advanced expertise in a technical domain and moderate expertise in a new, different technical domain
* experience building evaluation harnesses and automated test pipelines for llm, rag, or agentic applications using production-representative datasets.
* experience designing human-in-the-loop and model-based evaluation workflows, including calibration, error analysis, and validation of evaluation quality.
experience integrating evaluation results into ci/cd, release readiness, production monitoring, and governance evidence.  

employment eligibility to work with american express in the united states is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

  

at american express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and leadership behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. from delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

as part of team amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of american express.

  

we back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. this means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* competitive base salaries
* bonus incentives
* 6% company match on retirement savings plan
* free financial coaching and financial well-being support

* 20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacy
* free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)

**job description**
-------------------

this position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. the candidate is a self-motivated individual who can collaborate with a team and across the organization. the candidate takes responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to u.s. bank standards in order to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience. the candidate will be adept with the agile software development lifecycle and devops principles.  
  
**key responsibilities**

* build and integrate **ai-powered capabilities**, including large language models (llms), retrieval-augmented generation (rag), and intelligent ai agents into business solutions.
* develop and support **rest apis, microservices, and cloud-native applications** following engineering best practices.
* collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* participate in all phases of the **software development lifecycle (sdlc)**, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support.
* contribute to ai experimentation, proof-of-concepts, and production implementations that drive business value and innovation.
* implement secure coding standards and comply with enterprise risk, security, compliance, and ai governance requirements.
* support **ci/cd pipelines, devsecops practices, automated testing, application monitoring, and cloud operations** to ensure reliable software delivery.

**basic qualifications**  

* bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
* two to three years of relevant experience

**required skills & qualifications**

* experience developing applications using **java, spring boot, react, typescript, and restful apis**.
* knowledge of **sql and/or nosql databases** with the ability to design and interact with scalable data solutions.
* familiarity with cloud platforms such as **microsoft azure, aws, or google cloud platform (gcp)**.
* understanding of **object-oriented programming, software design patterns, and modern software engineering principles**.
* exposure to **generative ai technologies**, including llms, prompt engineering, ai agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag).
* experience using development tools such as **git, github, github copilot, ci/cd pipelines, and automated testing frameworks**.
* knowledge of **cloud-native architectures, containerization, docker, kubernetes, and microservices-based application development**.
* strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a passion for learning emerging technologies and delivering customer-focused solutions.

**technologies used**: java | springboot | react | typescript | rest apis | github | github copilot | azure | ai services | azure openai | azure ai search | aws bedrock | sql/nosql databases | docker | kubernetes | ci/cd pipelines.

**location expectations**  
this role requires working from a u.s. bank location three (3) or more days per week.

the arizona cardinals are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and technically skilled ai and data platform engineer to support the organization's expanding artificial intelligence, data management, and enterprise technology strategy.

ai platform administration & enablement

  + prepare and optimize enterprise datasets for generative ai, machine learning, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) use cases.

title: Customer Reliability Engineer
description:
### **about us**

ai coding is the largest use case of enterprise ai adoption today, as is evident from the success of anthropic on claude code, cursor’s $60b exit to spacex, and cognition’s $48b valuation.  
  
the bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - ai agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.  
  
auri by endor labs closes that gap. it runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and mcp, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. it shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.  
  
the companies building ai trust us to secure it - our customers include openai, spacex, doordash, dropbox, atlassian, mongodb, snowflake, robinhood and peloton to name a few.  
  
endor labs is the third company from founder & ceo varun badhwar, who built prisma cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300m arr at palo alto networks. we’ve raised $163m from lightspeed, coatue, dfj growth, salesforce ventures and dell technologies capital.  
  
software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. ai now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. come build that future with us.

#### **about the role**

customer reliability engineering (cre) is the highest-level technical support function within customer solutions. it operates as an escalation function, a peer to account management and closely aligned with post-sales field engineering. cre bridges customers and engineering by owning complex product behavior in the field, so other post-sales teams can stay focused on strategic platform use rather than firefighting.

✱ cre is a customer engineering role, not just a support role. we don't stop at diagnosing a problem. when the right fix is in the code, we write it, and when the team needs a tool that doesn't exist, we build it.

we work with urgency (the baton is on fire), we fix root causes rather than just patching today's problem, and we take extreme ownership of every engagement from start to finish. nobody should ever have to ask cre for a status update. if they do, we've failed to exceed the urgency or to communicate next steps clearly.

**how you'll make an impact**
-----------------------------

* **own technical escalations end-to-end.** lead complex product issues from first report to resolution, coordinating across customer solutions and engineering.
* **run point on incidents.** lead response to global and customer-specific incidents, understand customer impact, and communicate clearly and proactively to technical users and executives alike.
* **diagnose, root cause, and fix.** investigate unexpected product behavior using diagnostic tools, system logs, and the endor labs codebase, and hand engineering a clear path to the fix. if you’re comfortable in the codebase, you’re welcome to open the pr yourself.
* ✱ **build tools and applications.** design and build internal tools, scripts, automations, product features, and lightweight applications that speed up diagnosis, automate repetitive escalation work, and give support and account teams better visibility into customer health.
* **drive reliability and prevention work.** turn incident patterns into durable fixes, runbooks, tests, and guardrails so the product is easier to support at scale.
* **partner across the company.** share field insights with account teams, engineering, and product, and raise the quality of technical support across customer solutions through mentorship and enablement.
* **coordinate with engineering and r&d.** file, track, prioritize, and expedite resolution of critical customer bugs and complex technical issues, and make your own code contributions easy for them to review.
* **balance reactive and proactive work.** respond to account-team-triggered escalations while investing in fixes that stop tomorrow's version of today's issue from happening.
* **help define success.** contribute to the kpis and slas for escalation and incident response, including our 24x5 coverage for larger enterprise customers.

**what you'll bring to the table**
----------------------------------

* **5+ years of experience** in a customer-facing tier 3, escalation support, customer support engineering, sre, or software engineering role within a saas or developer tools environment.
* ✱ **strong software engineering skills.** you're a proficient programmer in go, python, or javascript/typescript (or a proven record of picking up new languages quickly), with real experience writing production-quality code, tests, and pull requests.
* ✱ **a track record of building.** you can point to tools, services, or applications you've designed and shipped, whether internal automation, dashboards, clis, or full applications.
* **proven troubleshooting skills.** you can dive into complex, unfamiliar codebases, analyze system logs, and debug api and infrastructure interactions.
* **incident management experience**, including staying calm and communicating clearly during high-severity, high-visibility events.
* **a structured problem-solving approach.** you can synthesize inputs from multiple sources and prioritize under pressure.
* **outstanding written and verbal communication**, with a knack for translating complex technical concepts for both developers and executive leaders.
* **an ownership mindset.** you're proactive, resourceful, and willing to drive issues to resolution with incomplete information, without waiting to be chased.
* **a passion for application security (appsec)**, open-source software, and developer workflows.

**nice to have**

* hands-on experience with source control systems (github, gitlab, bitbucket) and ci/cd pipelines.
* deep familiarity with cloud-native technologies, including docker, kubernetes, and major cloud providers (aws, gcp, azure).
* experience troubleshooting full-stack or api-backed applications, and building tools on top of observability and ticketing systems.
* experience writing runbooks, postmortems, or tooling that reduces repeat incidents.
* active use of ai-assisted development tools (e.g., cursor, claude, github copilot) to accelerate diagnosis, fixes, and tool-building.

#### **why endor labs**

we're building at the intersection of developer productivity and security, one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. our developer-loved platform delivers measurable roi, strong market momentum, and a customer base that deeply values our mission.

at endor labs, we **think big, start small, and learn fast**. we take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with customer success. we debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. we celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way, because when our customers win, we all win.

*endor labs is an equal opportunity employer. we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. even if you don't meet every single requirement listed above, we strongly encourage you to apply. we value diverse perspectives, transferable skills, and a passion for learning.*

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**about us**

johnson controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

for more than 140 years, johnson controls has delivered performance where it really matters. backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

johnson controls international (jci) is looking for an ai platform engineer to join the ai engineering & platforms team. this role focuses on building, automating, securing, and operating the enterprise landing zones and shared services that enable ai, machine learning, generative ai, and agent-based solutions across jci.

you will work across cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, devops, networking, security, observability, and service operations. the role is platform-first: creating reusable capabilities, governed deployment patterns, and reliable self-service experiences for ai engineering, data science, product, and business teams.

**how you will do it**

**enterprise ai landing zones & cloud platform engineering**

  

* build and operate secure, scalable ai landing zones and shared platform services, primarily on azure and increasingly across aws.
* develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment patterns using terraform and terragrunt, with consistent configuration across development, test, and production environments.
* provision and support azure ai foundry, azure machine learning, azure openai, ai search, document intelligence, container apps, app services, function apps, key vault, azure container registry, storage, cosmos db, redis, application insights, log analytics, and supporting services.
* contribute to aws ai/ml platform capabilities using services such as amazon bedrock, sagemaker, api gateway, lambda, s3, iam, and associated networking and security services.
* design platform services so new capabilities can be onboarded through repeatable modules, documented standards, and approved deployment patterns.

**ai gateways, model access & runtime services**

  

* build and operate governed access to foundation models and ai services through azure api management and equivalent cloud gateway patterns.
* implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, quotas, routing, retries, circuit breakers, usage tracking, and cost controls for model and api consumption.
* support pay-as-you-go and provisioned-throughput model deployments, model upgrades, endpoint lifecycle management, capacity planning, and controlled access for consuming teams.
* enable secure hosting patterns for apis, agents, containerized workloads, scheduled jobs, and event-driven services using managed cloud platforms.

**automation, ci/cd & developer enablement**

  

* create and maintain azure devops pipelines for infrastructure deployment, validation, policy checks, application hosting, and controlled releases.
* build automated testing for terraform modules, platform services, networking, security controls, and deployment smoke tests.
* create sample projects, templates, reference implementations, runbooks, and onboarding documentation that help teams adopt the platform safely and quickly.
* work with consuming teams to troubleshoot platform access, networking, identity, certificates, private endpoints, deployment, and runtime issues.

**security, governance, reliability & operations**

  

* implement private networking, managed identities, entra id integration, rbac, least-privilege access, secrets management, logging, auditability, and secure-by-default configurations.
* partner with cybersecurity, cloud engineering, networking, enterprise architecture, ai governance, and service owners to move solutions from development into supported production environments.
* build dashboards, alerts, health checks, monitoring, and operational metrics for platform availability, model usage, cost, capacity, and service quality.
* participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, platform maintenance, change management, and continuous improvement.
* support platform request, approval, provisioning, documentation, and handover processes, ensuring solutions remain supportable and compliant.

**collaboration & engineering standards**

  

* collaborate with ai engineers, data scientists, solution architects, product teams, and cloud specialists to translate use cases into reusable platform capabilities.
* contribute to architecture reviews, technical design decisions, backlog refinement, sprint delivery, code reviews, and platform roadmap planning.
* promote engineering practices focused on automation, reliability, security, maintainability, cost awareness, and clear technical documentation.

**qualifications & skills**

**required**

  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in cloud, devops, platform, sre, infrastructure, or mlops engineering roles.
* hands-on experience building production azure solutions using terraform and azure devops.
* strong knowledge of cloud networking, private endpoints, dns, identity, rbac, managed identities, secrets, and secure service-to-service connectivity.
* experience with containerized and managed application platforms such as azure container apps, app services, functions, docker, or kubernetes.
* experience implementing ci/cd, automated testing, deployment controls, monitoring, alerting, and operational support for production services.
* proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as python, powershell, or bash.
* ability to diagnose complex infrastructure, networking, authentication, certificate, deployment, and runtime issues.
* clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and product teams.

**preferred**

  

* hands-on experience with azure ai foundry, azure openai, azure machine learning, azure ai search, document intelligence, or similar managed ai services.
* experience designing or operating api gateways using azure api management, including policies for authentication, routing, throttling, retries, observability, and usage controls.
* experience developing reusable terraform modules and working with terragrunt, remote state, module versioning, and environment promotion patterns.
* experience with enterprise landing zones, hub-and-spoke networking, private cloud services, policy enforcement, and multi-subscription or multi-account environments.
* experience operating ai or ml platforms, including model endpoints, capacity, quotas, evaluation services, vector search, rag infrastructure, or agent runtimes.
* working knowledge of cloud cost management, service reliability, incident management, and platform product thinking.

**nice to have**

  

* experience with aws platform engineering, including bedrock, sagemaker, api gateway, iam, lambda, s3, vpc networking, terraform, or terragrunt.
* experience with multi-cloud ai gateway, model-routing, or centralized model-access patterns.
* knowledge of llmops, agent orchestration, mcp, rag, embeddings, vector databases, model evaluation, safety, or observability patterns.
* experience with opentelemetry, siem integration, dashboards, load testing, resilience testing, or performance engineering.
* exposure to servicenow-based request and fulfilment processes, cmdb, application onboarding, or enterprise architecture approval processes.
* relevant certifications such as azure administrator, azure solutions architect, azure devops engineer, azure ai engineer, aws solutions architect, or terraform associate.
* experience supporting global teams and services across multiple regions, time zones, and regulatory environments.

**mindset**

  

* platform-first engineer who looks for reusable solutions rather than one-off deployments.
* security-conscious and comfortable balancing delivery speed with enterprise controls.
* operationally minded, with a focus on reliability, supportability, automation, and continuous improvement.
* pragmatic problem solver who can work through ambiguity and evolving cloud and ai technologies.

title: Software and Data Engineer - Software Engineer III- Agentic Pricing
description:
**job description**  
  
  

we have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
as a software engineer iii at jpmorganchase within the commercial and investment bank digital & platform services, data analytics, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. you are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

jpmorganchase is hiring top talent to join the growing commercial & investment bank technology organization within digital & platform services / data analytics, building production ai agents on neo that leverage the firm's scale, data, and full-service advantage to deliver measurable impact across the commercial & investment bank and payments. as a senior ai application engineer, you'll design, productionize, and operate llm-powered agents on neo (the firm's agent runtime paas on aws/azure), partnering closely with business, product, and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.  
  
**job responsibilities**

* design and ship production agents on neo across the federated portfolio, owning them from prototype through production.
* build retrieval that holds up in production: graph rag combining knowledge-graph traversal with vector search, plus chunking, ranking, and grounding strategies that keep answers accurate and auditable.
* design agent memory: episodic and semantic memory organized as memory nodes, with recall, summarization, and decay policies tuned per use case.
* own organizational context management — assembling entitlement-, lineage-, and tenant-aware context so each agent reasons over only what it's allowed to see.
* compose multi-agent workflows using a2a, and integrate tools and data through mcp servers (bitbucket, confluence, databricks, kubernetes, snowflake, splunk).
* build and run evals: task-level and end-to-end agent evaluations, regression suites, llm-as-judge, and quality/safety gating before release.
* deploy and operate solutions on public cloud (aws and, or azure) with strong sdlc, security, resiliency, and observability practices.
* partner with product and business partners across cib and payments to turn use cases into shipped, supported agents.
* proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

**required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience with working on ai/ml solutions.
* hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* advanced in one or more programming language(s) - strong programming skills in python, with deep knowledge of data structures, algorithms, machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, and statistics.
* hands-on experience building llm-powered or agentic applications in production, including tracing, evaluations, and guardrails.
* deep proficiency with kubernetes and amazon eks, micro-vm isolation (e.g., firecracker, kata containers, gvisor), and sidecar architectures, with proven experience designing defense in depth across the stack: network and mtls, workload identity, fine-grained authorization, runtime isolation for untrusted or adversarial workloads, and application-level guardrails
* practical rag experience — retrieval quality, embeddings, and vector stores; expert knowledge of at least one of: aws, azure, kubernetes.  
  knowledge of data management and data model design; real-time processing using  
  both sql (e.g., postgres) and nosql stores (e.g., opensearch, redis).
* excellent communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* proficient in all aspects of the software development life cycle
* advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as ci/cd, application resiliency, and security
* in-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their it systems

  **preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* ms in computer science, statistics, mathematics, machine learning, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* experience with agent frameworks or runtimes, a2a, or mcp. agent memory design (memory nodes, episodic/semantic memory) and organizational context management.
* knowledge graphs and graph databases used for retrieval. graph rag a strong plus.
* understanding of llm fine-tuning and small language model inference.
* ability to develop full-stack products using modern javascript/typescript frameworks (e.g., next.js, svelte) for agent uis (ag-ui , neo ui sdk).
* experience working in the financial or payments domain at a large institution (investment banking, markets, securities services, or adjacent).
* knowledge of high-performance languages such as go or rust

**about us**  
  
  

jpmorganchase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the j.p. morgan and chase brands. our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

jpmorgan chase & co. is an equal opportunity employer, including disability/veterans

  
  
**about the team**
  
  
j.p. morgan's commercial & investment bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. the commercial & investment bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
kensho is s&p global’s hub for ai innovation and transformation. with expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at s&p global and its customers worldwide. kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative ai applications, agents, data retrieval apis, data extraction, and much more.

at kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. we collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. we dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. as a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful.

kensho’s applications group develops the web apps and apis that deliver kensho’s ai capabilities to our customers. our teams are small, product-focused, and intent on shipping high-quality code that best leverages our efforts. we’re collegial, humble, and inquisitive, and we delight in learning from teammates with backgrounds, skills, and interests different from our own.

  

as a senior backend engineer, you will develop reliable, secure, and performant apis that apply kensho’s ai capabilities to specific customer workflows. you will collaborate with colleagues from product, machine learning, infrastructure, and design, as well as with other engineers within applications. you have a demonstrated capacity for depth, and are comfortable working with a broad range of technologies. your verbal and written communication is proactive, efficient, and inclusive of your geographically-distributed colleagues. you are a thoughtful, deliberate technologist and share your knowledge generously.

kensho states that the anticipated base salary range for the position is 150k–225k. in addition, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and equity plans. at kensho, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

**what you’ll do:**

* design, develop, test, document, deploy, maintain, and improve software
* manage individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
* work with key stakeholders to develop system architectures, api specifications, implementation requirements, and complexity estimates
* test assumptions through instrumentation and prototyping
* promote ongoing technical development through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship

**what you'll need:**

* at least five years of direct experience developing customer-facing apis within a team
* thoughtful and efficient communication skills (both verbal and written)
* experience developing restful apis using a variety of tools
* experience turning abstract business requirements into concrete technical plans
* experience working across many stages of the software development lifecycle
* sound reasoning about the behavior and performance of loosely-coupled systems
* proficiency with algorithms (including time and space complexity analysis), data structures, and software architecture
* at least one domain of demonstrable technical depth

**technologies & tools we use :**

* development: python, flask, fastapi, django rest framework, postgresql, celery, rabbitmq, redis, kafka, jsonnet, agentic coding tools (claude code, codex, cline)
* operations: aws, amazon eks, sentry, prometheus, git, jenkins, github actions

* 100% company paid premiums

title: Analytics Engineer, Data Platform
description:
proper hospitality builds and operates a growing collection of luxury lifestyle hotels, restaurants and residences defined by design, culture, wellness and a strong sense of place, across proper hotels, by proper and the collective.  
  
**position overview**  
we're seeking an analytics engineer to join our corporate team in los angeles. our warehouse and core raw pipelines are built. your job is to keep them healthy, make them easy to use, and strengthen the foundation for ai-native work like workflows and data agents.  
  
this is an end-to-end, full-stack role focused primarily on data pipelines and  
foundations, with a front-row lens into how the hospitality industry runs.  
  
***what you'll do***

**maintain & improve our pipelines (core of the role)**

* monitor, triage, and resolve data pipeline bugs and failures, and find root  
  causes rather than patching symptoms
* manage the intake and prioritization of data issues and requests, and keep stakeholders informed
* keep data models, tests, and documentation current so the warehouse stays trustworthy
* spot recurring failure patterns and build monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks to prevent them

**build internal tooling & infrastructure**

* design and deploy tools and infrastructure that let teams access and work with data in our data hub
* automate repetitive operational work (backfills, access provisioning,  
  validation, reconciliation)
* own the deployment and configuration of the supporting services behind  
  these tools

**build the foundation for ai-native work**

* make sure data is clean, well-modeled, secure, and documented enough to support ai workflows, data agents, ml, and advanced analytics
* partner with analysts, data scientists, and operators to productionize datasets, features, and agent-ready data
* help make ai tools usable and trustworthy for non-technical operators

**support stakeholders**

* respond to data requests from finance, revenue, marketing, operations, and property teams
* translate business questions into the right data answers, and know when  
  something needs a new model rather than a one-off query
* document institutional knowledge such as data quirks, definitions, and lineage

**occasional analytics work**

* build and maintain reports and dashboards as needed

**learn the business from the ground up**  
the best data work comes from understanding the operations behind the  
numbers. expect to:

* take part in site visits to our properties
* join training sessions and hands-on operator learning experiences
* spend time with the front desk, f&b, events, and revenue teams to see how the systems you support are used day to day

***what we're looking for***  
  
**ideal background**

* 3+ years of experience in data engineering, or 5+ years in data science or  
  analytics
* new grads 1-2 years of experience in a data or analytics role) will be  
  considered if they demonstrate extremely strong proficiency, extraordinary tenacity, and genuine humility

**required**

* strong sql and deep, hands-on experience with snowflake, including building and operating pipelines with orchestration (tasks, streams, dynamic tables, or an external orchestrator)
* experience building data pipelines and models that others depend on  
  python (or a comparable language) for tooling, automation, and pipeline work
* working knowledge of git and ci/cd, or a willingness to learn it quickly
* a methodical approach to debugging: you reproduce, isolate, and find the root cause
* strong fundamentals in coding and systems design that you can demonstrate without ai assistance
* clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and the judgment to manage competing requests

**nice to have**

* experience with a range of business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., tableau, looker, sigma, power bi)
* experience with our stack:
  + snowflake security and governance: rbac design, masking policies, row-level access, and data sharing
  + github actions for orchestration and deployment, alongside native  
    snowflake orchestration
  + transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt) and ingestion tools
  + python services deployed on a cloud hosting platform, and infrastructure as code
  + hospitality source systems: property management infor hms, f&b point of sale toast, sales crm, hr, and revenue management  
    experience building with llms, agents, ai-powered workflows, or internal data apps
  + data modeling and dimensional design, plus testing and observability practices

**what success looks like**

* first 30 days: take ownership of the issue queue and stakeholder requests. you learn the stack, visit a property, and become the person teams go to when something looks off.
* first 90 days: help generate new, value-additive work: new datasets,  
  analyses, or interactive data tools that give the business something it didn't have before.
* first 6 months: raise the quality of our data pipelines and make a major  
  change to our core snowflake platform to make it more scalable, with  
  improvements across data security, data modeling, cost management, or  
  rollout infrastructure.

**our interview process**  
we want to see how you think, so part of our process is a technical assessment  
completed without ai assistance. you should be able to work through a systems design discussion and a basic coding exercise on your own. we use ai heavily in our day-to-day work and expect you to as well, but strong fundamentals are what let you direct it well and catch it when it's wrong. beyond that, expect conversations about your past work and how you approach stakeholders and ambiguity.  
  
**logistics**

* in-person hybrid at our santa monica, ca office, 3 days per week
* occasional travel to our properties for site visits and training
* **compensation**: $140,000-160,000, based on experience and skills

  

***proper perks & benefits***

**culture of growth & belonging**

* **culture of growth**: a collaborative, design-forward environment that values creativity, intelligence, and curiosity — where learning and excellence are a daily practice.
* **guided skills development**: access to training, leadership programs, mentorship, and cross-property mobility to encourage achievement and discovery.
* **diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging**: we honor individuality while fostering a culture of respect and belonging across all teams.
* **community engagement**: opportunities to give back through local volunteerism, sustainability, and charitable partnerships.

**health & wellness**

* **comprehensive health coverage**: medical, dental, and vision plans through aetna, designed to fit a range of personal and family needs.
* **wellness access**: company-subsidized memberships with equinox and classpass, plus wellbeing
* workshops and mental health resources.
* **employee assistance program (eap)**: confidential support for emotional wellbeing, financial planning,
* and life management through unum.

**time off & flexibility**

* **paid time off**: flexible pto plus 11 paid holidays each year for corporate team members.
* **paid parental leave**: paid time off for eligible employees welcoming a new child through birth, adoption, or foster placement.
* **flexible work practices**: hybrid schedules for eligible roles and an emphasis on work-life balance.

**financial wellbeing & core protections**

* **401(k) program**: company match of 50% of employee deferrals, up to the first 4% of eligible compensation.
* **employer-paid life & disability insurance**: core protections with optional additional coverage.
* **financial education**: access to planning tools and workshops to support long-term stability and growth.

**lifestyle & travel perks**

* **hotel stay benefits**: 75% off bar (floor of $100) across the proper portfolio.
* **design hotels partnership**: 50% off participating marriott design hotels.
* **dining discounts**: 75% off food & beverage at all proper hospitality outlets.
* **lifestyle perks**: complimentary or subsidized parking, cell phone reimbursement, and exclusive hospitality and retail discounts.

**why join proper hospitality**  
at proper, we build experiences that move people — and that begins with the team behind them. as a best-in-class employer, we’re committed to creating one of the **best places to work** in hospitality by nurturing a culture where creativity, excellence, and humanity thrive together.

everything we do is grounded in the belief that hospitality is more than a profession — it’s an opportunity to care for others and make lives better.

guided by the **pillars of proper**, we show up with warmth and authenticity (care proper), strive for excellence in everything we do (achieve proper), think creatively and resourcefully (imagine proper), and take pride in the style and culture that make us who we are (present proper).

we believe our people are our greatest strength, and we invest deeply in their wellbeing, growth, and sense of belonging. from comprehensive benefits to meaningful development programs, proper is designed to help you build a career, and a life, that feels as inspiring as the experiences we create for our guests.

**our commitment: building the best place to work**  
our best place to work initiative is a living commitment — a continuous investment in our people, our culture, and our purpose. we listen, learn, and evolve together to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to imagine boldly, achieve confidently, care deeply, and present themselves authentically.

at proper, joining the team means more than finding a job — it means joining a community that believes in building beautiful experiences together, for our guests and for one another.

**equal opportunity & fair chance hiring**  
we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other federal/state protected category.

proper hospitality will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local fair chance hiring ordinances.

equal opportunity employer
