title: Senior Front-End and Agentic-UI Engineer
description:
**your future evolves here**

evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. we believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. that's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

join evolent for the mission. stay for the culture.

**what you’ll be doing:**

**job description**

**position summary**

the senior software engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the evolent platform. this role builds high-performance react and next.js (typescript) features and works closely with product managers, ux designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

this individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. the role is expected to use approved ai-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

**ai-assisted engineering expectations**

evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved ai-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. these expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with ai on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and responsible ai standards.

**key responsibilities**

**design and development**

* lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front-end features in react and next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.
* build server and client components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.
* implement backend-for-frontend (bff) endpoints and integrate with .net (c#) and python (fastapi) services, and entra id / openid connect authentication.
* build data-heavy screens, including large grids, pdf and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as kendoreact or mui.
* collaborate closely with product managers, ux designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning.

**agentic user experience**

* build streaming user interfaces (sse) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative ui using the vercel ai sdk, assistant-ui, and copilotkit over the ag-ui protocol.
* implement human-in-the-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including pydantic ai tool-approval interrupts.
* implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging.
* contribute to the ag-ui event contract and shared-state design with the agent team.

**engineering excellence**

* conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices.
* mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
* build accessible components that meet wcag 2.1/2.2 aa and section 508 and resolve accessibility defects.
* write component and end-to-end tests using vitest, react testing library, and playwright.
* identify and implement improvements to ci/cd pipelines, supply-chain controls, and opentelemetry instrumentation.
* troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience.

**ai-enabled delivery**

* utilize approved ai-assisted engineering tools, such as github copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
* evaluate and validate ai-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
* continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through ai-enabled workflows and automation.
* contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, and ai-assisted development patterns to benefit the team.

**governance and compliance**

* follow enterprise policies governing ai usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, phi handling, and responsible ai practices.
* handle patient data safely under hipaa, keeping phi out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.
* ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved ai services or tooling.
* participate in peer reviews and validation processes for ai-assisted solutions.

**required qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production web applications with react and typescript.
* hands-on experience with next.js, including server and client components, server-side rendering, and streaming.
* experience building streaming or real-time user interfaces using server-sent events or websockets.
* experience building data-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as kendoreact (telerik) or mui.
* experience integrating front ends with rest apis and backend services, including the backend-for-frontend pattern.
* experience implementing authentication with entra id (azure ad) and openid connect.
* strong knowledge of wcag 2.1/2.2 aa and section 508, with experience building accessible applications.
* experience with vitest or jest, react testing library, and playwright.
* experience with docker, ci/cd with github actions, and git-based workflows, including pull requests.
* strong, daily use of ai-assisted development tools such as github copilot.
* ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non-technical colleagues.
* excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
* strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation.

**preferred qualifications**

* hands-on experience with agentic ui frameworks and protocols such as ag-ui, copilotkit, assistant-ui, or the vercel ai sdk.
* experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for ai agents, including approval and override workflows.
* familiarity with python and pydantic ai.
* experience with fhir r4; da vinci prior authorization support (pas) a plus.
* experience consuming events from azure service bus or similar message brokers.
* experience with kubernetes (aks) and opentelemetry.
* experience with c# and .net.
* experience integrating ai services, models, or agents into production applications.
* healthcare domain experience, including handling phi under hipaa.

**education**

* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

to ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo id. we conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. all candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person i-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. the use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**technical requirements:**

we require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: high speed internet over 10 mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

title: Business Analytics Engineer Enterprise - Oahu
description:
we recognize our competitive advantage - our people. we believe in our people, who share our vision of meeting the needs of our employees, customers, and communities and who carry out the continued success of the company.

  

our employees are committed to the company's foundational values: integrity, excellence, teamwork, environmental stewardship, and community commitment. in turn, we invest in our employees, providing opportunities for challenge and advancement and offering a competitive compensation package.

  

applications will be screened based on the information provided; in order to assist us in determining qualifications, please upload a current resume and take some time to update your employment information, certifications, etc. the information will flow over to your profile.

  

posting end date: this position will remain open until filled. early applications are highly encouraged.

  

**brief posting description:**

the p eb enterprise data & analytics department of the p enterprise architecture & planning division at hawaiian electric company has 1 management vacancy available. (role: professional)

  

**job function:**

the business analytics engineer is a recognized subject matter expert in data analytics supporting the enterprise or specific domains by leading business analytics services and data-driven solutions through the data science disciplines. these roles focus on optimizing data models, business aggregate (“last mile”) data pipelines and leveraging data as a strategic enterprise asset to enhance business performance, process effectiveness, predict outcomes and develop business intelligence to support data driven decisions. these roles are able to tell the story of data, evangelize good data usage, advise, and teach while transforming data into information, information into insight and insight into business actions.

  

specific functional domain expertise may be required: this position works across all functional data domains and enterprise-wide across hawaiian electric company, hawaii electric light company and maui electric company (the companies).

  

**essential functions:**

* **data science & analytics:** extracts knowledge and insights from high volume, high dimensional data using advanced statistical analysis, algorithms, predictive modeling, experimentation and pattern recognition to create solutions that enable enhanced business performance.
* **data modelling & transformation**: converts existing or new models into scalable analytical solutions and creates processes for data modeling, mining, and production and applies software engineering best practices to analytics code to provide clean, transformed data ready for analysis.
* **machine learning:** provides support for developing machine models and research into new artificial intelligence applications.
* **data solution management:**
  + supports and/or leads the companies to timely deliver, manage, enhance and upgrade analytical solutions that increase business value, improve data reliability, efficiency, quality, useability and meet corresponding key performance indicators (kpis).
  + provides consulting and expertise for enterprise or domain specific strategy to understand business priorities, identify opportunities to leverage data, and provides leadership and direction to analytics teams and/or analysts to promote awareness and potential of the value proposition as use cases are developed and delivered.
  + researches opportunities for data acquisition and new uses for existing data, understands and identifies applications of data to the operation of the business, and work closely with data subject matter experts and data science teams to determine what data management systems are appropriate and what data is needed.
* **organizational data governance & capability development**
  + mentors and coaches employees within the department, in the data analytics community (such as data scientists, data analysts, business users or any data consumers), and across the organization in the adoption of new analytical tools, techniques, technology, information and in the use of business intelligence tools to enhance business decision-making capability.
  + proactively monitors industry, functional, and technology trends, guiding business partners on emerging opportunities and new technology/product development and maintains multi-year data analytic plans, roadmaps and strategy for leadership consumption.
* remain available for both scheduled and unscheduled work. said work is occasionally required outside normal business hours and on weekends.
* participates in company emergency response activities as assigned, including any activities required to prepare for such emergency response.

  

**basic qualifications:**

**knowledge requirements**

* a bachelor's degree in data analytics, data science, computer science, management information systems, business analysis, business management, engineering, finance, statistics, or related fields (or equivalent work experience) is required.
* requires thorough knowledge of business and data analysis, including working with unstructured data, in support of business data requirements elicitation, documenting, standardizing, validating and thorough to extensive knowledge of operations and delivery concepts, principles, standards, tools, techniques, methodologies for data analytics to solve complex problems.
* understanding of distributed computing, cloud technologies with azure experience preferred.
* familiarity with agile methodology, devops, and experience leading cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
* working knowledge of utility business, business and/or engineering principles & practices preferred.
* proficiency in key analytical tools: for example, pyspark (preferred), r, python/jupyter, sas, power bi, tableau, matlab, etc.
* strong knowledge of popular database programming languages including sql, pl/sql, for relational databases and upcoming nonrelational databases/distributed data/computing tools.
* thorough experience working with popular data discovery, analytics and bi software tools like power bi, tableau, and others for semantic-layer-based data discovery.
* experience in commercial/open-source data discovery/analysis platforms for “big data” with preference for: spark, databricks ml, with thorough knowledge and practical experience using databricks for machine learning/data science strongly preferred.
* working knowledge of statistical methods and data mining techniques (predictive modeling, segmentation, regression, etc.) and experience in working with data science teams in refining and optimizing data science and machine learning models and algorithms.

  

**skills requirements**

* demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills (effective written, oral and listening communication) in order to work effectively with all levels of the company and with outside contractors and consultants.
* demonstrated strong analytical skills and thorough data literacy with the ability to describe business use cases/outcomes, data sources and management concepts, analytical approaches/options and solve business problems with advanced analytical solutions.
* ability to communicate complex information to technical and non-technical audiences, facilitate multi-level briefings and superior presentation skills, including storytelling and other techniques to guide and inspire.
* ability to conceptualize new ideas quickly and ability to learn new technologies on the job.
* communicates difficult concepts and negotiate adoption of new perspectives across the enterprise while mentoring teams and facilitating knowledge transfer.

  

**experience requirements**

* extensive (7+ or more) years experience in data management disciplines including data integration, modeling, optimization, and data quality, and/or other areas directly relevant to data engineering and analytics.
* several (3-5) years experience with project management, working in cross-functional teams with business stakeholders, in support of multi-departmental data management and analytics initiatives is preferred.
* electric utility experience and azure, databricks, sap, big data, cloud based architecture experience is desirable.
* data analytics/product or industry certification is desired.

  

**role:** professional

**number of vacancies:** 1

**location:** honolulu – oahu

**hiring range:** the hiring range for the business analytics enginer [req id 10761] position is $123,000.00 to $159,800.00. the person selected will be placed according to his/her skills and qualifications.

title: Automation Software Engineer
description:
**description**

sanmina corporation (nasdaq: sanm) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global electronics manufacturing services (ems) market. we are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or ai/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

### **summary**

sanmina turtle lake, wisconsin is a full-service plastic injection molding, electronics integration and design service facility. they have 50 injection molding machines and expertise with engineering-grade resins. sanmina turtle lake has long standing business partnerships with both tool designers and manufacturers. as a software engineer on the automation team, you are expected to contribute to the evolution of our company’s smart factory initiatives, fostering innovation through advanced automation, analytics, and digital solutions. your responsibilities include building, deploying, and maintaining software solutions that bridge operational environments and enterprise it systems. these systems will be utilized by our manufacturing group for informed decision making. your daily activities include conducting factory assessments, defining scope of work, identifying missing data and hardware, and implementing various levels of coding and mes configuration to ensure accurate data flow from machines to the system.

automation software engineer

### **what you'll do**

* conduct plant surveys to evaluate the current automation landscape, identifying missing data points, hardware gaps, and network limitations required for mes deployment
* develop detailed design proposals that define the scope of work for mes production order control implementation
* collaborate proactively with multi-disciplinary teams
* develop and maintain 42q iot application modules
* contribute to the development of iot platforms
* participate in iot standardization discussions and planning (connectivity standards, web of things, etc)
* determine optimal communication routes for data transfer between machine/line control plcs, mes, and scada systems
* interface with instrumentation, sensors, and process control equipment to capture relevant production data
* validate and troubleshoot mes integration, ensuring accurate, real-time data flow from shop floor equipment to mes servers
* conduct thorough data validation tests to ensure collected information is accurate, reliable, and aligned with business requirements
* collaborate with software developers, digital transformation teams, and factory engineers to design and implement innovative solutions
* research and introduce new digital technologies, including ai-driven analytics, predictive maintenance solutions, and process automation enhancements

### **experience you'll bring**

* application & scripting development: design, write, and maintain clean, scalable, and modular code using object-oriented and scripting languages.
* system integration & networking: bridge technical gaps between plant operations and it by understanding network architecture, protocols, and constraints. provide technical guidance to it teams to prevent operational roadblocks.
* server & container management: deploy, configure, and manage applications using docker containers and standard linux server environments.
* database management: structure, query, and maintain relational databases supporting internal systems and operations.
* designs iot systems that analyze performance trends
* interface with departments to define and manage projects
* designing scada systems which may include databases and database interfaces, data handling & reporting, scripting (42q, vb, python, etc.) and general programming
* understanding project requirements to develop/configure industrial control packages for use in our manufacturing environment
* understanding technical and operational constraints to create projects and implementation plans
* documentation & record keeping: maintain excellent records and write comprehensive, easy-to-understand documentation for code, apis, and system configurations to ensure smooth transitions and clarity for future developers.
* troubleshooting & debugging: perform root-cause analysis on complex software and system issues to quickly identify and resolve bugs.
* cross-functional communication: gather and translate project requirements across diverse stakeholders, including global business systems, global security, global it, and local plant teams.

### **how to stand out**

* operating systems: strong proficiency in linux environments, as it will serve as the primary environment for programming, server management, and application deployment.
* programming languages: proficiency with object-oriented and scripting languages, specifically typescript, javascript, and python.
* databases: practical experience managing and querying relational databases (mysql, postgresql).
* containerization & devops: solid understanding of docker, writing dockerfiles, and managing multi-container applications with docker compose.
* version control: proficiency with git and platform workflows in gitlab (branching, merge requests, ci/cd pipelines).
* solid understanding of http requests, restful apis, and messaging protocols like mqtt.
* foundational knowledge of enterprise networking infrastructure, ip protocols, and network configuration principles to effectively interface with it teams.
* infrastructure: experience with linux-based server deployment, configuration, and continuous management.
* experience with java and/or c/c++.
* hand-on experience working in or interfacing with manufacturing plant environments.

education & experience:

* bachelor degree in computer science, computer/software engineering, automation or equivalent experience

### **why join us?**

at sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. this provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

sanmina is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Data Scientist
company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
description:
**job requirements**  

technology is at the heart of disney’s past, present, and future. disney entertainment and espn product & technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for disney’s media business globally.

the team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. we are storytellers and innovators. creators and builders. entertainers and engineers. we work with every part of the walt disney company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

* **building the future of disney’s media:** our technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* **reach, scale & impact:** more than ever, disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. disney+. hulu. espn. abc. abc news…and many more. these products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
* **innovation:** we develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

ad platforms is responsible for disney’s industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms.

the research/ai team is the dedicated ai/ml and data science arm of the ad platform organization. its mission is to advance ai and machine learning capabilities across ad platform by delivering scalable, high impact ai/ml and data science solutions that enhance ad decisioning, forecasting, experimentation and ad experience. we are seeking a senior data scientist to join this innovative team. this role is a great opportunity for a seasoned data science professional who thrives at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning, and business strategy. as a senior data scientist, you will spearhead ml and data science initiatives that shape the future of advertising technology. you will be responsible for designing and executing ml and data science solutions that drive measurable impact across ad decisioning, forecasting, experimentation, and user experience optimization, as well leading evaluation and optimization of generative ai mixed media advertisement creation and enhancement technologies.

**what you’ll do**

* drive innovation and apply data science and statistical analysis in a variety of areas to enhance every aspect of advertising serving, including inventory forecasting, ad experience, ad pacing, pricing, targeting, advertising creation and enhancement, and efficient ad delivery.
* translate business questions into data science framework; develop data analysis and ml models for complex ad challenges with fast turnaround.
* define and evaluate key metrics in various product areas.
* partner closely with generative ai specialists to support the creation of datasets for generative ai modeling applications.
* develop standard operating procedures for human-driven evaluations or labeling.
* deliver data insights and provide data-driven recommendations to cross-team stakeholders.
* design and analyze a/b tests for machine learning algorithm iterations.
* establish strong partnership with stakeholders, including product managers, engineers and program managers, in a collaborative environment.

**what to bring**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of relevant industry experience in data science at leading internet or technology companies. experience in the advertising domain is a strong plus.
* experience creating ml datasets and rigorous dataset labeling or evaluation processes for models.
* strong interest to learn about generative mixed media, generative video, and diffusion-based technology.
* solid knowledge of data science and statistics. strong communication skills and business acumen.
* proficient in sql, python, java, or r. familiar with tableau, and/or other visualization tools.
* experience designing and building machine learning models.
* passionate about understanding the ad business, applying data science to relevant business scenarios, and seeking innovation opportunities to enhance business effectiveness.
* interested in supporting rapid prototyping, generative ai, and creative technologies, including applications to advertisement creation and enhancement.
* experienced building data-driven services and applications for production.
* a proven track record of thriving in a fast-paced, data-driven, and collaborative work environment is required.

**nice-to-haves**

* masters or phd degree.
* experience in digital video advertising or digital marketing domain.
* experience in production-grade development, rapid prototyping, or generative ai related. research using llms, generative imagery or video, or agentic flows. otherwise a strong interest to learn.
* experience with airflow, data warehouse, databricks or sagemaker.

title: AI-Native Software Engineer - Consultant
description:
**xprize overview**

xprize is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. as a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. these competitions not only de-risk early-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real-world scale.

we operate across 5 areas of impact, including:

* deep tech + exploration
* energy + climate + nature
* food + water + waste
* health
* learning + society

**project description**

xprize is seeking an experienced ai-native software engineer to support the build of our new **prize execution platform** — a unified system replacing our current, fragmented set of tools and expanding significantly on what they do today. the platform will manage the full lifecycle of an xprize competition in a single ecosystem connecting four core user groups:

* **xprize staff**, who design and configure competitions, manage milestones and timelines, oversee submission intake, coordinate judging, and track prize disbursement.
* **competitors**, who register teams, submit applications and milestone deliverables, track their progress through the competition lifecycle, and receive ai-assisted matchmaking with relevant mentors.
* **judges**, who review and score submissions — supported by ai-assisted scoring and automated submission review tools that surface relevant context and flag issues before human review.
* **alumni**, who stay connected to the xprize ecosystem post-competition through community and continued-engagement features.

ai is embedded directly into the product, not just the development process. core ai-powered capabilities include:

* **ai-assisted judging and scoring** to support judges with consistent, efficient evaluation.
* **automated submission review** to pre-screen and triage incoming applications and deliverables.
* **competitor-mentor matchmaking** to connect competing teams with relevant subject-matter mentors.
* **an applicant-facing chatbot** to answer questions and guide competitors through the application and submission process.

this is a net-new platform, not a like-for-like migration — it will consolidate and significantly extend the capabilities of xprize's current tooling. the engagement will be built using spec-driven and ai-assisted development practices on a .net, angular/react, and python stack.

the ideal consultant can move quickly within a defined scope, work independently with minimal ramp-up, and deliver production-quality results on a set timeline — while also helping xprize's internal engineering team build lasting capability in ai-assisted and spec-driven development practices.

**scope of work:**

* design, develop, and deliver features and modules across the prize execution platform, including competition management, submission intake, judging/scoring, competitor and mentor matchmaking, and applicant-facing ai tools within the defined project scope, using .net, angular/react, and python as needed.
* collaborate with the internal product and engineering team to confirm requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria for the engagement.
* deliver clean, maintainable, and tested code that meets the quality, security, and testing criteria defined in the statement of work and the technical guidelines provided at kickoff.
* submit work product for xprize review at agreed milestones, and join technical planning and review sessions as needed to confirm requirements and acceptance criteria.
* use ai-assisted development tools (e.g., claude code, github copilot, or similar) as the primary development workflow — for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation.
* apply ai-first, spec-driven development practices, translating specifications into ai-assisted implementation, and document this workflow so it's reusable by the internal team after the engagement ends.
* evaluate and refine ai-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit.
* transfer knowledge to xprize's internal engineers — including training on ai-assisted and spec-driven development methods used on this project — as part of project deliverables.
* deliver clear technical documentation enabling the internal team to maintain and extend the solution post-engagement.

**qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent experience.
* minimum 4 years of hands-on experience developing full stack web applications, including prior consulting/contract engagements.
* demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on an existing codebase and deliver independently within a defined scope and timeline.
* hands-on experience using ai coding tools such as claude code, github copilot, cursor, or similar in a professional workflow, with concrete examples of impact on delivery speed and quality.
* demonstrated experience with ai-first, spec-driven development, with the ability to teach this approach to an internal team as part of a knowledge-transfer deliverable.
* ability to critically evaluate ai-generated code for security, performance, and architectural consistency.
* strong proficiency in .net technologies and python.
* proven experience with angular (v12+) or react w/ typescript.
* solid understanding of html5, css3, javascript, and typescript.
* proficiency with sql server or other relational database systems.
* familiarity with azure, git, and ci/cd pipelines (e.g., github actions, azure devops, or similar).
* able to deliver the milestones in the statement of work within the engagement timeline.
* excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day oversight.

**work arrangement**

this is a fully remote engagement. the consultant may work from any location within the united states, subject to applicable tax and legal requirements. the consultant determines when and where the work is performed. the consultant will attend milestone reviews and collaboration sessions, which are scheduled by mutual agreement and are expected to occur approximately 2-3 times per week. the consultant is expected to be reasonably responsive to xprize team communications during u.s. pacific business hours. expected effort is approximately 30-40 hours per week, not to exceed 40 hours without written approval.

**tools and access**

xprize will provide access to the ai-assisted development tools, repositories, cloud environments, and accounts needed for this engagement (including claude code, github, azure etc.). to protect xprize data and systems, the consultant will use xprize-provided tools and environments for all work involving xprize code, data, or confidential information, and will not input xprize confidential information into unapproved ai tools or services. the consultant is responsible for providing their own computer, internet connection, and general office equipment. access will be revoked at the end of the engagement.

**intellectual property and confidentiality**

all work product created under this engagement, including code, documentation, specifications, prompts, workflows, and training materials, will be owned by xprize and assigned to xprize under the consulting agreement. the consultant will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and ip assignment before starting work.

**independent contractor status**

the consultant will be engaged directly by xprize as an independent contractor and will receive irs form 1099. the consultant is not an employee of xprize and is not eligible for employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, or paid time off. the consultant is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and business expenses. the consultant controls the means and methods of their work, within the scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria agreed in the statement of work.

**compensation**

$75-85/hour based on skills and experience

please note: submitting a resume or proposal does not make you a candidate for engagement. you will be considered a candidate only after xprize contacts you directly to begin the engagement process, which may include interviews, a technical assessment, reference checks, and a background check where permitted by law. final engagement is contingent on execution of a written independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and ip assignment terms. xprize is an equal opportunity organization and considers all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

*note: if you experience any issues or errors while trying to submit your application, please try* ***clearing your cache and cookies*** *or* ***applying through a different browser*** *(for example, safari instead of google chrome).*

description:

san diego, ca, united states

energy systems

full time

**overview**
------------

### **about us**

we are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

as a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**about energy systems**

  
we help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. we do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. we also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

### **about the role**

the **senior data engineer** is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data services, apis, backend systems, and ai-ready data foundations that support scalable platform capabilities across digital & transformation.

working within the data & ai engineering section, this role contributes hands-on engineering expertise across python, sql, fastapi, data modeling, api development, and cloud-native platform technologies. the role supports both deterministic domain workflows through robust backend services and ai-enabled capabilities through clean, structured, searchable, and governed data foundations.

working closely with product, ai engineering, application engineering, solution engineering, platform reliability, architecture, and security teams, this role translates complex business and domain requirements into reliable, performant, secure, and maintainable software solutions.

the ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience delivering apis, backend platforms, data services, and cloud-based solutions within agile product development environments.

**this position will be in our san diego, ca; office, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a dnv office or client location/site. further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process. other dnv offices may also be considered.**

**what you'll do**

**software engineering & solution delivery**

* design, develop, test, and maintain apis, and platform capabilities that support product and engineering objectives.
* contribute hands-on engineering expertise across solution design, implementation, code review, testing, documentation, and production support.
* translate business requirements and domain expertise into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software solutions.
* follow and contribute to engineering standards for api design, data modeling, testing, observability, documentation, and maintainability.
* develop reusable services and components that enable consistent implementation across platform capabilities.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, high-quality, and reliable software solutions.
* support software solutions that enable applications, workflows, analytics, reporting, and ai-enabled capabilities.

**api development & platform integration**

* design and build python-based services and fastapi endpoints that expose platform capabilities and domain-specific functionality.
* develop reliable sql solutions for storing, querying, transforming, validating, and serving business data.
* collaborate with application engineering teams on api contracts, integration patterns, performance considerations, and system interoperability.
* implement secure, scalable, and maintainable apis that support internal and customer-facing applications.
* contribute to integration solutions connecting applications, data services, ai-enabled capabilities, and enterprise platforms.
* support adoption of reusable platform services, shared capabilities, and standardized integration patterns.

title: Sr. Data Scientist - Supply Chain
description:
are you a current us foods employee? please apply directly through our internal workday career site

join our community of food people!

the sr data scientist – supply chain role will lead forward-looking analytics initiatives across time series forecasting, supply chain demand, buying, and inventory optimization, including data exploration, decision modeling, statistics, measurement sciences, and machine learning operations. the main responsibilities include, but are not limited to, developing and productionalizing customized forecasting and optimization models that improve demand accuracy, inform buying decisions, and right-size inventory, while enhancing supply chain replenishment by balancing a breadth of constraints, variables, and cost considerations. this role requires a deep analytical, technical, and complex problem-solving skill set with expertise in time series forecasting, mathematical optimization, statistical analysis, and advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques.  
  
the sr data scientist proactively works with cross-functional teams to understand the business context of supply chain problems that may be solved using ml and optimization, and presents data science solutions to stakeholders in an iterative fashion. they work with associate data scientists, data scientists, and decision scientists to translate business challenges into well-structured forecasting, optimization, or ml problems, kickstarting foundational work including data exploration, feature engineering, hypothesis testing, and baseline modeling. they play a key role in selecting and implementing the appropriate analytical approach and create the model feasibility document in close collaboration with the team. the sr data scientist may have direct reports including associate data scientists and data scientists.

**the work for the sr data scientist position is completely remote anywhere in the united states except hawaii or united states territories.**

**responsibilities**

as a sr data scientist, you will be expected to:

* work with associate data scientists and data scientists in researching data sources, data cleansing, feature engineering, and creating baseline models
* independently lead the formulation and development of forecasting, optimization, and ml models while managing multiple model development projects
* design, implement, and refine advanced ml and deep learning models for both time series forecasting and optimization to solve large-scale, real-world supply chain demand, buying, inventory, and replenishment problems
* collaborate and engage with various cross-functional stakeholders to ensure close coordination between data science and business stakeholders including the product management team
* provide full ownership of the model development from inception to implementation including the machine learning pipeline, documentation, model drift, and remodeling strategy
* mentor the associate data scientists and data scientists in data science knowledge and their interactions with other stakeholders
* coordinate with the ml team, anticipating deployment issues upfront, setting the stage for resource requirements, and ensuring the success of model deployment and retraining
* take and delegate ownership of critical tickets or issues faced by business stakeholders as assigned by the lead data scientist or director of data science
* read and independently navigate through extensive codebase with a focus on troubleshooting, debugging, and/or improvement of code
* contribute to coding standards and coding conventions and proactively participate in enforcing sound coding practices across the data science team
* create and maintain documentation of the ml models, data sources, and methodology
* assist in the creation of feasibility documents
* proactively participate in the core team processes including r&d, recommending, and implementing process improvements or new methodologies
* share knowledge with other various teams and members by presentation at periodic internal team sessions/workshops
* guide usage of development methodologies (scrum, kanban, etc.) and assist in their implementation in the group projects by deciphering details including features, tasks, estimates of efforts and timing, etc.

**relationships**

* **internal:** associate data scientists, data scientists, lead data scientists, principal data scientists, and director of ds.

**minimum qualifications**

  

as a sr. data scientist, you have:

* master’s degree in data science/mathematics/cs/statistics or similar field and 3+ years of experience or bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in data science
* effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work and communicate effectively with team members and cross-functional teams
* an expert-level understanding of the following topics:
  + classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction, association rule learning, bagging (e.g., random forests), boosting (e.g., adaboost, gradient boosting), neural networks and deep learning, model evaluation and metrics, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, optimization algorithms, nlp and more

* working knowledge of agile/scrum methodologies with 1-2 years of experience and a practical understanding of the epics, features, and tasks that may be most relevant and how much effort is required for them
* sufficient intellectual curiosity to investigate the latest developments in the field (for example llm/generative ai models)
* ability to see the big picture and anticipate issues in terms of deployment limitations, data latency, appropriateness of a particular implementation of algorithms, and mathematical details/assumptions
* at least 1+ years of working with a major cloud platform, creating ml models using frameworks from data exploration to deployment
* working knowledge in handling large datasets in a cloud environment
* working knowledge of how apis work, ci/cd (continuous integration/continuous deployment)
* understanding of devops and mlops principles
* 1+ years of writing production-grade code in scripting languages including bash, python, and sql with the ability to identify the areas of improvement, optimal choice of data structures, optimization of the code, and creating custom code to address unique situations
* proven, independent ability to navigate a data lake environment while creating training datasets or feature stores
* effective skills in creating, deploying, and troubleshooting containers in the context of ml modeling
* 1+ years of experience with version control systems/concepts, such as git, for tracking changes in machine learning projects
* ability to investigate/research ml frameworks/algorithms, datasets, feature stores, and contribute to solving data science problems
* capability of providing macro-level thought leadership to the junior members including the data scientists regarding best practices, issues, causes, and respective resolutions of those issues

**preferred qualifications**

  

* 2 years of supply chain analytics experience, preferably in replenishment systems, time series forecasting, order optimization, network optimization, inventory management, and/or logistics

  

* preferred 1+ year of optimization & operations research experience with experience writing production-grade code in optimization modeling languages; gurobi, pyomo, pulp, etc.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
live events are fun.
  
  
concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact.
  
companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment.  
  
ticketmanager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization.
  
  
built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, ticketmanager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. our industry-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove roi and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences.
  
  
ticketmanager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including anheuser-busch, verizon, american express, nike, and visa, as well as fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the nba, nfl, ncaa, and nascar.  
  
we’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the new york jets, philadelphia eagles and phillies, capital one arena, texas rangers, lafc, and seattle seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers.  
  
**why work at ticketmanager**  
  
at ticketmanager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real-world problems for the world’s best companies. we’re a fast-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun.  
  
if you’re excited about live events, cutting-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here.  
  
**the role**  
  
ticketmanager is building its ai and automation infrastructure from the ground up, and we are looking for a partner to build it with. as an ai automation engineer, you will work directly with the vp of enterprise technology & ai strategy to turn ai strategy into working systems: n8n workflows, mcp servers, llm integrations, chat and voice agents, and ai-driven engineering automation that makes the whole team faster.  
  
this is not a role with a fully written roadmap. requirements are fluid, projects range from a one-afternoon automation to a multi-month platform build, and the technology changes monthly. you will break things and fix them faster, stay endlessly curious, and set your own priorities. when the first three approaches fail, you find the fourth, because we believe there is always a way. your work will directly shape how ticketmanager operates, serves customers, and scales.  
  
**responsibilities:**

* build, maintain, and measure workflow automations in n8n across crm, erp, support, and fulfillment systems, from first prototype through stable production
* build, maintain, and measure custom mcp servers that connect claude and other models to internal systems and data
* build and manage integrations with claude, gemini, and other model apis, including prompt engineering and structured outputs
* design agentic workflows where ai takes multi-step actions autonomously, and instrument them so we know when they work and when they don't
* build and maintain voice and chat agents for sales and support, and own the development of a full in-app chatbot
* use ai cli tools such as claude code and codex daily, and automate code review, testing, qa, and release pipelines
* work with data lakes on aws and azure to keep ai systems fed with clean, current data, with security (credential handling, access scoping, audit logging) as a default
* define success metrics before every pilot, track cost, performance, and adoption, and kill what doesn't work fast
* evaluate new models and tools as they appear, and recommend when to adopt, switch, or skip
* present your work to leadership and cross-functional teams, make the case for the technologies you believe in, and help non-technical colleagues put them to use

  
**desired skills and experience:**

* bachelor's degree required; ms in computer science, engineering, mis, or a relevant field is preferred
* 1-3 years of hands-on experience in automation engineering, systems integration, or a closely related technical role
* hands-on experience with ai cli tools such as claude code, codex, or similar, and with code automation and ai-assisted code review and qa
* real experience with n8n, make, zapier, or comparable orchestration tools, plus working knowledge of rest apis, webhooks, and json
* familiarity with llm apis (claude, gemini, or similar) and prompt engineering fundamentals
* a track record of solving problems nobody handed you a clean answer for; comfortable with fluid requirements and setting your own priorities
* strong communication skills: you can present an idea and persuade others to adopt a technology or approach
* visible evidence of constant learning, such as side projects and experiments you built to teach yourself
* nice to have: experience with mcp (model context protocol), or building chat and voice agents (vapi, deep chat, assistant-ui, or similar)
* nice to have: python or javascript, ci/cd and release automation (github actions or similar), aws or azure data lakes, rag and vector databases

  
**ticketmanager highlights:**

* **location:** calabasas, ca (hq)
* **compensation:** $95,000 - $125,000 base salary + variable compensation
* **reports to:** vp, enterprise technology & ai strategy
* **work** **expectations**: role is in-office, monday-friday
* **retirement:** 401(k) & company match
* **health benefits**: medical, dental, vision & chiropractic
* **time off:** unlimited pto
* **interview process:** multistage interview process with senior leaders across ticketmanager to ensure strong alignment on role scope and expectations.
* **events:** quarterly live event credits (we practice what we preach!), monthly happy hours, and volunteering
* **perks:** fun, collaborative, in-office culture at our hq with catered lunches and big company perks with the autonomy of a high-growth startup
* **recognition:** inc. 5000 fastest-growing private company by inc. magazine six years in a row. recognized as one of the best places to work by inc. magazine, the la business journal, and sports business journal
* 4.5 out of 5 glassdoor rating
* used by over 4,000 globally known companies including ~15% of the fortune 500

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
**summary**
-----------

**the opportunity**

hyatt hotels corporation seeks an enthusiastic sr. ai/ml engineer to join our data and analytics department. in this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader machine learning and ai team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make hyatt a leading hospitality company. you will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

  

**who we are**

at hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

as we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: people. we turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

  

**why now?**

this is an exciting time to be at hyatt. we are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. the hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and hyatt is no exception.

  

**how we care for our people**

what sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the hyatt family. our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. we’re proud to have earned a place on fortune’s prestigious *100 best companies to work for®* list since 2013. this recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

  

we’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

* annual allotment of free hotel stays at hyatt hotels globally

* flexible work schedule

* work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center

* a global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption

* paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company match

**who you are**

as our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing. you enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

  

**the role**

the senior ai/ml engineer builds and operates the shared platforms that ai product engineering teams use to develop and run ai applications, agents, and models. this is a hands-on role focused on reliable, reusable, self-service capabilities that cut duplicated effort and shorten the path from experimentation to production, with internal engineering teams as the customers.

  

the role delivers scalable ai/ml platforms, including runtimes, orchestration, tool and enterprise system integration, evaluation, and observability, and the real-time serving systems delivered as apis: supporting products including recommendation engines, information retrieval and search, and other ml and ai backends. shared services include inference, model deployment pipelines, feature stores, and embedding and vector search services, covering the model and agent lifecycle from versioning through deployment and monitoring. system design is central: defining service boundaries, apis, and data flows, and making sound tradeoffs across scalability, latency, reliability, security, and cost.

  

the engineer contributes directly to architecture, python development, code reviews, and production problem solving across aws and gcp, partnering with product engineering, data, infrastructure, and security teams. success is measured by adoption and reliability of the platform and by how consistently product teams ship to production.

**qualifications**
------------------

**experience required:**

  

* 7+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-based environments, with a focus on ai engineering, machine learning engineering, platform engineering, or distributed systems, including hands-on ownership of production services.
* demonstrated experience designing, developing, deploying, and operating shared platforms, reusable services, or developer tools consumed by multiple engineering or data science teams.
* strong experience with end-to-end system design, including translating technical requirements into architectures, apis, service interfaces, integration patterns, and production implementations.
* experience building and operating production ai or machine learning systems, including agent-based applications, model serving, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, or enterprise integrations.
* experience working independently on complex technical problems, making engineering tradeoffs, and taking accountability for services from initial design through production operations and ongoing improvements.
* experience collaborating across engineering, data, infrastructure, security, and product teams to deliver scalable and reliable technical solutions.
* master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* strong system design skills, including distributed systems, service boundaries, apis, design patterns, data flows, and engineering tradeoffs across reliability, performance, scalability, security, and cost.
* strong python development skills, including experience building production services, reusable libraries, apis, sdks, and developer tools.
* experience developing ai agent systems using agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks, tool integrations, memory and context management, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
* experience with shared ai infrastructure, including real-time and batch inference services, embedding services, vector databases, model deployment pipelines, and feature stores.
* solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and lifecycle capabilities, including model training and serving, registration, versioning, validation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and explainability.
* experience with aws and gcp, including strong hands-on production expertise in at least one. familiarity with managed ai and machine learning services such as vertex ai, gemini, or equivalent technologies.
* experience with docker, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and ci/cd practices for building and operating production services.
* experience with sql and batch or streaming data processing architectures. familiarity with pyspark, streaming ingestion, online feature serving, or distributed data processing preferred.
* experience with service and ai observability, including logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and agent or llm evaluation tools such as datadog, arize, or equivalent technologies.
* familiarity with agent interoperability and tool integration protocols such as model context protocol (mcp), agent-to-agent (a2a), or equivalent frameworks preferred.
* experience with recommender systems, ranking systems, forecasting, experimentation platforms, or real-time decisioning systems preferred.

  

the position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

  

**we welcome you:**

research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? apply. we’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make hyatt even better.

the salary range for this position is $133,200 - $173,000

the final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

*we value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.*

title: Co-op- Robot Manipulation
description:
**who we are**

with its a.i.-powered robotic technology platform, symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**title:** co-op- robot manipulation

  

**term:** spring (jan- may 2027)

  

at symbotic, early career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. through our internship and co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. we are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

  

along the way, interns and co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

  

continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

  

**what you'll do**

* brainstorm with engineers on cross-functional teams to conceptualize and develop real-time high-performance software to manipulate real-world objects with high accuracy.
* apply best practices to the design of data structures and algorithms. strive for both simplicity and performance.
* produce high-quality software contributing to projects that have a significant impact on the business.
* simulate robot motion using internal simulation tools during feature development.
* develop motion planning algorithms and state machines for robotic manipulators.
* design, develop, and implement control software for specialized end-of-arm tools and grippers.
* define metrics for pick and place quality in the field with different sensors and cameras.
* work broadly across teams to facilitate integration of specialized manipulation systems from hardware to software.
* optimize processes using data-driven and machine learning, with ownership from data curation and training to inference.
* support system testing of systems and subsystems.
* provide technical support for hardware design as needed.
* troubleshoot system problems in production or design by investigating issues related to product performance or production difficulties.
evaluate and process engineering change requests  

  

**what you’ll need**

* pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, robotics, engineering or related field.
* experience with general-purpose programming environments, languages and scripting systems, data analysis packages: linux, c++, python, matlab.
* knowledge of git, jira, and confluence or similar tools.
* familiarity with devops or ci/cd – github automation and docker or jenkins.
* experience with simulation tools such as mujoco, nvidia isaacsim, pybullet.
* familiarity with forward kinematics and inverse kinematics for custom kinematic chains.
* strong linear algebra and 3d geometry fundamentals.
* familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and libraries
* experience with libraries such as ompl, openrave, nvidia curobo, opencv, pcl, ros, boost, eigen.
* hands on experience with embedded systems and platforms like arduino, stm32, esp32 or raspberry pi. integrating sensors, motors and actuators using can, spi, i2c.
* preferred experience with either of the following: motion planning algorithms, trajectory optimization and grasping.
* you are interested in working in a dynamic agile/scrum based environment.
you possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms.  

  

**our environment**

* up to 10% of travel may be required. employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.
* the employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.

**about symbotic**

symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, ai-powered robotic and software platform. symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. as the backbone of commerce the symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. for more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

title: Senior Associate, Full-Stack Engineer
description:
bny's wove trading & rebalancing team builds and operates the technology platform behind pershingx — the digital investing, trading, and portfolio management experience for wealth management firms, advisors, and asset managers.

the platform spans 50+ microservices and microfrontends processing portfolio rebalancing, order generation, trade execution, sleeve allocation, tax harvesting, and investment operations across multiple custodians and investment products (sma, urpm, uma). our users range from individual financial advisors managing client portfolios to large-scale asset managers executing firm-wide model changes across thousands of accounts.

we ship production code daily across a polyglot stack: angular microfrontends (module federation), a nestjs graphql bff, java 21 / spring boot 3.x backend services, and kafka-driven event pipelines — all deployed on bny's cloud-native app engine infrastructure. we use ai-assisted engineering practices to accelerate the full software development lifecycle.

**the role**  
we are looking for a vice president, full-stack engineering lead in new york city to own the technical direction, delivery, and operational health of the wove trading & rebalancing platform.
  
this is a hands-on leadership role. you will write code, review architecture, lead incident response, and mentor engineers, while also driving the strategic roadmap with product and business stakeholders. you will be responsible for a platform that must be correct (it moves money), resilient (market hours are non-negotiable), and scalable (the client base is growing rapidly across multiple wealth management firms).

**architecture & system design**

* own the technical roadmap for the trading & rebalancing platform — from rebalancing compute engines and order generation pipelines to advisor-facing trading dashboards.
* design and evolve a multi-personal, multi-custodian entitlements architecture that supports advisors, home office users, portfolio managers, and asset managers — each with distinct data hierarchies, trading discretions, and custody constraints.
* drive the "one bff" initiative: consolidating functional and data entitlements resolution into a unified nestjs graphql middleware layer using strategy patterns, guard chains, and per-persona data scoping.
* make architecture decisions across the full stack — angular microfrontends, nestjs services, spring boot microservices, kafka consumers/producers, hazelcast distributed caching, and the datalake api persistence layer.

**full-stack engineering**

* build and maintain high-performance backend services in java 21 / spring boot 3.x — order generation engines, rebalancing workflows, allocation services, validation engines, custodian rules engines, and trade automation pipelines.
* develop and extend angular microfrontends using module federation — trading worksheets, order review screens, overview dashboards, trading rules configuration, tax harvesting, sleeve allocation, and custom rebalance uis.
* design and operate a nestjs graphql bff that resolves entitlements from ems and admin center, orchestrates downstream service calls, and delivers persona-aware data to the frontend.
* implement secure service-to-service communication using mtls certificates, oauth2/jwt, and kerberos authentication — all integrated with bny's api gateway and marketplace token exchange.
* trading & rebalancing domain
* deliver capabilities for portfolio rebalancing workflows, model management, proposed order generation, order review, and order submission — supporting equities, fixed income, and multi-asset sleeve strategies.
* build systems that handle multi-custodian complexity: pershing, schwab, and bank custody-including cross-hierarchy custodian bindings where different firms route through different custodians.
* implement per-client trading discretion configuration (e.g., one firm can trade true uma while another is restricted to sma/urpm only).
* ensure platform compliance with regulatory, audit, and risk requirements in a financial services environment.

**ai-enabled engineering**

* champion ai-assisted development across the sdlc- design, coding, testing, code review, documentation, and production support.
* drive engineering productivity through ai-powered tools for automated test generation, release impact analysis, and incident root cause identification.
* lead adoption of agentic ai workflows that integrate with the team's existing ci/cd, sonarqube quality gates, and gitlab pipelines.
* **operational excellence**
* own production readiness across the service catalog -availability, resiliency, observability (splunk, dynatrace), and platform health.
* lead major incident resolution and root cause analysis. market-hours downtime is not acceptable.
* reduce operational burden through automation, intelligent monitoring, and self-healing patterns.
* drive continuous improvement in deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to recovery.

**people leadership**

* lead and mentor engineers across frontend, backend, bff, and platform disciplines.
* foster a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, and continuous learning.
* support hiring, talent development, and organizational growth.

**required qualifications**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time designing and delivering distributed systems in financial services.
* deep hands-on expertise in at least two of the following, with working knowledge of all:
* java 17+ / spring boot 3.x -microservices, virtual threads, security filter chains
* angular 15+ -component architecture, signals, module federation / microfrontends
* nestjs / typescript- graphql resolvers, guards, interceptors, strategy patterns
* strong experience with event-driven architectures — kafka producers/consumers, async messaging, dead-letter queues, idempotent processing.
* experience with nosql persistence (mongodb or document stores) data modeling, query optimization, api-mediated access patterns.
* solid understanding of authentication and authorization in enterprise environments — oauth2, jwt, mtls, kerberos, entitlements systems.
* experience building multi-tenant or multi-persona platforms where different user types see different data, have different permissions, and follow different workflows.
* proven track record of leading agile engineering teams and delivering in a ci/cd environment with automated quality gates (sonarqube, security scanning).
* strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with wealth management, trading, or portfolio management platforms — rebalancing, order management, custody, or investment advisory systems.
* experience modernizing monolithic applications into microservices using the strangler pattern.
* familiarity with distributed coaching (hazelcast, redis) and real-time data patterns (websockets, sse).
* experience with observability platforms — splunk, dynatrace, appdynamics, or opentelemetry.
* experience implementing ai-assisted software development practices and engineering automation.
* knowledge of cloud platforms, container orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code.
* experience managing geographically distributed teams.
* series 7 / series 63 or cfa/caia is a plus but not required.
* advanced degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or a related field.
