title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**who we are**

digicert is a global leader in intelligent trust. we protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. our ai-powered digicert one platform unifies pki, dns, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, ai content and agents. learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the fortune 500, choose digicert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**job summary**

**this position is for the ssl store, powered by digicert**

we are hiring a senior software engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, tls and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. the platform is a typescript monorepo: fastify and express services, next.js and react frontends, mysql and redis, queues and workers on aws, deployed to kubernetes through terraform, helm, and azure devops pipelines. it also carries a legacy .net estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of ai-assisted features and internal tooling.

you will own features end to end, from schema and api through ui, pipeline, and production. we work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

**what you will do**

* design, build, and ship features across the full stack: fastify or express apis, next.js and react frontends, mysql schemas and migrations, sqs-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
* own services in production: observability with sentry and grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
* build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
* maintain and incrementally retire legacy .net and python components, moving behavior into the typescript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
* extend ci/cd and infrastructure: azure devops pipelines, docker images, helm charts, and terraform for eks, rds, sqs, and related aws services.
* integrate third-party and partner apis (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
* use ai-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build ai-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
* review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and ai-generated code alike.
* mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

  

**what you will have**

* 6+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them.
* strong typescript and node.js, including a modern api framework (fastify preferred, express acceptable) and a react framework (next.js preferred).
* production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. depth in a single language is not enough for this role.
* solid relational database skills on mysql or postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior.
* comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence-led debugging in production.
* security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
* clear written communication. you can explain a design, a trade-off, or an incident to engineers and non-engineers.

  

**nice to have**

* hands-on aws (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change terraform.

* oauth 2.0 and openid connect implementation experience, especially multi-tenant identity providers.
* c# and .net, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home.
* python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling.
* large-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them.
* building with llm apis, mcp servers, or agentic workflows in a product context.

title: ML Engineer, Agentic Systems
description:
viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. with our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

  

**job summary**

we are hiring an ml engineer to build production agentic applications that automate complex geoscience workflows. you will design agent-based systems, integrate tools and external apis, implement persistent state management, provide agents with the right context, and deliver well-tested services with lightweight web interfaces for operators and end users.

  

beyond implementation, you will help shape what these applications do: which workflows to automate, where people stay in the loop, and how results are presented and verified. you will also be responsible for designing and executing llm fine-tuning strategies when model adaptation is required.

  

**about the team**

we work together to build high-impact tools and platforms that drive innovation – from scientific seismic algorithms to data visualization tools to intuitive web apps. combining our expertise across regions to drive innovation and impactful results. our team values collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, and we take pride in supporting each other to achieve shared goals.

**key responsibilities**

* shape the application logic and user experience: define what a good result looks like, remove what does not help users decide, and make outputs easy to verify.
* design agent workflows with branches, loops, sub-workflows, and explicit routing, choosing the simplest structure that solves the problem.
* implement human-in-the-loop approvals, and decide which actions an agent may take on its own.
* give agents the right context: tool-based search over files, logs, code, and databases, using text search, sql, and semantic retrieval where appropriate.
* ground answers in cited evidence, enforce tool permissions, and guard against prompt injection and unsafe actions.
* integrate tools and external apis. handle concurrency, retries, and error paths.
* add database-backed persistence. ensure workflows can pause and resume reliably.
* design and execute llm fine-tuning strategies when needed: data curation, supervised fine-tuning with parameter-efficient methods such as lora, preference optimization (e.g., dpo), reinforcement learning methods such as grpo with verifiable rewards, evaluation sets, and rollback criteria.
* instrument agent runs with tracing and continuous evaluation, making decisions and actions auditable and detecting quality regressions early.
* deliver production-ready services with automated tests and ci/cd, and expose apis where other teams or systems need them.
* collaborate with domain experts, product, and engineering. present clear design docs and trade-offs.
leverage ai coding agents such as claude code or codex effectively and responsibly: plan and direct their work, review and test what they produce, and stay accountable for every change that ships.  

  

**qualifications:**

***required:***

* bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, physics, mathematics, geophysics, or a related field.
* strong academic performance, including a minimum cumulative gpa of 3.5 on a 4.0 scale for all earned degrees. equivalent academic grading systems will be considered for degrees obtained outside the u.s.
* strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, including asynchronous and concurrent programming.
* sound design and product judgment: you can explain why a system is built the way it is, what was left out, and how its quality is measured.
* hands-on experience building multi-agent or graph-based llm workflows, using established frameworks or custom implementations.
* experience designing how agents find information: tool-based search over files, logs, and databases, and semantic retrieval with reranking when needed.
* practical llm fine-tuning experience: parameter-efficient methods such as lora, dataset preparation and quality assurance, offline and online evals; a working understanding of rl-based fine-tuning and reward design.
* experience with tracing and evaluation of llm applications.
* experience building web services and apis (e.g., fastapi), and working with postgresql, docker, and git.
* ability to harness ai coding agents such as claude code or codex: understand how they work, break down tasks, guide their execution, critically review their output, recognize failures, and take ownership of the resulting code.

***preferred:***

* experience designing complex agent systems, including task decomposition, parallel execution, result aggregation, and human-in-the-loop orchestration.
* hands-on experience with llm post-training techniques (e.g., dpo, grpo), including reward design for verifiable outcomes and multi-step tool use.
* experience running enterprise-scale applications in production, including retries, idempotency, timeouts, and rate limits.
* prior work in workflow automation; exposure to geoscience or scientific computing is a plus.
* frontend experience building lightweight operator dashboards.

**houston benefits:**

* 401k retirement plan - when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2%
* free on-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes
* short-term disability and long-term disability coverage at no cost to you
* parental leave program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child
* pet insurance – options to meet every budget
wellness program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly.

due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. we do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
### **when you join verizon**

you want more out of a career. a place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. at verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. we do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. our v team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. in crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. want in? join the #vteamlife.

we are seeking an **agentic ai engineer** to architect and implement autonomous, multi-agent workflows that go beyond static text generation. you will be responsible for building reliable agentic systems that interface with enterprise databases, execute real-world apis, manage long-term state, and operate safely within strict performance and governance guardrails.

you will be responsible for the following but not limited to:

* **agent architecture & orchestration:** design stateful, multi-step agentic workflows using reasoning frameworks (e.g., react, plan-and-solve, reflection).
* **tool & api integration:** build reliable execution layers connecting llms to external systems via rest apis, database connectors, and protocol standards like **model context protocol (mcp)**.
* **context & memory management:** implement short-term and long-term memory architectures, state persistency, context window optimization, and hybrid rag retrieval layers.
* **evaluation & guardrails:** establish offline test sets ("golden sets") and real-time observability pipelines (using llm-as-a-judge, trace analysis, and latency/cost monitoring) to prevent hallucinations, infinite loops, and unwanted drift.
* **production deployment:** containerize and deploy multi-agent microservices using scalable async patterns, distributed queues, and fallback mechanisms.

**what we’re looking for...**

you thrive on creating smart, customer-centric solutions that simplify user interactions and deliver immediate answers. your expertise allows you to build secure, scalable ai frameworks using established software engineering practices, ensuring smooth integration with downstream enterprise tools. as a trusted engineer, teams rely on you to navigate challenging obstacles in nlp, ai integration, and search relevance. by combining deep technical proficiency in ai with an analytical, collaborative mindset, you will directly enhance our user journey.

**you’ll need to have:**

* bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* experience building **multi-agent systems** with complex delegation models (human-in-the-loop escalation paths).
* hands-on experience developing enterprise-grade agentic workflows, multi-agent topologies, and task orchestration pipelines using platforms such as **langgraph**, **google adk / ces**, **sierra**, **decagon**, or similar
* experience with large language models (llms), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (rag) architectures, and generative ai guardrails.

**even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related technical field.
* experience in programming in modern languages (python, java, nodejs) for building custom fulfillment webhooks, microservices, and backend apis.
* experience implementing vertex ai search / enterprise search, grounding models, custom data store connectors, and tuning search relevance and rankings.
* experience integrating google ai solutions with non-google enterprise architectures via rest/soap apis, pub/sub messaging, and webhook integrations.
* knowledge of contact center integrations (telephony adapters, crm platforms like salesforce/genesys, and live agent hand-off protocols).

if verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **where you’ll be working**

in this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

### **scheduled weekly hours**

40

### **equal employment opportunity**

verizon is an equal opportunity employer. we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
altana is the network for trusted trade. our ai-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

**the opportunity at altana**

the engineering team is responsible for building out the product for bringing this vision to life. we are creating a platform fundamentally driven by ai, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions.

shipping products that customers actually adopt, not just products that ship, takes a particular kind of engineering practice. it means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. it means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. it means reaching for ai as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. and it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later.

as a senior engineer at altana, that's the work and you'll lead others doing it. you'll embed with product and design, get on calls with users, form hypotheses about where the real pain is, and lead a small team turning those hypotheses into shipped, adopted products. you'll measure your work in customer outcomes, not commits.

  

**you will**

* **spend real time with customers.** sit alongside them in their workflows, watch where they get stuck, and translate what you learn into product bets your team is willing to ship behind.
* **partner with the product team to decide** ***what*** **to build, not just** ***how***. form hypotheses about customer value, design the smallest experiment that could prove them out, and learn fast. push back on briefs that aren't grounded in evidence.
* **take new product surfaces from 0 to 1.** pitch, prototype, ship, and drive adoption with real users. you are as fluent in "did this land?" as you are in "is this maintainable?"
* **build ai‑native by default**. llms, agents, evals, retrieval, and modern ai tooling are first‑class building blocks in your stack, not bolt‑ons. you make principled choices about where ai changes the product equation and where it doesn't.
* **own end‑to‑end outcomes**. from the first customer conversation to telemetry on the dashboard six months later — including the architecture and instrumentation choices that make that telemetry meaningful.
* **set the technical bar for your team**. review designs and code with a high standard for quality, simplicity, and customer impact, and a low tolerance for engineering work that can't be traced back to a customer outcome.
* **mentor engineers in customer‑centric, hypothesis‑driven product development**. help them build the instincts to talk to users, run experiments, and tell when a feature is done because it's loved, not because the ticket is closed.
* **drive technical decision‑making with a bias toward shipping**. choose practical, iterative designs that get a working version in front of customers fast, then evolve them as you learn.

**you have**

* you've deployed production code and services to cloud-hosted environments.
* you have demonstrated experience delivering incremental releases from proof-of-concept to mvp to production.
* self-starter with demonstrated experience working on large, complex problems.
* you care deeply about engineering excellence, clean code, and knowledge-sharing.
* you have strong written and verbal communication skills.
* experience leading other engineers on complex projects.

**nice to have, but not required**

* experience with python machine learning toolsets (numpy, pandas, dedupe).
* experience with container technologies like docker and kubernetes.

**technologies we love to use at altana**

* languages: python, pyspark
* tools: docker, git, kubernetes, swagger/openapi, aws/azure, mlflow, celery
* datastores: databricks and delta lakes

**this role is based in brooklyn, ny, usa with hybrid work flexibility and candidates must be within commuting distance from our williamsburg, brooklyn office**

**us salary range and benefits**

$170,000 - $200,000 usd

the salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position. the base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of altana's total compensation package. altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. additionally, altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

* flexible time off: altana operates with a flexible time oﬀ (fto) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.
* parental leave: we oﬀer industry leading paid parental leave (ppl), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.
* health benefits: we have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your health savings account (hsa). there is also a flexible spending account (fsa) option.
* supplemental benefits: altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and ad&d insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.
* 401(k) savings: save for and invest in your future using our guideline 401(k) retirement savings program.
* commuter benefits: save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!
* wellness: because we value mental and emotional health, every altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.
* pet insurance: pets are family too! keep them healthy with wishbone insurance and / or our total pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.

the recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

### **our values**

our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.they form the foundation of altana's culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

* **trust:** our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. we honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. we rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
* **resilience:** in a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. it's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
* **stewardship:** we are stewards of every mission we touch. because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. we believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. and we are stewards of the greater good of the company. by holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
* **courage:** courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. it's the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. we know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. courage fuels our growth mindset. it means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it's demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

title: AI Solutions Engineer (ITS Architect III)

**caloptima**

we are hoping you will join us as a **ai solutions engineer (its architect iii)** and help shape the future of healthcare where you'll be an integral part of our **it - data warehouse and analytics technology** team, helping to strive for excellence while we serve our member health with dignity, respecting the value and needs of each of our members through collaboration with our providers, community partners and local stakeholders. this position has been approved to be **full telework**.  
  
  

* *if telework is approved, you are required to work within the state of california only and if partial telework, also come in to the main office in orange, ca, at least two (2) days per week minimum.*

  
  
the ai solutions engineer will serve as the primary technical resource for the organization's enterprise ai program, taking approved use cases from concept to production deployment. following a build-and-buy approach, you will configure and extend vendor and embedded ai capabilities and develop targeted internal solutions where appropriate. for internal builds, you primarily leverages the microsoft ai ecosystem (copilot studio, azure ai, and power automate), grounding solutions in governed data from the organization's cloud-native enterprise data platform. partnering closely with the ai solutions analyst, the incumbent will own technical build, deployment, and production reliability. you will also contribute to the program's shared ai platform foundation by building reusable components, integration patterns, and engineering standards that let the program scale. partnering with enterprise architecture as a technical collaborator and with cybersecurity, the ai solutions engineer will keep solutions within enterprise security and data-governance boundaries. together, we are building a stronger, more equitable health system.

  + partners with the ai solutions analyst on user acceptance testing and quality assurance, focusing on technical deployment and production readiness.
  + owns the operational lifecycle of deployed ai solutions, monitoring performance and output quality, detecting changes in model behavior and prompt or retrieval-quality degradation, managing versions, and leading incident response.
  + partners with enterprise architecture as a technical collaborator on complex builds, keeping solutions aligned with the organization's platform strategy and architectural standards.
  + partners with cybersecurity from use case intake through production deployment, designing ai workflows that keep member data within approved enterprise boundaries and applicable vendor agreements.

10% - other
completes other projects and duties as assigned.  

  
  
**do you have what the role requires?**  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field, plus 5 years of professional experience in technical implementation, software development, or ai and automation platform deployment required; an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position such as those listed above may also be qualifying.
* 2 years of hands-on experience building, deploying, or integrating ai or large language model solutions in a production environment required.
  

  
  
**you'll stand out more if you possess the following:**  

* demonstrated experience building ai agents, automation workflows, or llm-based solutions using microsoft-native tooling including copilot studio, power automate, azure ai document intelligence, or azure ai foundry.
* experience with azure openai service including prompt engineering, rag pipeline design, and grounding llm solutions in enterprise data.
* experience with intelligent automation in an enterprise environment.
* healthcare payer domain knowledge including familiarity with claims, eligibility, prior authorization, or care management data and workflows.
* experience working within a government cloud or other highly regulated cloud environment with strict data governance, compliance, and security requirements.

* familiarity with microsoft 365 copilot and the broader microsoft ai ecosystem as it applies to enterprise productivity and workflow automation.
  

  
  
**what the regulatory agencies need you to possess?**

**your knowledge & abilities to bring to this role:**

* work independently and exercise sound judgment.

title: Senior BI Platform Operations Engineer
description:
##### **project description**

we are looking for a hands-on bi platform operations engineer to provide production operational support, administration, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting for our enterprise business intelligence platforms and associated aws services.
  
the role will primarily support tableau and amazon quicksight / amazon quick suite, including a custom bi-as-a-service (biaas) platform built on top of amazon quicksight. the biaas platform consists of multiple backend services, restful apis, aws serverless and data services, and a web-based user interface.
  
this is primarily a platform engineering and production support role, rather than a dashboard/report development position. the successful candidate will be comfortable troubleshooting across bi, application, api, data, ai-assisted analytics, and cloud infrastructure layers and working with engineering teams to maintain a reliable and stable production service.
  
for canada this role is for subcontractor.
  
for nyc: compensation 90000-115000 uas gross per year and based on your interview results.

##### **responsibilities**

production operations & support

* provide day-to-day production operational support for tableau, amazon quicksight / quick suite, the bi-as-a-service platform, and its supporting aws services.

* monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, scheduled workloads, and overall service health.

* investigate and resolve production incidents, user issues, failed jobs, connectivity problems, access issues, api failures, and platform errors.

* perform root-cause analysis and work with engineering, application, data, and infrastructure teams to resolve recurring issues.

* support incident, problem, release, and change-management processes.

* develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, and support documentation.

* identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational and administrative activities.

* proactively identify platform health, reliability, and supportability improvements.

tableau platform administration

* administer and maintain the enterprise tableau server environment.

* support tableau server infrastructure, configuration, upgrades, patching, and platform maintenance.

* manage sites, projects, users, groups, permissions, and content access.

* troubleshoot extracts, refresh schedules, data-source connectivity, authentication, and performance issues.

* monitor tableau server processes, logs, resource utilization, and platform health.

* assist with platform upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and infrastructure-related activities.

amazon quicksight / quick suite administration, authoring & support

* provide day-to-day amazon quicksight / quick suite production support, administration, and operational troubleshooting.

* support the lifecycle, administration, and troubleshooting of bi and analytics assets, including:

o analyses

o dashboards

o datasets

o data sources

o themes

o folders

o templates

o topics and conversational bi capabilities

o other quicksight / quick suite assets and platform objects

* troubleshoot issues related to creating, updating, publishing, sharing, and accessing analyses and dashboards.

* support quicksight authoring capabilities and assist authors with analysis, visualization, dataset, data-source, dashboard, and semantic configuration issues.

* troubleshoot dataset ingestion and refresh failures, including spice ingestion, scheduled refreshes, and direct-query scenarios.

* diagnose data-source connectivity and access issues involving amazon athena and other supported data sources.

* support and troubleshoot themes and reusable assets, including permissions and sharing.

* manage and troubleshoot users, groups, namespaces, folders, asset permissions, and access controls.

* troubleshoot dashboard and analysis permissions, sharing, ownership, and access issues.

* understand and troubleshoot security and aws integrations, including iam-based access and permissions.

* support and troubleshoot programmatic management of quicksight assets using quicksight apis and aws sdks.

* troubleshoot api operations involving analyses, dashboards, datasets, data sources, themes, permissions, and other supported assets.

* support embedded quicksight capabilities and troubleshoot embedding, authentication, authorization, and access-related issues where applicable.

amazon q / generative bi & quick suite capabilities

* support and develop operational familiarity with amazon q capabilities within quicksight / quick suite, including natural-language and generative bi experiences.

* support amazon q topics and associated semantic configurations used to provide business context for natural-language analytics.

* troubleshoot user access, permissions, data availability, semantic configuration, and other issues affecting amazon q experiences.

* support conversational bi capabilities that allow users to ask questions of enterprise data using natural language.

* support newer quick suite conversational and agentic experiences, including chat agents, agents, and spaces, where adopted by the platform.

* understand how spaces organize relevant data, content, context, and resources used by quick suite experiences.

* assist with operational support and troubleshooting of amazon q / quick suite agents, including access, configuration, underlying data/content availability, and integration-related issues.

* work with platform and engineering teams as amazon q and quick suite capabilities evolve and are incorporated into the bi-as-a-service offering.

bi-as-a-service platform

provide operational and technical support for our internally developed bi-as-a-service platform built on amazon quicksight, including the aws data, api, serverless, monitoring, and analytics services that underpin the platform.

platform & quicksight integration

* understand the end-to-end biaas architecture and troubleshoot issues across apis, backend services, aws infrastructure, data services, quicksight, and quick suite capabilities.

* support integrations with amazon quicksight using quicksight apis and aws sdks.

* troubleshoot the programmatic creation, update, deployment, sharing, and management of quicksight assets.

* troubleshoot asset provisioning, permissions, embedding, authentication, authorization, and other quicksight integration workflows.

* analyze application and aws service logs to diagnose production issues.

* work closely with platform engineering and development teams to identify defects and implement sustainable fixes.

* assist with deployments, configuration changes, environment maintenance, and production releases.

aws data & analytics services

title: AI Engineer – Startups & Partnerships
description:
**discover your future at citi**
--------------------------------

working at citi is far more than just a job. a career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. at citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**job overview**
----------------

**about citi:**

citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

as a bank with a brain and a soul, citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. as a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our operations & technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. we reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. we foster an environment where the best people want to work. we value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. if you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. we’ll enable growth and progress together.

  
  

**the team:**
=============

the **startups & partnerships team** is the forward scout of the citi's head of ai organization. our mandate: identify, evaluate, and rapidly onboard the emerging technologies that will define citi's next chapter with artificial intelligence as our number one strategic priority right now. we don't sit in a lab waiting for ideas to trickle in. we move across every line of business at citi, sit down directly with business stakeholders and clients, and go toe-to-toe with the sharpest startups and frontier ai labs in the market. we run fast, we run lean, and we run with the full weight of a global institution behind us.

  
  

**the opportunity:**
====================

as an **ai engineer** on the startups & partnerships team, you will be at the **tip of the spear** for citi's ai strategy - building, testing, and shipping real applications that touch real business problems across the bank, not writing whitepapers about them from the sidelines.

you'll get a level of exposure that's rare in a tier-1 global bank: direct access to business requirements, hands-on evaluation of the newest models and platforms from the industry's leading ai labs, and the mandate to move at startup speed inside an institution operating at global scale. if you want to build things that matter, get them in front of real users fast, and shape how one of the world's largest financial institutions adopts ai - this is the seat.

  
  

**what you'll do day to day**
=============================

* **build and ship ai applications** - architect, develop, and deploy production-grade ai-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that solve real business problems across citi's lines of business.

* **evaluate emerging ai technology** - run structured proof-of-concepts and sandbox "bake-offs" to rapidly assess new models, platforms, and startup tools (llms, agentic frameworks, orchestration layers) for real-world fit.

* **prototype at speed** - turn a business idea into a working demo in days, not quarters, and iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback.

* **integrate across the stack** - connect llms and agentic systems to enterprise apis, data pipelines, and lightweight front-end or tooling layers to deliver end-to-end working solutions.

* **deliver pocs into production pathways** - work with governance, risk, and platform teams to shepherd validated solutions from prototype toward scaled deployment.

* **communicate impact** - translate technical work into clear, compelling narratives for senior business and technology stakeholders.
  

  

**required skills**
===================

* a **full-stack engineer with applied ai/llm experience** - this is explicitly **not** a data science or ml research role. we need builders, not modelers.

* proven experience **building and shipping ai applications, pipelines, and workflows** in live, production environments - not just notebooks and academic experiments.

* hands-on proficiency with **large language models (llms)**, prompt engineering, and **agentic frameworks and orchestration tools** (e.g., langchain, llamaindex, autogen, or similar).

* strong software engineering fundamentals - comfortable working across the stack, from backend services and api integrations to lightweight front-end or internal tooling layers.

* strong communication and stakeholder management skills - you can work directly with business leaders and clients, not just other engineers.

* a track record of learning and adopting new tools and platforms quickly as the ai landscape evolves.

* comfort operating in a large, regulated, global institution while bringing a startup-speed mentality to your work.
  

  

**nice-to-have skills**
=======================

* experience working directly with startups, venture teams, or technology scouting functions.

* familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), or knowledge graph-based retrieval.

* experience with containerization and cloud-native deployment (docker, kubernetes) for ai services.

* prior exposure to financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries.

* experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical, senior business audiences.
  

  

**education**
=============

* bachelor’s degree/university degree or equivalent experience
* master’s degree preferred

title: Senior Perception Learning Engineer
description:
apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing ai-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. our flagship humanoid robot, apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.  
  
we operate at the cutting edge of applied ai, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. you will join a team dedicated to bringing apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

you will drive research and development of advanced perception systems that empower apptronik's humanoid robots to understand and interact with complex human environments. your work will focus heavily on slam, visual-inertial odometry, world modeling, and learning-based perception, alongside object detection and multi-sensor fusion, creating the foundation for robust autonomy in real-world settings.

you will design and optimize deep learning models for real-time detection, tracking, segmentation, scene understanding, and state estimation while contributing to scalable pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment. you will also integrate data from multiple modalities—cameras, lidar, depth sensors, and imus—into unified world models that support navigation, manipulation, safety, and human-robot interaction.

this role requires balancing research innovation with practical engineering to deliver deployable, high-performance slam and perception stacks. you will collaborate across reinforcement learning teams, platform software team, and systems teams, and contribute to shaping apptronik's perception and autonomy roadmap. your work will directly accelerate the development of humanoid robots that can safely operate in human spaces, adapt to dynamic environments, and extend human capability.

### **core responsibilities**

* lead design, develop, and optimize perception and slam pipelines for humanoid robots, including visual-inertial odometry, mapping, localization, object detection, tracking, segmentation, pose estimation, and scene understanding.
* develop multi-sensor fusion frameworks that integrate cameras, lidar, depth sensors, and imus for robust real-time state estimation and mapping in dynamic human-centered environments.
* contribute to scalable data pipelines, training infrastructure, and inference frameworks to accelerate model development, evaluation, and deployment.
* drive research and deployment of learning-based models for slam, 3d scene understanding, and perception optimized for humanoid locomotion, manipulation, and human-robot interaction.
* implement performance profiling, regression testing, and telemetry systems to ensure perception and slam modules meet strict latency, accuracy, and reliability requirements on edge devices.
* collaborate with planning, control, and hardware teams to define perception-to-action interfaces, ensuring real-time compatibility with locomotion and manipulation pipelines.
* guide the integration of synthetic data (e.g., simulation frameworks like isaacsim) with real-world datasets to enhance model generalization and robustness.
contribute to best practices in code quality, model versioning, reproducibility, and deployment.  

### **required qualifications**

* ms/phd in computer science, robotics, computer engineering, or related field.
* 3- 5+ years building and shipping perception and/or slam systems in robotics or real-time vision applications.
* strong background in slam, vio, probabilistic state estimation, and deep learning for computer vision.
* practical expertise in detection, segmentation, multi-object tracking, 3d perception, and learning-based mapping/localization.
* hands-on experience with modern ai frameworks (pytorch, jax, tensorflow) and computer vision / multi-modal libraries such as opencv, detectron2, yolo, and foundation models for perception and language (e.g., sam, clip, dinov2, flamingo).
* proficiency in python and modern c++, with strong software engineering fundamentals (version control, testing, ci/cd).
* deep understanding of 3d geometry, camera models, and probabilistic estimation (ekf/ukf, factor graphs, slam, vio).
* experience deploying optimized perception or slam models on edge hardware (gpu/npu/embedded platforms) under compute, latency, and thermal constraints.
track record of shipping ml/perception or slam systems from r&d into production robotics platforms.  

### **preferred experience**

* experience with humanoid robots, bipedal locomotion, and manipulation tasks.
* experience with modern slam frameworks (e.g., orb-slam, vins, kimera, cartographer) or learning-based slam systems.
* strong classical computer vision skills (geometry-based methods, feature extraction) complementing learning-based approaches.
* expertise in model acceleration, quantization, or compression (tensorrt, onnx runtime).
* familiarity with real-time frameworks and middleware such as ros 2, gstreamer, or zero-copy pipelines.
* knowledge of synthetic data generation and domain adaptation techniques for training perception and slam models.
* contributions to open-source robotics or vision software stacks.

identity is the key to unlocking the potential of ai. okta secures ai by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. this work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. we are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

the team that built jeeva ai is building digital workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside okta. the team works directly with todd mckinnon, okta's co-founder and ceo, with the opportunity to bring this product to okta's 20,000+ customers. you will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

you will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. they investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

*careful evaluator:* you investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

*strong owner:* you follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

* evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. keep the harness connected to aws workflow execution and approval state.

* build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and ai agent onboarding.

* test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
* improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

* strong python engineering skills and experience shipping an llm application that uses tools.

* experience integrating model apis, structured outputs and asynchronous services. experience with openai or anthropic is especially relevant.
* depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
* ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

**scope by level**

senior: own an agent capability or evaluation pipeline with measurable improvements.

**our stack**

our core stack is python fastapi, aws step functions, amazon bedrock agentcore, postgresql on amazon rds and pgvector. openai and anthropic model apis are part of the integration plan.

we plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using clickhouse or bigquery. the harness choice is open. experience with equivalent tools also counts.

* fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.

**summary**
-----------

support an industry-sponsored research project, funded by a honda ai+x seed grant, that develops an explainable, cost-sensitive machine-learning framework to predict equipment component failures within 24 hours and turn those predictions into practical maintenance recommendations. the research assistant will combine manufacturing and maintenance knowledge with data science skills to prepare equipment data, build and evaluate predictive models, and translate results into decisions that make sense on the plant floor. work collaboratively with other project team members and the faculty supervisor.
  
  
**career readiness competencies**

* take initiative to learn new tools, systems, or procedures on the job.
* ask questions to gain clarity on job expectations and responsibilities.
* use appropriate grammar, punctuation, and formatting in written work.
* identify when additional information is needed before making a decision.
* build positive working relationships across campus departments.

**essential functions**
-----------------------

* help define the project scope and the input-output data schema for machine sensor readings (voltage, rotation, pressure, vibration), error logs, maintenance and component-replacement records, and machine attributes.
* acquire candidate datasets (public or partner-provided) and audit data quality, including duplicates, missing records, and timestamp alignment.
* build a reproducible python pipeline to clean and merge the records, construct 24-hour failure labels, and prevent temporal leakage.
* engineer tabular features (current readings, 3-hour and 24-hour trends, recent event counts, time since maintenance) and prepare sequence windows from the sensor data.
* implement a sensor-threshold baseline, then train and compare a lightgbm model and a compact temporal convolutional network (pytorch) using chronological data splits.
* evaluate models using pr-auc, precision, recall, brier score, and calibration plots, and apply sigmoid or isotonic probability calibration.
* develop maintenance cost ratios and inspection-capacity assumptions, and implement the cost-sensitive alert-ranking policy.
* evaluate results at the event level (failure coverage, alert lead time, false alerts per machine-month, daily inspection workload).
* generate model explanations using treeshap and integrated gradients, and interpret them from a maintenance and reliability perspective.
* maintain clear, version-controlled code and documentation (github), contribute to the final technical report and presentation, and support the final project showcase.
* perform other related research duties as assigned within the scope of the position.

**minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* currently enrolled bgsu student (undergraduate or graduate) in good academic standing.
* major in industrial/systems engineering, manufacturing or mechanical engineering technology, computer science, data science, statistics, or a related field.
* working python skills (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and coursework or project experience in data analysis or machine learning.
* basic understanding of manufacturing operations, equipment maintenance, or reliability concepts.
* strong written communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with appropriate supervision.

**additional information**
--------------------------

* preferred qualifications:
  + coursework or experience in predictive or preventive maintenance, reliability engineering, quality control, or lean six sigma.
  + industry or internship experience in a manufacturing environment.
  + experience with lightgbm or xgboost, pytorch or tensorflow, time-series or sensor data, or model explainability (shap).
  + familiarity with git/github, jupyter, and reproducible research practices.
* two openings. total hours are capped at 120 hours for one student (manufacturing focus) and 100 hours for the other (computational focus). work period: hire date through december 31, 2026, up to 20 hours per week, scheduled flexibly around the student’s classes. work can be done in the lab or remotely, as arranged with the supervisor. students are expected to attend and help present the project at the final showcase during the week of january 11, 2027. time is reported bi-weekly. the position reports to dr. md imran hasan tusar, assistant professor, systems engineering (eic #295). to apply, submit a resume and a brief statement (half a page at most) describing relevant coursework and experience. unofficial transcripts are optional.

title: Data Engineer
description:
hendrick autoguard - hiclocation: 6030 east independence blvd, charlotte, north carolina 28212

**position summary**

the data engineer is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for the systems and structures that make hendrick autoguard's data reliable, accessible, and useful. this role owns the design and operation of the ingestion pipelines, transformation logic, and data models that serve both business intelligence and ai initiatives.

this is not a role that waits for requirements to arrive fully formed. the data engineer is expected to develop a working understanding of how the business operates and to apply that knowledge when making technical decisions. a pipeline that runs on time but models the business incorrectly has not done its job. that distinction sits at the center of this role.

the role works alongside the analysts and bi developers who build reporting on the data platform, the data science and ai teams who use curated data for model development, and the team that administers the underlying cloud infrastructure. the data engineer makes sure the data layer serves each of these groups well, so that none of them has to rebuild it for their own use.

**what this role does**

the data engineer owns the movement of data from source systems into the snowflake data platform. in practice that means designing, building, and maintaining ingestion pipelines; orchestrating workflows in dagster so they are observable, reliable, and operationally sound; and monitoring pipeline health and data availability. when a load fails or data arrives late, the data engineer investigates, fixes the underlying cause, and puts alerting in place so the same problem surfaces early next time rather than in a stakeholder's report.

once data lands, the data engineer develops and maintains the dbt transformation models that turn raw source data into clean, tested, and well-documented datasets. that includes designing dimensional models and data marts that support both reporting and machine learning use cases, and implementing data quality checks and testing standards throughout the transformation layer. downstream consumers should be able to trust a dataset without re-verifying it themselves.

the data engineer also prepares data for ai. that work includes structuring feature datasets and training data pipelines, and collaborating with data science and ai teams to make sure the data meets their requirements for quality, freshness, and structure. the data engineer contributes to the semantic layer that gives ai and analytics consumers consistent, well-defined access to business metrics and entities, and keeps data lineage and governance in view, since ai applications raise the stakes on knowing where data came from and how it may be used.

the data engineer is also expected to advise on the strategic direction of the data engineering toolset, weighing in on platform and feature updates and evaluating new capabilities as they become available. staying current with best practices and industry advancements in data engineering, ai data preparation, and orchestration is part of the job, not a side interest, and that knowledge should inform how the team's tools and standards evolve over time.

across all of this work, the data engineer builds working knowledge of the autoguard business processes it supports, including vehicle service contract and protection product sales through dealership partners, claims administration, and cancellations, along with the workflows and decisions that depend on data from those areas. the data engineer engages directly with business stakeholders to understand their data needs, translates those needs into sound technical designs, and applies business context when weighing modeling decisions, pipeline priorities, and data quality standards. that knowledge makes each new request faster to scope. it also makes the data engineer a useful partner when a team is still working out which question it needs to answer.

**adjacent competencies**

dashboard and report preparation are not a routine part of this role, and primary ownership of that work belongs to analysts and bi developers. the data engineer may occasionally need to support that function, though, whether by building or troubleshooting a report in a pinch or by helping an analyst work through a modeling issue at the source. the data engineer's core job is to deliver the modeled, tested data those teams build on, and to work with them when a reporting need exposes a gap in the data layer.

**experience and qualifications**

a candidate for this role has 3–7 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline. they are proficient in sql and have hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, a data transformation and modeling framework, and a workflow orchestration tool. experience with snowflake, dbt, and dagster is strongly preferred, as is familiarity with aws, including storage, iam, and basic networking concepts.

preferred experience includes python for pipeline development or data scripting; exposure to data quality frameworks, data contracts, or observability tooling; supporting ml pipelines or ai data preparation workflows; familiarity with medallion architecture or similar layered data design patterns; and involvement in data governance or data catalog efforts. the current technology environment includes snowflake, dagster, dbt, aws (s3, ec2, and iam), python, and github.

candidates must be able to engage with non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into technical requirements. clear written and verbal communication is not optional in this role. the data engineer produces model documentation, dataset descriptions, and design notes that analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders rely on. that documentation needs to be accurate, specific, and usable without a follow-up conversation.

**working conditions**

the data engineer works on site at hendrick automotive group headquarters in a standard office environment, collaborating in person with technology teams and the business stakeholders this role supports. travel is minimal, and may be by car or plane. position is not remote due to essential functions of the job. position is required to sit for prolonged periods of time, extensive use of computer and related functions like typing and other office equipment used in regular performance of essential functions like phone, printer.

hendrick is an equal opportunity employer. minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
